0.completion: Well done! You certainly are no amateur when it comes to killing monsters. I foresee that you will become the next great hero of Greece!
0.details: Greetings, brave Spartan! You look like a fierce fighter but you still must prove your valor. A pack of mischievous Dumb Wood Men are plaguing the outskirts of Newbie Village. Go there and kill 10 of them to show me what you can do!
0.objectives: Kill 10 Dumb Wood Men and return to the Newbie Guide. Click the quest names in green text to start auto-track.
0.title: [Lv200]Welcome to Sparta!

1.completion: Welcome back! You have earned my trust but you still have a long way to go.
1.details: Word of your skill and courage has reached Ion, the head of Newbie Village. He wishes to speak with you about some challenging missions if you are up to the task.
1.objectives: Speak with Ion in Newbie Village.  Click the character names in green text to start auto-track.
1.title: [Lv200]Where's Ion?

2.completion: Excellent work with those pesky puppets. You are well on your way to becoming a true legend in Greece.
2.details: You are a skilled warrior but still have much to learn. To continue your training, cut down 10 Wooden Puppets just outside Newbie Village and then report to [Skill]Thisbe.
2.objectives: Kill 10 Wooden Puppets and return to [Skill]Thisbe.
2.title: [Lv200]The Puppeteer

3.completion: Thank you for taking care of the Vipers.
3.details: Defend the glory of Sparta by slaying the Vipers in the Sparta Starting Area!
3.objectives: Destroy the Vipers in the Sparta Starting Area.
3.title: [Lv200]Spartan Honor

4.completion: You've chased off the vipers. Excellent work.
4.details: It seems those Snakes were just the tip of the iceberg. Rid us of the Vipers hiding in the Suburbs, and I will see that you are handsomely rewarded.
4.objectives: Kill some Vipers in the Suburbs of Sparta, then report to the [Round Quest]Main City Issuer.
4.title: [Lv200]Viper Attack!

5.completion: Thanks you for keeping Peloponnesus safe for the athletes.
5.details: The Boas out here have been attacking many of the athletes. I heard from Patroklos that you are quite the snake wrangler. Can you get rid of the Boas for me?
5.objectives: Kill the  Boas in Peloponnesus, then report to the [Round Quest]Peloponnesus Issuer.
5.title: [Lv200]Snake Wrangler

6.completion: Hey, I've heard of your achievements. I am the deputy Village Head of the Starting Area. Every day I stand here to greet heroes like you. I am so excited to finally meet you!
6.details: What do you think of this Starting Area? Its surely lost some of its charm when all the monsters moved in. Would you please give my message to Peleus, the one with a ponytail? Tell him the monsters have all cleared out. For your information, my friend, he is the Village Head of the Starting Area.
6.objectives: Talk to Peleus, the head of the Starting Area.
6.title: [Lv5]Pay a Visit

7.completion: Yeah, I am Filippou, the Skill Merchant here! What, you didn't know?
7.details: If you have any trouble, ask others for help. Now go to talk with [Skill]Filippou. Remember his name, could you pronounce it?
7.objectives: Talk to [Skill]Filippou in the Starting Area of Sparta.
7.title: [Lv5]Start Training

8.completion: You did a good job, you have definitely earned these skill points!
8.details: Want to learn some skills? There are two kinds of skills, active skills and passive skills. Active skills must be learned from specialized books while passive skills require accumulated skill points. You can do some practice to earn experience. There are many Wooden Puppets outside the Starting Area, would you catch some for me? All big heroes develop from basic training - like deer hunting.
8.objectives: Clear the Wooden Puppets outside the Starting Area,and return to have a talk with [Skill]Filippou.
8.title: [Lv6]More Challenges

9.completion: Thank you so much for destroying those snakes. How can I repay you? Ah, I see that your bag is weighing you down! Deposit your things with me, and I will keep them safe. Withdraw them for free from any of my fellow Warehouse colleagues.
9.details: News travel fast in this place. I have spoken about you with [Warehouse]Savva. He would like you to kill the Little Snakes in this region. Exterminate them to show your sincerity.
9.objectives: Kill some Little Snakes outside the Spartan Starting Area and then talk to [Warehouse]Savva.
9.title: [Lv200]The Warehouse

10.completion: You have done well and many are requesting your help. Lend your strength to the troubled citizens in this area, and they will reward you handsomely.
10.details: You have done well here, young hero. But I hear the Newbie Guide has some news for you and wants you to go back. Return to him at once. It must be important!
10.objectives: Speak with the Newbie Guide in the Newbie Village of the main city.
10.title: [Lv200]Return to the Guide

11.details: Ion recommended you to assist the Main City of Sparta. Speak with Ion for more details.
11.title: [Lv200]Recommendation

12.completion: Greetings, I am Foka, an Officer of Sparta. We are seeking heroes to join our war against Athens. Every Spartan must do their part!
12.details: Foka, one of the city's officials, has asked me to find some young talent for a mission. I think you’d be a good fit for it. Bring this reference letter to Foka, and he’ll fill you in on all the details. In return, I need you to clear out the Chest Monsters nearby.
12.objectives: Clear some Chest Monsters outside the Sparta Starting Area, then talk to Foka.
12.title: [Lv200]Foka's Chests

13.completion: My troops know that I am a man of few compliments. But you did well, young hero.
13.details: Before we strike Athens, you must first demolish the Snake infestation outside the city. Defeat them and bring back 10 Sulphur's Stones to prove yourself!
13.objectives: Clear some Snakes outside the Starting Area of Sparta and bring 10 Sulphur's Stones to Foka.
13.title: [Lv200]Foka's Test

14.completion: Welcome, recruit! May the Gods bless you!
14.details: You should speak with Pelagias in Sparta. To find your way around the city, bring up the Quest window and go to the Search tab. Search for Pelageias' name to find him.
14.objectives: Talk to the Spartan officer Pelagias.
14.title: [Lv200]Searching for Pelagias

15.completion: What is this, some kind of a joke? I thought I had asked for someone with more experience! Well, I guess you'll have to do... but you won't be fighting any Athenians looking like this. Heh!
15.details: Welcome to the Main City! I'll bet you've never been to a place like this before. Make your way around the city and get to know the streets. Say, if you're interested, you should head to the Recruits Camp. The Captain of the Guards, Asteriou, has a task for you.
15.title: [Lv200]The Main City

16.completion: Well done, recruit! This is the kind of hard work we're looking for! Here, you earned this!
16.details: The Spartan citizens near the Starting Area are being terrorized by a plague of Snakes. I need you to clear those monsters out. I wouldn't be surprised in the least if this was the work of Elis up in the North.
16.objectives: Clear the Snakes from outside the Sparta Starting Area and then return to Asteriou.
16.title: [Lv200]Sparring in Sparta

17.completion: Ha! Yeah, I guess you can say I'm a bit of a joker. But hey, it's good for morale, right? Here, this was passed down to me by some of the great warriors of Sparta. I think it might do you some good.
17.details: There is no such thing as a one-man battalion, so be prepared to make friends with your comrades. You might also want to get aquainted with Nathanail. He's helped a lot of the new recruits in the past.
17.title: [Lv200]Meet the Troops

18.completion: H-h-hello. Are you here to request a song? I'm afraid I've lost my sense of inspiration. All I can think about is hiding from the monsters! If only there was a way to take care of them.
18.details: The whole city is panicking about the monster infestation. Zeno, the musician, is losing his mind over this. What a coward; he's even thinking of packing up and leaving the city! How can we expect to enjoy ourselves at the upcoming festivals without his music? Do you think you can talk him out of moving away? Tell him anything you want. Just make sure he stays!
18.objectives: Find the Musician Zeno and put his mind at ease.
18.title: [Lv200]The Frightened Musician

19.completion: So, any luck getting the musician to stay?
19.details: What? You'll get rid of all these monsters? Well, if you're absolutely certain you can, I'll stay. Oh, I'm so glad you're doing this for me. Tell you what, how would you like to be my personal bodyguard? The citizens expect me to present a new melody at the Festival of Ares, but my hands keep shaking from fear! What do you say?
19.objectives: Speak with Nathanail about becoming the musician's bodyguard.
19.title: [Lv200]The Musician's Bodyguard

20.completion: Well done! You might be even stronger than I was at your age!
20.details: So, Zeno needs a bodyguard, huh? Ha ha! What a coward! You know, it's the Lions that are really getting to him. They're causing all sorts of trouble in the Suburbs. If you get rid of those fiends, he'll be much more willing to stay in the city! Come back after you've slayed those monsters.
20.objectives: Destroy the Lions in the Suburbs of Sparta, then talk with Nathanail.
20.title: [Lv200]Nathanail's Advice

21.completion: My word! Did you really destroy all of those nasty toothy things? Fantastic! Here, let me reward you for all of your hard work.
21.details: Nicely done. Now go tell Zeno the good news!
21.title: [Lv200]The Musician's Surprise

22.completion: Why, hello there! Did Zeno send you? I've been waiting for his new song for so long!
22.details: Thanks to you, I completed a new song! Would you mind sending this music scroll to my darling, the beautiful Eeria? She is truly breathtaking.
22.title: [Lv200]A Romantic Serenade

23.completion: I see. How disappointing, I was hoping the grapes would've ripened by now! Are you Eeria's new assistant?
23.details: Say, while you're here, may I ask a favor of you? Senator Amvrosiou asked me to grow some Olympic Grapes for him but I'm running very low on seeds. Would you mind informing the Senator that his order has been delayed? I could have more supplies delivered if the roads weren't teeming with monsters.
23.objectives: Talk to Senator Amvrosiou in Sparta.
23.title: [Lv200]Helping Eeria

24.completion: Oh dear! Now I absolutely must find some seeds. Thank you for telling me!
24.details: This is quite disastrous. If this was my order, I would have no complaints about waiting. Unfortunately, the grapes were ordered for Pelagias, the Executor, to use during the Carnival Ceremony. Please tell Lady Eeria they must ripen in time!
24.title: [Lv200]Rush Delivery

25.completion: Wonderful! This will most definitely be enough for the festival! How sweet of you!
25.details: Unfortunately, I still haven't received the new batch of grape seeds that I need for the Senator's order. Even worse, all the grapes from the orchards nearby have been devoured by those nasty monsters! Would you mind defeating some Vipers and getting me 8 Seeds?
25.objectives: Collect 8 Seeds for Eeria by defeating the Vipers.
25.title: [Lv200]Emergency Supplies

26.completion: I’m so relieved to receive such good news in such a short time! You have put my heart at ease.
26.details: Ah, time to get back to work! Can you please tell Senator Amvrosiou that I will complete his order on time?
26.objectives: Talk to Senator Amvrosiou in Sparta.
26.title: [Lv200]The Senator's Order

27.completion: Hmm? What could a youngster like you want with such a a boring old fogey like me?
27.details: Ah, a weight has been lifted from my shoulders! Now I can get back to preparing for the big celebration. There's so much to do and so little time! Can you please tell Mr. Claudios, my law expert, that I need to speak with him immediately?
27.title: [Lv200]The Senator's Envoy I

28.completion: The manuscript? How did you hear about that?
28.details: Ah, so my old friend Amvrosiou needs me again? Ha ha! He'd be helpless without me. Well, I would like to go but I'm afraid I'm busy searching for my Manuscript. I've looked all over for it. Hmm... perhaps my student Kleopatra has taken it. No matter what, I must find it! It's very rare and was made from the sacred Nile's Sedge. Well, I guess it would be best if I didn't keep the Senator waiting too long. Would you mind searching for my Manuscript while I'm away?
28.title: [Lv200]The Lost Manuscript

29.completion: Oh, how forgetful of me. I've been so busy lately that I'd forget where I put my head if it wasn't attached to me! I just spoke with Senator Amvrosiou and will gladly join his speech group tp bring peace to Sparta. Surely even Ares himself will bless our mission. You may be unaware, but a secret war is raging between Sparta and Athens.
29.details: Well, of course I have Mr. Claudios' manuscript. I told him I was going to borrow it before I left! But he's getting older now and his hearing is absolutely terrible when he's busy. Could you please explain to him that I have his manuscript?
29.title: [Lv200]The Manuscript

30.completion: Ah, you're back! I am very pleased to hear that Claudios will be joining me for the ceremony. Here, take this for your hard work.
30.details: If we had time, I'm sure you and I could hold an excellent debate but it will have to wait until I've finished working with the Senetor on his speech. That reminds me, can you tell the Senator I'll see him soon?
30.objectives: Talk with Senator Amvrosiou in Sparta.
30.title: [Lv200]The Naggy Tutor

31.completion: Sure. I can repair the Holy Square. To be honest, I'm not a big fan of Senator Amvrosiou. But I've heard good things about you and all the good you've done.
31.details: I also will need help from Master Ikaros. I need him to repair the Holy Square before the Festival of Ares commences. Would you please go speak with him for me?
31.title: [Lv200]The Senator's Envoy 2

32.completion: Well, what do you know. Great job, kid!
32.details: I'm currently doing research on new types of cement but I'm running out of usable materials. Can you bring me 3 pieces of Magic Alloy? I hear the Skeletons in the Suburbs like to collect them.
32.objectives: Collect 3 Magic Alloys from the Skeletons in the Suburbs of Sparta, then speak to Ikaros in Sparta.
32.title: [Lv200]Concrete Magic

33.completion: What? How dare he refuse such a glorious task! Any other Spartan would be thrilled!
33.details: What's that? Oh, right, the repairs. You know, now that I think about it, I really don't have the time. Surely, the Senator can understand that.
33.title: [Lv200]Cooky Engineer

34.completion: Ah, life is like paint - the colors can mix perfectly one moment and suddenly go terribly wrong in the next! What do you need from me?
34.details: Don't worry, I'm not angry. If I recall correctly, Ikaros has a friend by the name of Artem who lives in the Sparta Starting Area. Perhaps he can convince his stubborn friend to help me.
34.objectives: Talk to Artem in the Sparta Starting Area.
34.title: [Lv200]The Senator's Advice

35.completion: Why did Artem send you? My trouble with Simonos is my business. Has that sneaky warrior been spreading rumors about me?
35.details: Heh, I see Ikaros is being stubborn again. Very well, I will talk to him. While I'm gone, can you visit Viktoros? His loud quarrel with [Warrior]Simonos is driving me mad.
35.objectives: Talk to Viktoros in the Sparta Starting Area.
35.title: [Lv200]The Painter 1

36.completion: Stingy? I never said such a thing! Ever since he became friends with Dionysus, he has had too much wine at his disposal!
36.details: Listen here, I'll tell you why I'm so angry. I sent Simonos a gift a few days ago, and yet that ungrateful swine still dares to call me stingy! I swear by Ares' name that I will never forgive this!
36.objectives: Talk to $Simonos in the Sparta Starting Area.
36.title: [Lv200]Angry Viktoros

37.completion: He said that? It seems I overreacted to silly rumors. Yes, I will make him a new weapon as an apology. And I will make one for you as well!
37.details: Look, I'll be the bigger man. Viktoros has been easily irritated lately. Please send him my good wishes.
37.objectives: Talk to Viktoros in the Sparta Starting Area.
37.title: [Lv200]Simonos' Defense

38.completion: I knew he would come to his senses, heh heh. Thank you for all of your hard work!
38.details: Here, may this little number assist you in your bold adventures! But before you leave, can you send my apologies to Simonos? I am too embarassed to face him.
38.objectives: Talk to $Simonos in the Sparta Starting Area.
38.title: [Lv200]The Jolly Ironsmith

39.completion: That was quite a trip. I'm about to lose my voice from debating with Ikaros!
39.details: I heard Artem is back from his visit to Ikaros and is looking for you. You may want to head his way soon.
39.objectives: Talk to Artem in the Sparta Starting Area.
39.title: [Lv200]The Painter 2

40.completion: *Sigh* So much to do, so little time...
40.details: Thank you for settling that issue between Viktoros and Simonos. Now go see Ikaros. I believe you will find him much more receptive.
40.title: [Lv200]The Painter 3

41.completion: Aha! Excellent. This must be the map for the hidden hammer! But these ancient words are nothing but gibberish to me.
41.details: The Skeletons outside the village found out that I have been collecting Magic Alloys and have taken upon themselves to seek revenge! My precious Magic Hammer is no where to be found. You must return it to me!
41.objectives: Defeat the Skeleton to find clues about the missing Magic Hammer.
41.title: [Lv200]Pesky Thieves

42.completion: Why, greetings, child. There is a sparkle in your eyes that resembles my dear friend Aristotle.
42.details: No, this map is not the Skeletons' work. They are incapable of such feats! For now, we need the wisdom of [Priest]Diotima. She is the most learned scholar in all of Sparta.
42.title: [Lv200]The Decipherer

43.completion: What are you doing with that map?
43.details: A map, you say? Hmm... these symbols are ancient letters from the Island of Crete. It seems to lead to some type of treasure. This is very sophisticated. Even the paint is of rare origin! No, this couldn't be the work of Skeletons. I believe a Spartan made this. If I am correct, Artem is very fond of this style of paint.
43.objectives: Talk to Artem in the Sparta Starting Area.
43.title: [Lv200]The Detective

44.completion: You're looking for the hammer? Well, of course I have it. Artem said he needed a place to store it.
44.details: Yes, I took his hammer. But before your eyebrow raises further, let me explain! I was jealous that the Senator had only invited Ikaros for the preparations. An engineer can't complete a project alone, you know! Anyway, I intended on returning it to him a few days later, but I misplaced the map and could not remember the hammer's whereabouts. Can you find it? You should ask Savva for help. He was my accomplice.
44.objectives: Talk to [Warehouse]Savva in the Starting Area of the main city.
44.title: [Lv200]The Painter 4

45.completion: Artem and Savva? I never would have thought. Well, at least it is safe. Thank you.
45.details: Please don't think badly of Artem. Tell Ikaros he can collect the hammer from me any time.
45.title: [Lv200]The Painter 5

46.completion: Feh! The lengths one must go to in order to get good help these days!
46.details: Well, thank you very much for this wonderful news! No need to worry, I'm not actually angry at anyone. I'll gladly help with the project. Please tell Amvrosiou that he'll have my assistance.
46.title: [Lv200]The Relieved Engineer

47.completion: Ah, yes! I sensed you would be in need of my visions.
47.details: How fortuitous to have someone as skilled as Ikaros leading the repair project! Unfortunately, I'm afraid I must punish Artem for his foolishness by making him do all the painting for the festival! I have yet another favor to ask of you. There's a great athelete who lives in Peloponnesus. I need you to find him. If you need more clues on his whereabouts, talk to Basileiou at the Peloponnesus Outpost.
47.title: [Lv200]The Senator's Envoy 3

48.details: Ah, yes! I know of whom you seek. He is mighty hero, is he not? I know where he spars but first, you must assist me with something in return. There are several Huge Spiders plaguing the plains. Slay these beasts and speak with the Hermit Varnava. He will guide you further.
48.objectives: Defeat the Huge Spiders, then talk to Varnava in Peloponnesus.
48.title: [Lv200]The Prophet's Parlor

49.completion: Oh, hello there. What's that? Varnava thinks I have his dog?
49.details: I am so sick of all these monsters! To make matters worse, my dog has gone missing. Can you help me find him? My only hope is that Annis took it on a stroll. Please be careful where you look. There are several scorpions in these fields.
49.objectives: Defeat the Scorpions in Peloponnesus, then talk with Annis.
49.title: [Lv200]A Hermit's Best Friend

50.completion: Oh, help! There's a poor little puppy in danger!
50.details: I'm afraid I haven't seen Varnava's dog lately. I hope he wasn't devoured by the monsters. Oh, that would just be terrible! My sister Thalia has also gone missing. Please, while you're looking for that poor dog, keep an eye out for my sister too.
50.title: [Lv200]The Sisters 1

51.completion: Oh no, this bone came from the puppy!
51.details: Annis is looking for me? She must be worried sick. Oh dear, I'll be in deep trouble when I go home! But I can't go back yet. Not until I know the dog is safe from all of those Boas. Won't you please do something?
51.objectives: Defeat the Boas in Peloponnesus, then talk to Thalia.
51.title: [Lv200]The Sisters 2

52.completion: Oh dear, Varnava won't be happy to hear this. I'll give him the bad news.
52.details: I've cried away all my strength. Please let my sister know that I'm alright. I'll be home after a little rest.
52.title: [Lv200]The Sisters 3

53.completion: Ahh! Please help! One of those evil Scorpions just stung me!
53.details: Wait, Thalia is still out there! It's getting ever so late and there are wicked monsters out there. Please tell her to come home!
53.title: [Lv200]The Sisters 4

54.details: It hurts so much! Am I dying? Please! Find Fanouriou, the doctor! He'll know what to do.
54.objectives: Talk to Fanouriou in the Sparta Starting Area.
54.title: [Lv200]The Scorpion Strikes!

55.completion: Oh... good... I was beginning... to worry.
55.details: You got here just in the nick of time! This is my very last Antidote. Here, take it and hurry. Even if the Scorpion's venom doesn't kill her, the pain must be unbearable. I just hope I can get more medicine before this happens again.
55.objectives: Take the Antidote to Thalia in Peloponnesus.
55.title: [Lv200]The Doctor

56.completion: Curses! The monsters here were not so demonic a few years ago!
56.details: Oh, I am much better now. While you were away, Varnava cleaned the wound for me. He was so upset and rushed into the forest to hunt down the Scorpions! Please make sure he's alright.
56.title: [Lv200]The Brave Hermit

57.completion: Unbelievable. Varnava was stung as well? I'll make the antidote right away.
57.details: Ah... I'm afraid those vile monsters got the best of me... do you have more antidote? What's that? No more? Then you must act quickly!. Kill the Scorpions and take a sample of their venom to the doctor. Hurry!
57.objectives: Collect the Scorpion Venom and take it to Fanouriou in the Sparta Starting Area.
57.title: [Lv200]Natural Remedies

58.completion: Well, you know what they say. Just what the doctor ordered, eh?
58.details: There, that ought to do the job. Take this antidote to Varnava quickly!
58.objectives: Deliver the antidote to Varnava in Peloponnesus.
58.title: [Lv200]Help Is On The Way!

59.completion: Fantastic job! Once again, you've earned this.
59.details: Thanks a lot, friend. What's that? You're looking for a great athlete? Well, here I am. Don't look so shocked! I have scaled countless mountains and fought my fair share of monsters in the past. Let Amvrosiou know I'll gladly be there.
59.objectives: Talk with Senator Amvrosiou in Sparta.
59.title: [Lv200]The Athletic Hermit

60.completion: Hello there, soldier. Well, haven't you become a fine civil servent. That's not necessarily a compliment. Heh heh.
60.details: Well it looks as though my party is assembled! This is most splendid! Say, while you were out, your old commander, Captain Asteriou, was looking for you. Why don't you pay him a visit.
60.title: [Lv200]The Senator's Envoy 4

61.completion: Hey, it's not safe to travel out here alone.
61.details: Recent scouting reports show that one of the main trade routes in Peloponnesus is blocked. I need you to investigate this. Before you go, speak with Koronos. He's the Vanguard Captain in Peloponnesus. He'll have more information for you.
61.title: [Lv200]Traffic Patrol

62.completion: Even Ares could not have done it better. Good job, soldier!
62.details: The trade routes have been growing increasingly unstable. In fact, Luka the merchant was just attacked! What's worse, a wave of Toxic Scorpions near the trade route is preventing our advance. Help us!
62.objectives: Defeat the Toxic Scorpions in Peloponnesus, then talk to Koronos.
62.title: [Lv200]Pluck the Stingers

63.completion: Who goes there? Koronos sent you? Fine. Have a look at this.
63.details: Vice Captain Meges sent an envoy while you were away. He says he's uncovered information that may help us clear the roads. I cannot leave this camp, so you will have to assist him.
63.title: [Lv200]A Vital Discovery

64.completion: Well now, let’s hear what they have to say for themselves.
64.details: Our scouts have spotted an unearthly group of troublemakers on the trade route. The ones who have been attacking the merchants are not bandits but Huge Skeletons! Help me bring these lawless fiends in for interrogation.
64.objectives: Defeat the Huge Skeletons in Peloponnesus, then speak with Meges.
64.title: [Lv200]If Skulls Could Speak

65.completion: Grand work, soldier! You up for another challenge?
65.details: It looks like these skeletons won't be causing trouble any time soon. You may return to Captain Koronos. I'm sure he'll be as proud of you as I am.
65.title: [Lv200]Justice is Served

66.completion: Well well. You just keep turning heads, don't you? Here, this skill book has helped me over the years. Let's hope it does you some good as well.
66.details: We may have the upperhand now, but victory is never sure to last. Return to Guard Captain Asteriou and inform him that we are in need of reinforcements.
66.title: [Lv200]Reinforcements

67.details: Heh! Leave it to those no-good Skeletons to take advantage of a bad situation. To dispatch more men, I will need a direct order from General Muropis. The men I have are needed to guard the city of Sparta.
67.title: [Lv200]Authorizing Deployment

68.completion: Take cover, kid. The frontline ain't no plaground.
68.details: Just hold on a second. We'll get to your problem soon enough. First, it's been months since I received word from Antilochos. Find him and bring me his report. He is probably trapped by those sinister Evil Wizards.
68.objectives: Clear out the Evil Wizards, then find Antilochos in Nemea.
68.title: [Lv200]Dark Magic

69.completion: Hey there. What's that? Withdraw my squad?
69.details: Reassign the men? During a war? Are you out of your mind? I've been in need of reinforcements for weeks but all communication to Sparta has been lost. The only squad that can spare a few men are under the command of Automedon. Go check with him.
69.title: [Lv45]A Tight Situation

70.completion: That should work well enough as a decoy.
70.details: To be honest, we haven't seen action in a while. All this restlessness is bad for morale. But an open withdrawal will be a sign of weakness to our enemies. Take the men to defeat some wild Wild Lions.
70.objectives: Defeat the Wild Lions in Nemea, then talk to Automedon.
70.title: [Lv47]The Decoy

71.completion: I do like your armor. Is that the newest trend?
71.details: Great job. Go speak with Eurubaies. His unit will return to Sparta with you.
71.title: [Lv48]Soldiers to Spare

72.completion: By Zeus' beard! What are you talking about?
72.details: Well, how you doin' today? Say what? Automedon wants me to go home? No! I re-re-refuse! I was just starting to have fun. Whee!
72.title: [Lv49]The Wild Man

73.completion: My, oh my. A Chaos Spell you say?
73.details: I've seen this before. Eurubaies is under a Chaos Spell! We must cure him before anyone else notices. Quickly, find Pit. He can help lift this curse.
73.title: [Lv50]The Chaos Spell

74.completion: I have worked out the solution. Are you ready?
74.details: A Chaos Spell is no laughing matter. Well, maybe it is a little. Heh heh. But I know just the cure. Give me a moment...
74.title: [Lv51]Alchemy at its Finest

75.completion: Yes, yes yes. An excellent job.
75.details: What I need are some Mint Seeds. Unfortunately, you'll have to get them from the Wizard Lair nearby.
75.objectives: Defeat the Wizards and collect 10 Mint Seeds, then talk to Pit in Nemea.
75.title: [Lv52]Minty Wizards

76.completion: Why, yes I have the dispensing kit right here. What? He wants it back already?
76.details: The potion needs time to complete. Meanwhile, will you find Gerasimou in Peloponnesus and get my Dispensing Kit? I will have the potion finished when you return.
76.title: [Lv53]Dispensing Kit

77.details: Actually... I lent the Dispensing Kit to a guy named Theklas in Nemea. Find him and you'll find the kit.
77.title: [Lv54]Borrowing from Borrowers

78.completion: Thekla who? Well, that's what I get for dealing with scoundrels.
78.details: I'm sorry. I was under the impression it belonged to Gerasimou. Well, if it must be returned to it's rightful owner then so be it.
78.title: [Lv55]Ranger's Apology

79.completion: No! I don't like medicine! It tastes yucky! Aaaahh!! *Gulp*
79.details: Run this potion out to Eurubaies. He'll be fine.
79.title: [Lv56]A Cure for Chaos

80.completion: Ah, you've returned. I see you've been fighting Wizards. You're covered in magic dust!
80.details: Wh-what happened? I can't remember anything, except I was fighting Forest Wizards! Yes, I can send my squad back to Sparta, but we cannot leave while these spellshapers are at large. Alas, I am still weak... surely you can get rid of them.
80.objectives: Defeat the Forest Wizards in Nemea, then talk to Automedon.
80.title: [Lv57]Eurubaies' Awakening

81.details: I'll easily be able to spare a few men now. But first, I need you to visit northern Argolis. I just received word that there are some intruders in that area. Head that way and meet with Menesthes.
81.title: [Lv58]The Last Patrol

82.details: My job is to patrol the border between Athens and Sparta, but the local citizens refuse to stay clear of this dangerous area. Can you make them leave? Find Eurumedon if you need help.
82.title: [Lv59]Border Patrol

83.details: So you wish to be persuasive? I find that people like to follow those with unusual skills. If you wish to strengthen your reputation, defeat the Death Servants and bring me some Green Stone Pieces. I'll teach you how to conjour Thunderbolt Balls.
83.objectives: Collect Green Stone Pieces by defeating the Death Servants in Argolis, then speak to Eurumedon.
83.title: [Lv60]A Test of Might

84.details: The leader of Argolis is a man named Menelaos. If you can convince him to redirect his men into military service, we will be much more united before our foes!
84.title: [Lv62]For the Greater Good

85.completion: Look at you. You must've come all the way from the Main City.
85.details: Cooperate with those military goons? Hah! What we really need are the experienced Mycenaen fighters! If you want my trust, have a word with Aeoliah for me. Let him know his men will be paid handsomely.
85.title: [Lv64]Spartan Militia

86.details: Sure, we can help but at a cost. Let's start with 100 in silver. Bring that and we can talk.
86.title: [Lv66]Hired Help

87.completion: Well, well, well. Looks like I picked the right side after all.
87.details: This is more than enough to share with the boys. But you know, my men have families and we don't fight losin' battles! Athens or the Persians, we're still debatin'. Tell you what, if you can salvage some Small Purses from the Robber Kelins, we have a deal.
87.objectives: Defeat the Robber Kelins and bring some Small Purses to Aeoliah in Argolis.
87.title: [Lv68]Proof of Power

88.completion: Is that so? They really agreed to help us?
88.details: Alright, go and tell Menelaos that we'll join his men. But make it quick! A great hero like me doesn't have all day. Heh heh heh.
88.title: [Lv70]The Mercenaries

89.completion: That's fantastic! You deserve a promtion for all your hard work!
89.details: If Aeoliah is joining, my men will as well. And I heard Antilochos was looking for you. I'm sure he'll be pleased to hear about this. Ares be with you!
89.title: [Lv72]United Front

90.completion: Alright, we're all ready to go!
90.details: Go tell Eurubaies to prepare his men to move out. Automedon should also be ready about now.
90.title: [Lv74]Reassignment

91.completion: Orders from Eurubaies? I hope this isn't part of that Chaos Spell he was under.
91.details: I've got some bad news, kid. Some of our enemies from Kelin Bay are hiding in Nemea. Those evil intruders are planning to attack our capital from the sea. Head west and find the Guard out there. All are for Sparta!
91.objectives: Talk to the Guard in Nemea.
91.title: [Lv75]Seaside Trouble

92.details: I'm afraid I can't give orders. You'll need to speak with the Captain about this.
92.objectives: Talk to the Captain in Nemea.
92.title: [Lv77]Higher Command

93.completion: That'll do just fine. And don’t worry, they won't go to waste. We can turn their shells into shields and use the bodies as sacrifices to the Gods.
93.details: Alright, my men will begin patrolling the coasts. But first, I'll need you to get rid of the Magic Tortoises out there. Soldiers don't make good fish food, you know?
93.objectives: Get rid of the Magic Tortoises in Argolis, then talk to the Captain in Nemea.
93.title: [Lv79]Turtle Hurdles

94.completion: Greetings, mighty hero! To what do I owe the pleasure?
94.details: My men can easily guard the coastline now. Head to the nearby village and tell the Village Head not to be alarmed by the military reassignment.
94.objectives: Talk to the Village Head in Nemea.
94.title: [Lv80]It Takes a Village

95.completion: It is an honor to be in your presence. We owe you our eternal gratitude.
95.details: By the power of Zeus, a hero stands before me. I know you must be very busy, but could you help us get rid of the Red Deer nearby? They are driving my villagers to the brink of madness!
95.objectives: Get rid of the Red Deer from Argolis, then talk to the Village Head in Nemea
95.title: [Lv82]The People's Champion

96.completion: Well done! I see our troops have kept you busy!
96.details: I don't mean to sound ungrateful, but something continues to keep my villagers from returning home. Could you please report this crisis to Pelagias?
96.title: [Lv85]Report to the Council

97.completion: I am so relieved now that you returned!
97.details: I spoke with the Priest Diotima. He believes the root of the problem lies in the Skeleton Mages. I know that I can count on you to eliminate them. Please keep the Village Head informed on your progress.
97.objectives: Fight the Skeleton Mages along the Argolis Coast, then speak to the Village Head in Nemea.
97.title: [Lv87]Council's Orders

98.completion: The Village Head's concerns are valid. I shall think more on this.
98.details: No, no, no. It cannot be that easy. My village will not be safe until all intruders are gone! Please, you must tell Antilochos that I need more help!
98.title: [Lv89]Mr. Inconsolable

99.completion: Greetings. I have heard much of your good deeds.
99.details: Very well. I know what we can do to solve this problem. Deliver this letter to Philoctetes in Nemea. He will have a solution. May the Gods protect you!
99.title: [Lv90]Philocteres, the Mighty!

100.completion: Well done. We are extremely proud of you. Your name will echo throughout the ages!
100.details: There have been reports of Deigo Pirates hiding out in Derveni. Eliminate them and remember, you're defending more than just a village today - you are defending all of Sparta!
100.objectives: Defeat the Deigo Pirates in Derveni, then talk to Philoctetes in Nemea.
100.title: [Lv91]The Final Defense

101.details: Did Asteriou ask you to get rid of those Little Snakes in the Suburbs of Sparta? You'd better get to it.
101.objectives: Get rid of the Little Snakes in the Suburbs of Sparta, then talk to Achilles in Sparta.
101.title: [Lv200]Lil Snakes, Big Problems

102.completion: Outstanding! You have earned my respect!
102.details: There are so many crazy Boas in Peloponnesus. They frequently attack passersby. I hope you can get rid of them for us.
102.objectives: Get rid of enough Boas from Peloponnesus, then talk to Achilles in Sparta.
102.title: [Lv200]Bad to the Boa

103.completion: You are the greastest hunter in all of Greece!
103.details: A squad of Amazon Scouts in Nemea want nothing more than to cause chaos wherever they go. We are too shorthanded to deal with them properly. Teach them a lesson.
103.objectives: Get rid of the Amazon Scouts in Nemea, then talk to Achilles in Sparta.
103.title: [Lv200]Amazon Combat

104.completion: Well, looks like you're quite the master after all.
104.details: Those Red Deer are so annoying. Now that you have finished working for Achilles', I believe you can help us drive them away.
104.objectives: Kill enough Red Deer in Argolis, then talk to Acacia in the Sparta Newbie Village.
104.title: [Lv80]Dawn of the Deer

105.completion: Aha! Sparta is safe again! Well done.
105.details: Several Deigo Pirates are hiding in Derveni and are planning to attack Sparta. It's time to reveal their plot. Please go kill them.
105.objectives: Kill enough Deigo Pirates in Derveni, then talk to Acacia in the Sparta Newbie Village.
105.title: [Lv90]Bloody Pirates

106.completion: Well done, my friend. You are quite the hero indeed.
106.details: There are a lot of Persian Missionaries hiding in Derveni. We should get the jump on them before they act on their evil plans. Please go to Derveni and kill them.
106.objectives: Eliminate the Persian Missionaries from Derveni, then speak with Acacia in the Sparta Newbie Village.
106.title: [Lv100]On a Mission from Allah

107.completion: Hello. What can I do you for?
107.details: I heard that a gold mine has been found. I am an explorer and I would like to know more about it. Can you help me ask Amvrosiou about it?
107.title: [Lv20]Gold Mine 1

108.completion: Oh, would you like to know more about the treasure?
108.details: Yes. We have sent someone to investigate it. You should go to find Muropis in the Peloponnesus.
108.objectives: Talk to Muropis in the Peloponnesus.
108.title: [Lv22]Gold Mine 2

109.completion: Well done. However, I will take the treasure map. You can obtain other rewards.
109.details: Oh, no. How did you know that I would like to find it? Ok, you have to kill all of those Evil Wizards.
109.objectives: Get rid of enough Evil Wizards and take the map back. Then talk to Muropis in the Peloponnesus.
109.title: [Lv40]Gold Mine 3

110.completion: Ah, safe at last! Thank you.
110.details: Help! I was ambushed by the Forest Wizards. Avenge me!
110.objectives: Defeat the Forest Wizards, then talk to the Wounded Guard in Nemea.
110.title: [Lv50]The Wounded Guard 1

111.completion: What's the matter? What? Is he alright?
111.details: Please tell my Captain to send help.
111.objectives: Talk to the Captain in Nemea.
111.title: [Lv60]The Wounded Guard 2

112.completion: Well what do you know. You're much stronger than I was at your age.
112.details: I need you to fill in for the Wounded Guard. Some Amazon Warriors have been spotted along the Megara Coast. Legend has it these wild women perform human sacrifices! I hope that's not true. Please chase them off.
112.objectives: Clear the Amazon Warriors from Argolis and then talk to the Captain in Nemea.
112.title: [Lv75]The Wounded Guard 3

113.details: Hello, can you do me a favor? It is said that there is a Lyre in Greece that can grant immortality to whoever plays it. Can you find it for me? Hyacinthus should know something about it.
113.title: [Lv100]Lyre's Legend 1

114.completion: Are you here because of the Lyre legend?
114.details: Yes, it exists. It's called Apollo's Lyre, but obtaining it is no easy task! If you truly wish to know more, go to Nemea and speak with Phoenix. He will tell you more about it.
114.title: [Lv101]Lyre's Legend 2

115.completion: There. I've strung the shell with the finest gutstring. Let's give it a play, shall we. *TWANG* That sounded terrible! Well, perhaps they'll grant you immortality through song.
115.details: Legend tells us Apollo's Lyre was fashioned from the shell of a Scary Turtle. These are not docile creatures and they don't take kindly to outsiders. Fetch one of their shells and you'll have your lyre frame.
115.objectives: Collect a Magic Turtle Shell from the Scary Turtles on the Isthmus of Corinth, then talk to Phoenix in Nemea.
115.title: [Lv99]Lyre's Legend 3

116.completion: You sure showed him. Excellent work.
116.details: Greetings, warrior. You may not know of me, but I am Helen, and I watch over these lands. Gordon, the Brute, has hurt many civilians. End his reign of terror.
116.objectives: Defeat [BOSS] Gordon in the Suburb of Sparta, then talk to Helen in Sparta.
116.title: [Lv200]Gordon, the Brute

117.completion: Excellent work. You deserve every bit of your reward.
117.details: Your valor is greatly admirable and I have another bounty available if you're interested. The Boas in Peloponnesus have become incredibly aggressive. I need you to reduce their numbers.
117.objectives: Get rid of the Boas from Peloponessus, then talk to Helen in Sparta.
117.title: [Lv200]Constricting Menace

118.completion: Your courage continues to amaze me.
118.details: Your valor is greatly admirable, and I have another bounty available if you're interested. Recently, the Astrien has been raging uncontrollably through Nemea. Put him in his place and you'll be handsomely rewarded.
118.objectives: Defeat the [BOSS] Astrien in Nemea, then talk to Helen in Sparta.
118.title: [Lv56]Bounty Hunter: the Astrien

119.completion: Terrific. You freed the minds of many villagers. The rest will follow.
119.details: Your valor is greatly admirable, and I have another bounty available if you're interested. A cult of Death Servants is hexing civilians in Argolis and controlling the weak-minded for their evil biddings. Slay them and release the innocent citizens!
119.objectives: Defeat the Death Servants in Argolis, then talk to Helen in Sparta.
119.title: [Lv70]Cult of Death Servants

120.completion: You would do well as a member of our national security.
120.details: Your valor is greatly admirable, and I have another bounty available if you're interested. The unruly Robber Kelin in Argolis are attacking the locals. I know you can get rid of them. Come back when you're finished to collect the bounty.
120.objectives: Disperse the Robber Kelin in Argolis, then talk to Helen in Sparta.
120.title: [Lv72]Robber Round-up

121.completion: Those wild horsemen couldn't drag you away!
121.details: Your valor is greatly admirable, and I have another bounty available if you're interested. A pack of lumbering Centaur Warriors in Derveni are causing trouble for the local guardsmen. Keep on your toes and chase them back where they belong!
121.objectives: Chase back the bloodthirsthy Centaur Warriors from Derveni, then talk to Helen in Sparta.
121.title: [Lv90]Raging Centaurs

122.completion: Yee-hah! The Hailer has been rounded up for good. Excellent work.
122.details: Your valor is greatly admirable, and I have one last bounty for you. The Centaur Shaikh Hailer is pillaging the residents of Derveni. There is no better candidate to rid us of this menace than you.
122.objectives: Defeat the Centaur Sheikh Hailer in Derveni, then talk to Helen in Sparta.
122.title: [Lv100]Centaur Shaikh Hailer

123.completion: Great! It is a gift for you.
123.details: You are now level 10. I believe that you have some basic knowledge of the game now. Take my recommendation and find Neo. He can guide you further into game.
123.title: [Lv12]Hero's Skill 1

124.completion: Great! It is a gift for you.
124.details: Congratulations. You have leveled up. Go to find Neo and claim your rewards.
124.title: [Lv30]Hero's Skill 2

125.completion: Great! It is a gift for you.
125.details: We hope Sparta can be peaceful and free forever. Kid, go to find Neo. He is waiting for you.
125.title: [Lv50]Hero's Skill 3

126.completion: Great! It is a gift for you.
126.details: Leveling up is like no other feeling. Know yourself. Neo is waiting for you.
126.title: [Lv70]Hero's Skill 4

127.completion: Great! It is a gift for you.
127.details: Are you ready? You can claim a Spell Book from Neo now.
127.title: [Lv90]Hero's Skill 5

128.completion: You can choose one from the following items. But be careful. Choose wisely...
128.details: Congratulations. You have shown yourself to be an outstanding warrior. Come to find me when you are ready.
128.title: [Lv40]Warrior Guide

129.completion: Great! It is a gift for you.
129.details: You are now level 10. I believe that you have some basic knowledge of the game now. Take my recommendation and find Patroklos. He can guide you further into game.
129.objectives: Talk to the Warrior Supplier Patroklos in Sparta.
129.title: [Lv12]Sadhu's Skill 1

130.completion: Great! It is a gift for you.
130.details: Congratulations. You have leveled up. Go to find Patroklos and claim your rewards.
130.objectives: Talk to the Warrior Supplier Patroklos in Sparta.
130.title: [Lv30]Sadhu's Skill 2

131.completion: Great! It is a gift for you.
131.details: We hope Sparta can be peaceful and free forever. Kid, go to find Patroklos. He is waiting for you.
131.objectives: Talk to the Warrior Supplier Patroklos in Sparta.
131.title: [Lv50]Sadhu's Skill 3

132.completion: Great! It is a gift for you.
132.details: Leveling up is like no other feeling. Know yourself. Patroklos is waiting for you.
132.objectives: Talk to the Warrior Supplier Patroklos in Sparta.
132.title: [Lv70]Sadhu's Skill 4

133.completion: Great! It is a gift for you.
133.details: Are you ready? You can claim a Spell Book from Patroklos now.
133.objectives: Talk to the Warrior Supplier Patroklos in Sparta.
133.title: [Lv90]Sadhu's Skill 5

134.completion: You can choose one from the following items. But be careful. Choose wisely...
134.details: Congratulations. You have shown yourself to be an outstanding warrior. Come to find me when you are ready.
134.objectives: Talk to the Warrior Supplier Patroklos in Sparta.
134.title: [Lv40]The Sage Guide 1

135.completion: Hello, I am a Spartan priest. I am in charge of assigning Gods and worshippers. You can choose one from among the 14 Gods. Different Gods can help you in different ways. In addition, you can learn corresponding skills.
135.details: Have you ever been on a pilgrimage to the temples?  That is where the Gods' statues are. Go to find Diotima and she will give you more information about these fascinating places.
135.objectives: Talk to Priest Diotima in Sparta.
135.title: [Lv12]The Faith 1

136.completion: Well done. May the Gods bless you! Come back to find Atalanta once you have reached level 30.
136.details: At present, Ares is the patron and protector of Sparta. In order to make sacrifices to her, we need more offerings. Can you go to catch several Ferocious Wolves, from outside the city?
136.objectives: Get rid of enough Ferocious Wolves near the suburbs of Sparta and then talk to the Priest Diotima in Sparta.
136.title: [Lv16]The Faith 2

137.details: Hello. Do you have a favorite God? Do you know how to use their corresponding skills?
137.title: [Lv30]The Faith 3

138.details: Hello. Diotima asked me to prepare an offering for the sacrifice. Can you go to kill Dark Wizard and bring me his Holy Wand?
138.objectives: Kill  Dark Wizard in Peloponnesus. Take his holy wand back and talk to Atalanta
138.title: [Lv40]Sacrifice

139.completion: Hello, weary pilgrim. I hope this journey has been enlightening for you.
139.details: Say, have you ever completed the pilgrimage to Argolis? If you are so inclined, walk the path of Ares and meet with Eurumedon in Argolis.
139.title: [Lv60]Pilgrimage to the Coast

140.details: Ah! It must be good to be so young. I would have liked to travel everywhere in my youth. Of course that was a very long time ago. Are you busy now? I have many letters that need to be delivered to Sparta. Please help me deliver this letter to Odysseus.
140.objectives: Talk to Odysseus in the suburbs of Sparta.
140.title: [Lv12]Sparta 1

141.details: Humans need to work. Take it easy. Don't be nervous! Click confirm to accept my quest. Go to catch some Huge Skeletons in Peloponnesus.
141.objectives: Clear those Bad Huge Skeletons from Peloponnesus and then talk to Odysseus in the suburb of Sparta.
141.title: [Lv40]Sparta 2

142.completion: What's this? A letter from Odysseus? How thoughtful of him.
142.details: Say, do you have some time to spare? My dear friend Philoctetes has been sent to guard Nemea. Would you please deliver this letter to him?
142.title: [Lv52]A Letter for the Master

143.completion: With those Skeleton Mages gone, our battle against the Athenians will be much easier.
143.details: I need your help, friend. The General has sent word that there are several Skeleton Mages amassing along the Argolis Coast. I need you to kill them before the Athenian army takes advantage of a bad situation.
143.objectives: Defeat 80 Skeleton Mages in Argolis and then talk to Odysseus in the Sparta Starting Area.
143.title: [Lv80]To Protect and Sever

144.completion: Ha ha! Well done! That will teach these greedy pigs not to double-cross anyone ever again.
144.details: I may be skilled on the sea but I am just as skilled with a sword. Will you fight alongside me? There are several Jaba Astrologists in the Isthmus of Corinth. Their thirst for wealth leaves no space for morality in their hearts. We must chase them out!
144.objectives: Clear the Jaba Astrologists from the Isthmus of Corinth and then talk to Odysseus in the Starting Area of Sparta.
144.title: [Lv100]Battle with a Traveler

145.completion: Excellent work! This will help keep our army strong.
145.details: I'm in charge of supplying the Spartan Army, but our supplies are dwindling. I would be much obliged if you can bring me the pelts of some Boas.
145.objectives: Collect 12 Boa pelts in Peloponnesus, then talk to Ion in the Spartan Starting Area.
145.title: [Lv200]Not So Fashionable Boas

146.completion: Excellent work! This will help keep our army strong.
146.details: Our army is preparing for war, but defense supplies are low. I need 12 lion tails from the Wild Lions to build stronger bandoliers. Can you handle that?
146.objectives: Collect 12 tails from the Wild Lions in Nemea, then talk to Ion in the Sparta Main City.
146.title: [Lv49]Supply Drives: An Epic Tail

147.completion: Excellent work! This will help keep our army strong.
147.details: Yes, you would be perfect for this next task. We need 12 jewels from the necklaces of the Amazon Warriors. They will make excellent shot weapons.
147.objectives: Collect 12 jewels from the Amazon Warriors in Argolis, then talk to Ion in the Sparta Main City.
147.title: [Lv81]Jewels of the Amazon

148.details: The Centaur Warriors of Derveni have stolen our Sagittarius Weapons! Be careful when you try to get them back.
148.objectives: Collect the Sagittarius Weapons from the Centaur Warriors of Derveni, then return to Pelagias in Sparta.
148.title: [Lv96]Horseman's Longbow

149.completion: Could it be..? I have dreamt of this for so long...
149.details: I am in search of a Persian Rug, but they are very rare. The only people who seem to have some are the Milier Guardsmen in the Isthmus of Corinth. I must have one.
149.objectives: Collect Persian Rugs from the Milier Guardsmen in the Isthmus of Corinth, then talk to Pelagias in Sparta.
149.title: [Lv105]Pulling the Rug Out

150.completion: Thanks so much. You're a swifter messenger than Hermes himself.
150.details: A postman's life is not as easy as it seems. In fact, I'm running quite behind! Please take this letter to the Postman in Argolis. Chop chop!
150.objectives: Talk to the Postman in Argolis.
150.title: [Lv50]Express Delivery

151.completion: Thanks a lot. This will do great.
151.details: Hiya! Could you do me a favor? I need some fresh wood to conduct some experiments. Perhaps you could collect it from the Wood Men near the Sparta Starting Area.
151.objectives: Clear the Wood Men, then talk to Ianeira in the Sparta Starting Area.
151.title: [Lv2]The Lumberjack

152.completion: Wow, this is wonderful. Thank you so much.
152.details: Could you do me another favor? I'm trying to discover the secret of the Wooden Puppets reanimation powers. Can you capture a few for me?
152.objectives: Fight the Wooden Puppets in the Sparta Starting Area, then talk to [Scholar]Ianeira.
152.title: [Lv4]High Strung Scoundrels

153.completion: Wow, you have finished it so quickly.
153.details: Hey, I heard that you are a real go-getter. Help me get gems from the many Empusa's Boxes in the suburbs. Pick up those big ones.
153.objectives: Fight the Empusa's Boxes, collect the Gems and then talk to Daidalos in Sparta.
153.title: [Lv10]Gem Collection

154.completion: That should calm things down a bit.
154.details: I've heard reports of several Snakes attacking local citizens  in the Suburbs. Can you help me get rid of them?
154.objectives: Kill some Snakes in the Suburbs of Sparta, then report to the [Round Quest]Main City Issuer.
154.title: [Lv200]Snake Snake Snake

155.completion: You will be a skilled snake-killer someday.
155.details: There are many Vipers hidden among the tall grass in the suburbs. Can you help me kill them all. I will give you some big rewards.
155.objectives: Help Patroklos to eliminate the Vipers and then report to the [Round Quest]Main City Issuer in Sparta.
155.title: [Lv21]Snake Hunter 2

156.completion: That's awesome. You really are great.
156.details: The Boas are a dangerous enemy in Peloponnesus. Patroklos told me that you are good at trapping snakes. Go to kill all of the Boas for me.
156.objectives: Help Iakovou to kill some Boas, then report to the [Round Quest]Peloponnesus Issuer.
156.title: [Lv31]Snake Hunter 3

157.completion: I used to be as swift as you are.
157.details: Hi, the Evil Wizard's Magic Powder can be used to make medicine. Can you help me to collect some. Evil Wizards are found on the plain. Just be careful.
157.objectives: Fight the Evil Wizards, collect Magic Powder and then talk to Aithra in Peloponnesus.
157.title: [Lv38]Drug Stuff

158.details: Can you help me get rid of the Plains Wolves in the area? Yipes!
158.objectives: Fight the Plain Wolves in Nemea, then talk to Tuchios.
158.title: [Lv46]Crying Wolf

159.completion: Ha ha! Excellent. The villagers have been released.
159.details: Alright, soldier. I need you to wipe out the Wizards just outside the village and put an end to their evil spells!
159.objectives: Fight the Wizards in Nemea, then talk to Eumaeus.
159.title: [Lv50]The Dark: Wizard's Duel

160.completion: You never cease to amaze me. Please take this for all your hard work.
160.details: There have been reports from Nemea of a group of Amazon Scouts sneaking through our lands. Drive them away and I will offer you a great reward.
160.objectives: Fight the Amazon Scouts in Nemea, then talk to Eumaeus.
160.title: [Lv54]The Dark: Wild Explorers

171.details: Greetings, my name is Phaedrus. I am just a humble bard, but my heart beats boldly for Sparta. If you are interested in serving Ares, perhaps I can offer you some work as a spy. You shall take my disguise and speak to Pylades in Megara. He will provide you with much help. But be wary of those around you. The Athenians number in the thousands. I will speak with you soon... assuming you survive of course. May Hermes lend his speed to yours!

217.completion: Yones is gone! Thank you so much. He and Valkyr drove my sister Thalia to madness. Please find her.
217.details: To become a hero, you must protect Greece from those who wreak havoc on our lands. In a strange way, you're in luck. There happens to be three warlords trying to overthrow the rulers of Greece: Dark Spirit Yones, Valkyr the Living Devil, and Leader Cassirer, the Beast Master. Defeating them will aid you on your quest to become the next great hero of Greece. The Dark Spirit Yones is currently nearby slaying the innocent and gathering their souls for his dark army. Defeat him and move one step closer to completing your trials. After you have killed him, find Annis in Peloponnesus. She will guide you to the next warlord.
217.objectives: Defeat Dark Spirit Yones, then meet with Annis in Peloponnesus.
217.title: [Lv75]3 Warlords: Soulless

218.completion: Oh my poor sister Thalia. As her only caretaker for over a decade, I've tried my hardest to protect her. Twelve years ago, our father went to search for a legendary holy weapon. Only recently did he return. The night after his return, Thalia followed a white sheep deep into the forest. Despite how weak he was from his travels, my father ran out to look for her. He never returned. The next day, Circe was seen wandering near our front gate. She was only a shell of herself. From what we can understand, Valkyr and Yones attacked her in the night. Our father was able to rescue her... but at the cost of his own life.
218.details: No! Please stay away from me! I don't want to die! Guards, help me! Valkyr is going to kill me!
218.title: [Lv75]Hero's Trial 2

219.completion: Thank goodness you've come back safely!

220.completion: Thank you for all you have done for my family. The Living Devil will be punished for all eternity in the fires of Tartarus.

221.completion: The three warlords are gone forever, banished to the Underworld where they will suffer eternally for their crimes against Greece. Likewise, I will be eternally grateful to you, my brave hero.
221.details: I don't think I'll ever be able to thank you enough. These warlords have harrassed my family ever since father returned with the lost holy weapon. Leader Cassirer, the Beast Master, has constantly tried to steal it from us. He is a master of deception. Each time he came to our door, he was shaped like a different creature. The last time Cassirer threatened us, he swore that if my father did not give up the weapon it would cost him his most valued possesion. Now I know he meant Thalia. He disguised himself has the sheep the night of my father's death and lead both Thalia and my father to their doom. Please end my family's torture once and for all.
221.objectives: Defeat the Beast Master Leader Cassirer, then return to Annis.
221.title: [Lv95]3 Warlords: Beast Master

222.completion: Now you understand the true meaning of a hero. While strength and skill will guard you on the battlefield, it is your heart that guides your actions. 246.objectives: Defeat the Skeleton Mages along the Argolis Coast.
246.title: [Lv92]Grave Danger

247.completion: Well done! Please accept your rewards.
247.details: The Deigo Pirates are pillaging homes in Derveni. They're climbing through windows and snatching our people up. Stop them before their rampage becomes a full riot.
247.objectives: Chase off the Deigo Pirates in Derveni.
247.title: [Lv96]Bloodthirsty Pirates

248.completion: Excellent. With these maps I can plan our next attack.
248.details: I need you to deliver these maps to Asteriou in Sparta. They're battlefield layouts for our troops stationed along the Argolis Coast. Please deliver them safely.
248.objectives: Deliver the battlefield report to Asteriou in the Main City of Sparta.
248.title: [Lv70]Report from the Front

249.title: [Lv25]Conscious Wolf

250.title: [Lv45]True Skeleton

251.title: [Lv55]Monster Hunt: The Wizards

253.title: [Lv75]Wicked Servants

254.title: [Lv81]Deadly Threat

255.completion: Excellent work. You're quite the hunter!
255.details: This scroll lists all of the monsters to be destroyed in the annual Geat Monster Hunt. The next on this list are the Giant Boas. There's a pod of them in Derveni.

255.title: [Lv91]Ghastly Boas

256.completion: Success! The Great Monster Hunt is over! Thank you for your assistance.
256.details: The annual Great Monster Hunt is almost at a close. This scroll lists all of the monsters to be destroyed, the last of which are the Centaur Warriors. There's a clan of them nearby.
256.objectives: Defeat the Centaur Warriors, then report to Menesthes in Argolis.
256.title: [Lv101]Execute the Plan

257.completion: Great job, kid. You earned this.
257.details: The Persian Missionaries defied the Gods. They promised to use their knowledge for the good of the world but instead their Emporer poses as a living god. They have grown greedier than ever and are looting supplies from our troops in Derveni. Show them the cost of their treachery!
257.objectives: Defeat the Persian Missionaries in Derveni, then speak with the Achaeans Soldier to claim your reward.
257.title: [Lv111]Wicked Mission

258.completion: Great job, kid. You earned this.
258.details: Our men in Derveni were attacked. They claim the assailants moved more swiftly than air. The only possible culprits are the Harpies. Urgh, those wild halflings don't know who they messed with.
258.objectives: Defeat the Harpies in Derveni, then speak with the Achaeans Soldier.
258.title: [Lv116]Blustery Ambush

259.completion: I have been looking everywhere for this book! Thank you very much. Here, let me offer you something for your troubles.
259.details: Excuse me, could I ask a favor of you? My friend Jason is a great fan of our nation's history. Would you be willing to take him this book for his collection?
259.objectives: Deliver the Spartan History book to Jason in the Main City of Sparta.
259.title: [Lv20]Spartan History

260.completion: Thank you for your work, good citizen. Please accept this reward on our behalf.
260.details: I've grown sick and tired of dealing with the Evil Wizards. I've issued a warrant for their arrest. Do the right thing and bring them to justice.
260.objectives: Arrest the Evil Wizards in Peloponnesus.
260.title: [Lv40]Law & Order

261.completion: Thank you for your work, good citizen. Please accept this reward on our behalf.
261.details: The Huge Frogs have finally gotten out of hand. I'm declaring an open hunt of the beasts until I feel it is safe for the residents in Nemea.
261.objectives: Destroy the Huge Frogs in Nemea.
261.title: [Lv60]A Wicked Tongue

262.completion: Thank you for your work, good citizen. Please accept this reward on our behalf.
262.details: I'm afraid I underestimated the breeding potential of the Magic Tortoises. They are a terrible threat. Head to Argolis and destroy them.
262.objectives: Destroy the Magic Tortoises in Argolis.
262.title: [Lv80]Tyrannical Tortoises

263.completion: Thank you for your work, good citizen. Please accept this reward on our behalf.
263.details: The Centaur Warriors are invading Derveni. The time has come to end this struggle once and for all!
263.objectives: Defeat the invading Centaur Warriors in Derveni.
263.title: [Lv100]Centaurian Invasion

275.completion: Who dares speak to Zeus? Oh, it is you, the brave adventurer who has vowed to find my beloved Europa. Take this clue. May it help you find her and bring her back to me quickly!
275.details: In a fit of jealous rage, Zeus' wife Hera trapped her husband’s lover Europa in the Cyclades islands. Desperate to reunite with his forbidden love, Zeus vows to lavish, godly rewards upon any adventurer who rescues the fair Europa. But first you must find Zeus and speak with him personally.
275.title: [Lv50]The Family Feud

286.title: [Lv80]General's Award 11

291.completion: So, how do you like the gifts?
291.details: Beautiful Sicily has gone to hell, damned Hades! In order to purify and rebuild my beloved Sicily, we must destroy the inhuman monsters that have taken up residence there. The 'Event Transporter' in the main city can teleport you to Sicily. When you've arrived, hit the "Search" button and then find the Quest Envoy. This envoy will help you find the monsters' hiding places quickly.
291.objectives: Go to Sicily and kill 100 Gela Hunters and then report to the Sicilian Refugee. (The Event Transporter will help you get to Sicily)
291.title: [Lv25]Sage's Gift 5

292.completion: Thank you for ridding Sicily of those annoying elves. Please take these rewards as a humble symbol of our gratitude.
292.details: Hades has unleashed an army of inhuman monsters onto nearby Sicily. It’s now infested with hordes of wicked elves! Slay 100 of them to begin restoring this once beautiful island to its rightful splendor. Transporting there is easy; simply speak to the 'Event Transporter' in the main city. Once in Sicily, hit the “Search” button to find the Quest Envoy. They know exactly where the Sicilian Elves are hiding. Good luck!
292.objectives: Go to Sicily via the Event Transporter. Once there, kill 100 Sicilian Elves, then report to the Sicilian Refugee.
292.title: [Lv25]Purify Sicily: The Elves

293.completion: You’ve killed the wolves! Such bravery will always be remembered in Sicily. Please accept these rewards. It's the least I can do.
293.details: The elves are finally gone! Unfortunately, they have been replaced with packs of ravenous Numb Wolves. Kill 100 of these cruel creatures and every Sicilian will be forever grateful. The Quest Envoy knows exactly where they are hiding. May the Gods be with you!
293.objectives: Go to Sicily via the Event Transporter. Once there, kill 100 Numb Wolves, then report to the Sicilian Refugee.
293.title: [Lv45]Purify Sicily: The Wolves

294.completion: Those creepy puppets are gone! Songs of your selfless deeds will be sung by children for generations! On behalf of every Sicilian, I present you with these rewards.
294.details: Life in Sicily is much better without those Numb Wolves roaming around, but now legions of Ruthless Puppets have appeared. They scare the children and ruin the peace! Kill 100 of these maniacal marionettes and you will be handsomely rewarded. May the wind always be at your back!
294.objectives: Go to Sicily via the Event Transporter. Once there, kill 100 Ruthless Puppets, then report to the Sicilian Refugee.
294.title: [Lv65]Purify Sicily: Puppets

295.completion: Yay! With those deadly Blaze Vipers gone, life in Sicily can finally begin to return to normal. We thank you with these lavish rewards.
295.details: Thanks to you, our island is free of those horrible puppets! However it’s hard to celebrate with so many Blaze Vipers around. Destroy 100 of these slithery serpents and we will be that much closer to driving Hades and his minions out of our island forever. For help finding these monsters, talk to the Quest Envoy. God's speed!
295.objectives: Go to Sicily via the Event Transporter. Once there, kill 100 Blaze Vipers, then report to the Sicilian Refugee.
295.title: [Lv81]Purify Sicily: The Vipers

296.completion: Now that those Ice Wraiths are gone, the weather is warming up again. You are truly Sicily’s hero and we insist on rewarding your service with these gifts.
296.details: As if those vipers weren’t scary enough, now we’re faced with a scourge of Ice Wraiths! Hades must be getting desperate to send such wretched filth to our fair island. Annihilate 100 of these frozen freaks and all of Sicily will be forever in your debt. As usual, the Quest Envoy has offered to help you find the wraiths. Be careful!
296.objectives: Go to Sicily via the Event Transporter. Once there, kill 100 Ice Wraiths, then report to the Sicilian Refugee.
296.title: [Lv91]Purify Sicily: Wraiths

297.completion: I thought those Gela Guards would never be defeated. Thankfully, you proved me wrong. In honor of your strength and bravery, we present you with these fine Sicilian gifts.
297.details: Those ugly things walking around the countryside are Gela Guards. They bully us Sicilians and wreak havoc wherever they go. Defeat 100 of these goons to win our gratitude and a few gifts. If you have trouble finding them, the Quest Envoy knows exactly where they hide.
297.objectives: Go to Sicily via the Event Transporter. Once there, kill 100 Gela Guards, then report to the Sicilian Refugee.
297.title: [Lv101]Purify Sicily: The Guards

298.completion: Glory be upon you! You have defeated Hades and Sicily is once again free from His curse. To thank you, we have prepared the finest gifts that all of Sicily has to offer. Accept them with pride!
298.details: Your bravery has angered Hades, who has now sent some of his deadliest monsters to fight you. The dreaded Gela Hunter is both smart and lethal. Send 100 of them back to the Underworld God and forever rid Sicily of his wretched curse. Stay strong and victory will be yours!
298.objectives: Go to Sicily via the Event Transporter. Once there, kill 100 Gela Hunters, then report to the Sicilian Refugee.
298.title: [Lv111]Purify Sicily: Hunters

299.completion: So, how do you like the gifts?
299.details: You have grown into a hero. The wise sage asked me to give you some gifts.
299.objectives: When you reach Level 35, talk to the Gift Envoy and claim the sage's gifts, they will enlarge your bag.
299.title: [Lv30]Sage's Gift 6

300.completion: With those Forest Warriors gone, business in Nemea has returned to normal. You have earned this reward.
300.details: Nemea is overrun with Forest Warriors. This is bad for local businesses. The merchants are offering a reward to anyone who can kill 50 or more of these wicked women.
300.objectives: Slay 50 Forest Warriors in Nemea, then report to Ion in the Newbie Village.
300.title: [Lv67]The Wicked Women

302.completion: I am the Pet Master. My pets are some of the fanciest in all of Greece. Take this egg and your pet will hatch from it!
302.details: The Pet Master came to the village recently and offered to give away her fancy pets. If you want an animal companion, you must find her quickly before the pets are all gone!
302.objectives: Claim a pet from the Pet Master in the Newbie Village.
302.title: [Lv200]First Fuzzy Friend

303.completion: Your baby pet looks hungry. Feed it now and don’t miss any more meal times!
303.details: Baby pets need more than love. They need food too! The only person I know with baby pet food is the Newbie Guide. Ask him nicely and he may give you some.
303.objectives: Claim pet food from the Newbie Guide in the Newbie Village.
303.title: [Lv200]Hungry Baby Pet

304.completion: You are quite the Snake killer! For ridding the Starting Area of those repulsive reptiles, I gladly present you with this reward.
304.details: Welcome to the Starting Area of the Main City. It’s usually a very pleasant place but we’ve recently been invaded by Snakes. They bite at everyone, even the children! If you can kill at least 30 of them, we would all be very grateful!
304.objectives: Kill 30 Snakes in the Starting Area of Sparta.
304.title: [Lv200]Snake Attack!

305.completion: So, how do you like the gifts?
305.details: You have grown into a hero. The wise sage asked me to give you some gifts.
305.objectives: When you reach Level 40, talk to the Gift Envoy and claim the sage's gifts, they will enlarge your bag.
305.title: [Lv35]Sage's Gift 7

306.completion: Glory be upon you! You have defeated Hades and Sicily is once again free from His curse. To thank you, we have prepared the finest gifts that all of Sicily has to offer. Accept them with pride!
306.details: Your bravery has angered Hades, who has now sent some of his deadliest monsters to fight you. The dreaded Gela Hunter is both smart and lethal. Send 100 of them back to the Underworld God, and forever rid Sicily of his wretched curse. The Quest Envoy has offered to help you find the hunters, should you need their assistant. Stay strong and victory will be yours!
306.objectives: Go to Sicily via the Event Transporter. Once there, kill 100 Gela Hunters, then report to the Sicilian Refugee.
306.title: [Lv121]Purify Sicily: Hunters

307.completion: The Persian army will think twice before sending their Vanguards to our country again. Please accept this reward as a token of our gratitude.
307.details: Enemies from the east have attacked Derveni. They assault the citizens and pillage their homes. Sparta needs you to drive these Persian Vanguards back from whence they came!
307.objectives: Destroy the Persian Vanguards in Derveni, then report to the Tiryns Elder.
307.title: [Lv105]Derveni Under Siege

308.completion: Generations of great soldiers have trained by fighting with those Ancient Crocodiles. Now you follow that tradition. Here is your reward for a job well done!
308.details: Our spies inform us that Persian Scouts are preparing to invade Derveni! You are not ready to face them yet. Kill 100 Ancient Crocodiles and report back to me.
308.objectives: Kill 100 Ancient Crocodiles in Derveni, then report back to the Tiryns Elder.
308.title: [Lv110]Prepare for War!

309.completion: You’ve done it! Those Persian Missionaries are dead! In the name of our fallen leader, I present to you these useful rewards.
309.details: I was once a soldier in a proud army but that all changed when we lost our leader to the Persian Missionaries. Since then, we have drifted far from our former glory. You can make things right. Defeat the Persian Missionaries and we can once again march through this country with our heads held high!
309.objectives: Defeat the Persian Missionaries in Derveni, then report to the Achaeans Soldier.
309.title: [Lv105]A Broken Army

310.completion: I am pleased to hear the Harpies are gone from Derveni. You have earned our thanks as well as these valuable rewards.
310.details: Harpies have raided Derveni. They are tricky creatures and often smell like burnt cheese. Worst of all, they harass our soldiers and make life difficult for everyone. Only you can drive them away!
310.objectives: Kill the Harpies in Derveni and then report to the Achaeans Soldier.
310.title: [Lv110]Hellish Harpies

311.completion: My warrior, I have been waiting for you for some time.
311.details: War is just around the corner, with various guilds beginning to get involved. Find the Retired Wizard in the main city first and he will tell you the details.
311.objectives: Find the Retired Wizard in the city of Sparta and then he will tell you what you should do.
311.title: [Lv21]Ship Materials

312.details: I was once a brave Spartan wizard. I've been living here in seclusion since I retired from the army. However, as a former Spartan soldier, I always pay attnetion  what's going on in the city. A battle is approaching, but we are still badly in need of supplies. Please find Simonos who is in the Starting Area of the main city and inquire him about that for me.
312.objectives: Find Simonos in the Starting Area of the main city and inquire him about supplies for the battlefront.
312.title: [Lv21]Retired Wizard

313.details: I am busy. What, he sent you here? Good, you seem to have his approval. Go to Peloponnesus and tell Muropis about this. He is in charge of the material allocation.
313.objectives: Simonos asks you to tell Muropis in Peloponnesus about this matter.
313.title: [Lv21]Simonos' Attitude

314.completion: Good, choose any material and send it to the War Supplier in the main city, in the suburbs or in Peloponnesus, and you will get different rewards for each.
314.details: Oh? He asked you to find me? It seems you are strong enough, I suppose. All right, you have my approval as well, go back to him. Remember, be polite!
314.objectives: Muropis asks you to report to the Retired Wizard in the city of Sparta.
314.title: [Lv21]Final Result

315.completion: You did it! Killing the Mutant Cruces was no small feat but you made it look easy. Thank you. Please accept this humble reward.
315.details: There are rumors that Persephone’s seal of the Underworld has been removed. This will summon the souls of the dead! Prophecies warn us the first monster will be the Mutant Cruces. Slay this evil beast and all Sicily will rejoice!
315.title: [Lv25]Sicilian Call(1)

316.completion: All of Sicily thanks you for killing Wicked Alex. Here is a reward for your heroic service.
316.details: The terror of the Mutant Cruces was only the beginning. I fear more souls are rising from the grave. The prophecy foretells the next monster will be Wicked Alex. Slay him and save Sicily from this wretched curse.
316.title: [Lv61]Wicked Alex This Way Comes

317.completion: Skeleton Captain Ixion is dead! Let the good news ring out for all to hear! Take this reward. You deserve nothing less.
317.details: With the death of Wicked Alex, there is but one more monster to defeat. Skeleton Captain Ixion is said to be the most dangerous of all cursed souls. Slay this foul spirit and Sicily will once again be free of evil!
317.title: [Lv101]The Deadly Captain Ixion

318.completion: So, how do you like the gifts?
318.details: For your heroic performance, the sage has asked me to give you this gift as a reward. Please accept it!
318.objectives: When you reach level 60, talk to the  Gift Envoy  and claim the gear awarded by the sage.
318.title: [Lv55]Sage's Gift 8

319.completion: I am pleased to hear the Harpies are gone from Derveni. You have earned our thanks as well as these valuable rewards.
319.details: Harpies have raided Derveni. They are tricky creatures and often smell like burnt cheese. Worst of all, they harass our soldiers and make life difficult for everyone. Only you can drive them away!
319.objectives: Kill the Harpies in Derveni and then report to the Achaeans Soldier.
319.title: [Lv110]Hellish Harpies

320.completion: Killing those Huge Spiders was no small feat. Peloponnesus is much better without them. Take this reward. You earned it!
320.details: I’ve heard you are a brave hero, but you have yet to pass the seven trials of magic. The first test pits you against hordes of Huge Spiders in Peloponnesus. Eliminate 100 of them, then find the Spartan Traveler. She will tell me if you succeeded or failed. Now off with you!
320.objectives: Eliminate 100 Huge Spiders in Peloponnesus, then report to the Spartan Traveler.
320.title: [Lv1]Magic Trial(1)

321.completion: Those skeletons have been running loose in the Sparta Suburbs for too long. Thank you for destroying them. Here is your reward.
321.details: You killed the huge spiders in Peloponnesus but that was only the first of seven tests. Next, you must travel to the Suburbs of Sparta and destroy the Skeletons that haunt the area. Once you have collected 10 of their skulls, take them to the Spartan Traveler. She will inform me of your progress. Be gone!
321.objectives: Collect 10 skulls from the Skeletons in the Suburbs of Sparta, then speak with the Spartan Traveler.
321.title: [Lv1]Magic Trial(2)

322.completion: Thanks to you, Nemea is free of those terrible Forest Warriors! And now, it’s reward time!
