322.details: I was certain those skeletons would stop you but your skills grow more impressive each day. The third trial of magic will not be so easy. Go to Nemea and kill 100 Forest Warriors. If you survive the ordeal, seek out the Spartan Traveler. She will again inform me of your success... or failure. Leave me now!
322.objectives: Defeat 100 Forest Warriors in Nemea, then talk to Spartan Traveler.
322.title: [Lv61]Magic Trial(3)

323.completion: Argolis has been terrorized by those Death Servants for too long. You did a good thing by killing them. Now take this reward. It’s the least I can do.
323.details: You are more than half way through the trials of magic. I’m beginning to believe the stories of your greatness. But this fourth trial is very difficult. Death Servants are invading Argolis. Slay them and collect 10 of their wands. Take the wands to the Spartan Traveler. She will know what to do. Now leave at once!
323.objectives: Collect 10 wands from the Death Servants in Argolis. Afterwards, talk to Spartan Traveler.
323.title: [Lv61]Magic Trial(4)

324.completion: I never met a Centaur Warrior I liked. Probably because those horsemen just creep me out. Good job taking so many out! Here’s your reward.
324.details: I see the Death Servants were no match for your strength. I hope for your sake the same is true in this fifth trial. Centaur Warriors roam the Derveni countryside. Kill 100 of them and inform the Spartan Traveler of your success. Why haven't you left yet?
324.objectives: Defeat 100 Centaur Warriors, then talk to Spartan Traveler.
324.title: [Lv91]Magic Trial(5)

325.completion: The Persian Missionaries think they're so smart. Now they don’t think at all... because they're dead! Hahaha! This reward is for you!
325.details: You may not look like a typical Centaur exterminator but one should never judge a hero by their looks! This sixth trial has bested challenger greater than you. Slay the Persian Missionaries in Derveni and collect 10 wands from them, then report to the Spartan Traveler. Go now!
325.objectives: Collect 10 wands from the Persian Missionaries, then talk to the Spartan Traveler.
325.title: [Lv91]Magic Trial(6)

326.completion: You made the Ferocious Wolf King howl like a little cub. Here is your final reward.
326.details: You have reached the final trial of magic. The previous trials were nothing compared to this one. You must travel to Nemea and kill the Ferocious Wolf King. If you survive, seek the Spartan Traveler. If you fail, I shall pray for your safe passage through the Underworld. Now leave already!
326.objectives: Kill the Ferocious Wolf King in Nemea, then find the Spartan Traveler.
326.title: [Lv1]Magic Trial(7)

327.completion: This honor is reserved for only the bravest Spartans and that certainly includes you. Well done!
327.details: Because of your courageous service to Sparta, the High Council has awarded you the title of Heroic Envoy. To claim this prestigious honor, visit the Senator in Sparta.
327.objectives: Speak with the Senator in Sparta.
327.title: [Lv1]Heroic Envoy

328.completion: You can now shift classes. Enjoy all the responsibilities and privileges this new class has to offer!
328.details: You have proven yourself to be a hero of the people and are now permitted to shift classes. I can make this happen if you’d like.
328.title: [Lv101]Class Shift

329.completion: You can now shift your equipment and open a new array of gear to explore. Congratulations!
329.details: A hero of your caliber deserves a change in equipment now and then. I can grant you a permit that shifts your equipment if you are interested.
329.title: [Lv101]Equipment Shift

330.completion: It will be a long time before any Bloodfly Wasps come back here looking for an easy score. Take this reward as our thanks!
330.details: A valuable shipment just arrived at the Nemean Forest. Officials fear Bloodfly Wasps are planning to steal it, and request that you clear them out.
330.objectives: Eliminate the Bloodfly Wasps in Nemea and then return to the [Round Quest]Forest Issuer.
330.title: [Lv80]Secure the Supplies

331.completion: The Nemean Forest is once again free of those annoying Acadians. Take this reward, you earned every bit of it!
331.details: Acadian Warriors have snuck into the Nemean Forest to cause trouble. Stop them!
331.objectives: Bust those Acadian Warriors in the Nemean Forest
331.title: [Lv91]Acadians Attack!

332.completion: With the Jungle Minotaurs gone, our shipping lanes are finally clear. Such a service deserves this reward!
332.details: Every year, Jungle Minotaurs migrate to the mouth of the river near the Nemean Forest and clog our shipping lanes. We need you to clear them out!
332.objectives: Kill those Jungle Minotaurs in the river near the Nemean Forest, then return to the [Round Quest]Port Issuer for your rewards.
332.title: [Lv101]Clear the River

333.completion: Bloodfly Wasps are difficult to deal with, but not for you! Take this reward as thanks for driving them away.
333.details: There are several reports of cargo transports being attacked by Bloodfly Wasps. You are our best hope to drive them away.
333.title: [Lv80]Bloody Bloodflies

334.completion: Thank you for ridding us of those Spider Warriors. You are obviously not burdened by fear of any kind. Take this well-earned reward!
334.details: An army of Spider Warriors is attacking the encampment. If you can drive them off, we would be ever so grateful!
334.objectives: Eliminate some Spider Warriors in the encampment.
334.title: [Lv81]No Spiders Allowed

335.completion: Life was unbearable with those Totem Spiders crawling around the camp. On behalf of the transport crew, here is your reward.
335.details: A swarm of Totem Spiders have attacked a transport crew. For safety’s sake, kill those spiders!
335.objectives: Get rid of the Totem Spiders in the Nemean Forest.
335.title: [Lv89]Spiders From Hell

336.completion: Thanks to you, those Frontline Cavalries have fled the Nemean Forest. I doubt that’s the last we’ve seen of them but for now, take this reward.
336.details: A new Persian threat is upon us! We have several reports of their Frontline Cavalries attacking the Nemean Forest. They pose a dire threat to Sparta. Will you help?
336.objectives: Eliminate some Frontline Cavalries in the Nemean Forest, then report back to the [Daily Quest]Forest Issuer.
336.title: [Lv90]The Persians are Coming!

337.completion: You have helped me more than you can imagine. Take this reward. It’s from the bottom of my heart!
337.details: Forest Lions are a pain in the you-know-what. I have the scar to prove it! Get them for me, please!
337.objectives: Teach those Forest Lions a lesson then report to the [Daily Quest]Forest Issuer.
337.title: [Lv94]Ferocious Forest Lions

338.completion: The Frontline Priests are gone! We can all breathe deeply now, thanks to you.
338.details: The Frontline Priests are making trouble again. They've got their eyes on our cargo. Stop them!
338.objectives: Defeat the Frontline Priests and then report to the [Daily Quest]Forest Issuer.
338.title: [Lv98]Troublesome Priests

339.completion: Yay! I knew you could get rid of those Jungle Minotaurs! Everyone in then Nemean Forest wants me to thank you with this reward.
339.details: Jungle Minotaurs are always bothering travelers around the Nemean Forest. Go and clear them out!
339.objectives: Eliminate the Jungle Minotaurs and then return to the [Daily Quest]Forest Issuer.
339.title: [Lv100]Annoying Jungle Minotaurs

340.completion: Wow, I’m very impressed with the way you handled those Purple Winged Demons. You have earned this reward and then some!
340.details: Urgh, Purple Winged Demons are all over the forest. Kill them and end this nightmare!
340.objectives: Destroy thePurple Winged Demons and then return to the [Daily Quest]Forest Issuer.
340.title: [Lv103]Purple People Eater

341.completion: What can a silly Tree Demon do against one as brave as you? Nothing, except die! Hahaha. And now, your reward.
341.details: Is there no end to our bad luck? Now a gang of Tree Demons are attacking us. Grind those evil shrubs into sawdust!
341.objectives: Defeat the Tree Demons and then return to the [Daily Quest]Forest Issuer.
341.title: [Lv106]The Terrible Tree Demons

342.completion: I am so glad you made it. We can really use your skills here on the frontline. Are you ready for the battles that lie ahead?
342.details: War is coming and we are once again in need of your service. The frontline appears to be the Nemean Forest. Go there and report to Eurybia. He will put your skills to best use.
342.objectives: Report to Eurybia in the Nemean Forest.
342.title: [Lv80]Duty Calls

343.completion: Those Bloodfly Wasps didn’t stand a chance against you! I guess you deserve a reward. Take it before I change my mind.
343.details: The Bloodfly Wasps are back. Kill those buzzy pests and then report to Pelagias in Sparta.
343.objectives: Swat the Bloodfly Wasps and then report to Pelagias.
343.title: [Lv80]Bloodfly, Bloody Bloodfly

344.completion: You have an important message for me? Let me see... yes, this is grave news indeed. Thank you for delivering it.
344.details: The Persian invasion includes hordes of giant monsters. A mysterious power is regenerating their monsters and all attempts to eliminate them have proven futile. I need you to deliver this important message to Eurybia in the Nemean Forest. May your journey be swift!
344.objectives: Find Eurybia in the Nemean Forest.
344.title: [Lv80]Monsters Reborn

345.completion: I always knew something was weird about that grove. Thank you for confirming my suspicions!
345.details: I've got a possible lead regarding the Persian monster regeneration problem. Go to Mysterial Grove and see what you can find.
345.objectives: Go to Mysterial Grove then report to Antilochos in the Nemean Forest.
345.title: [Lv80]Trip-Mysterial Grove

346.completion: I see your efforts were not in vain. This information will help the investigation immeasurably. Good work!
346.details: Eurybia is an expert investigator. He can help us decide what to do next.
346.title: [Lv80]Detective Eurybia

347.completion: With those pesky spiders gone, the Persian invasion is a lesser threat. Thank you!
347.details: Those Spider Warriors are helping the Persians regenerate their monsters. Kill them before they continue working their evil magic! Then report to Pelagias.
347.objectives: Kill the Spider Warriors, then report to Pelagias in Sparta.
347.title: [Lv80]Spider Slayer

348.completion: Greetings! Hear my tales of wars gone by. May they help strike down our enemies.
348.details: War will soon be upon us. We need all the advice we can get. Speak with Pythagoras. He is a celebrated veteran and has many helpful suggestions to share.
348.title: [Lv105]War Stories

349.completion: This vacation was good for you, yes? I see your fighting spirit has returned.
349.details: You’re a bit jumpy these days, aren't you? Perhaps a vacation would do you well. The Northern Forest of Nemea is stunning. I suggest you go there for a while. Talk to Pelagias when you feel relaxed again.
349.objectives: Visit the Northern Forest of Nemea, then talk to Pelagias in Sparta
349.title: [Lv105]Mandatory Vacation

350.completion: So, you wish to become an even greater soldier? I have a few military exercises that will accomplish that, if you’re up to the task.
350.details: Military exercises are a great way to prepare for war. Find Eurybia in Nemean Forest. His training techniques are the best in Greece.
350.objectives: Find Eurybia in the Nemean Forest.
350.title: [Lv105]War Games

351.completion: You are more prepared for battle than ever before.
351.details: Sharpen your skills by killing those Purple Winged Demons. Not only will you be more battle ready, but we’ll finally be free of those deadly imps. It’s win-win! When you’re done, visit good ol' Antilochos.
351.objectives: Destroy the Purple Winged Demons,then visit Antilochos.
351.title: [Lv105]Death to Demons

352.completion: It's good to see you again. Are you ready for your final training? The sooner we start, the better for us all!
352.details: One final exercise remains. Go to the Nemean Forest and find Eurybia. He will have further instructions.
352.objectives: Find Eurybia in the Nemean Forest.
352.title: [Lv105]Complete Your Training

353.completion: Excellent work, soldier! This training will prove invaluable on the battlefield. You are now ready to face our foes.
353.details: Your final exercise will not be easy. Abyss Demons are nasty creatures and hard to kill. Slay them to complete your training.
353.objectives: Kill the Abyss Demons, then report to Pelagias in Sparta.
353.title: [Lv105]Abyss Demon's Roar

354.completion: You did it! Those mages will no longer impede our army’s efforts. Here is your reward.
354.details: The dogs of war are barking at our gates! Welcome to the frontlines. I hope you remember your training because you’re going to need it. Your first task is to kill the Persian Mages that surround us. Good luck. Our men are counting on you!
354.objectives: Defeat the Persian Mages, then report to the [Round Quest]Thermopylae Issuer.
354.title: [Lv110]Mages on the Run

355.completion: Those Persian Vanguards folded quickly once you joined the battle. Thermopylae thanks you.
355.details: An entire legion of Persian Vanguards have begun an assault on Thermopylae. This will not stand! Kill them for the glory of Greece!
355.objectives: Kill the Persian Vanguards in Thermopylae, then speak with the [Round Quest]Spartan Issuer.
355.title: [Lv120]Defend Thermopylae

356.completion: Another victory for Greece! Each Persian Archmage slain brings us closer to ending this war.
356.details: Persian Archmages invade our land and pillage all in their way. They deserve no mercy from us. Kill them now!
356.objectives: Kill the Persian Archmages and then report to the [Round Quest]Spartan Issuer.
356.title: [Lv121]Archmage Archenemies

357.completion: It wasn’t a pretty task but killing those Rot Hide Cooers was necessary. You are indeed a great asset to our cause.
357.details: The battlefield is riddled with dead soldiers, each deserving a hero’s burial. But instead, their corpses are picked clean by those disgusting Rot Hide Cooers. And where Cooers go, disease soon follows. Kill them before this becomes a bigger problem.
357.objectives: Kill the Rot Hide Cooers and then report to Eurypylus.
357.title: [Lv110]Kill the Cooers

358.completion: War is hell, and it’s even worse with creatures like the White Cooers running around. Thanks to you, that’s no longer a problem.
358.details: A plague of White Cooers have arrived. These disgusting creatures must be eliminated.
358.objectives: Kill the White Cooers and then report to the [Daily Quest]Spartan Issuer.
358.title: [Lv113]Death to all Cooers

359.completion: Reports from Thermopylae claim you have rid the area of those Flaming Hounds. Bless you! This reward is the least we can do.
359.details: Our soldiers at Thermopylae are not only facing a Persian invasion but also packs of Flaming Hound. They attack with fiery fangs and disrupt the night with dreadful howls. Exterminate these hellish beasts!
359.objectives: Kill the Flaming Hounds and then report to Eurypylus.
359.title: [Lv119]The Bellicose Hounds

360.completion: Those Persian Huntresses no longer threaten our hopes for victory.
360.details: Powerful Persian Huntresses have been seen at the Thermopylae battlefield. Only a soldier of your skill can hope to stop them.
360.objectives: Defeat Persian Huntresses at Thermopylae and then report to the [Daily Quest]Spartan Issuer.
360.title: [Lv119]Who Hunts the Huntress?

361.completion: I was unsure how we would ever defeat those Persian Vanguards but you made it look easy. We are lucky to have you on our side!
361.details: Our soldiers at Thermopylae were assaulted by a stealthy foe. Only Persian Vanguards are capable of such sneaky attacks. Find these covert assassins and kill them all.
361.objectives: Kill the Persian Vanguards and then report to the [Daily Quest]Spartan Issuer.
361.title: [Lv120]Vanguards of Vengeance

362.completion: The winds of fate are blowing in our favor! With this wand, we will surely cripple the Persian war effort. Please accept this reward as a symbol of our thanks.
362.details: Our spies inform us that a coven of Persian Whiterobe Mages in Thermopylae are guarding the Persian Wand. We must obtain it! Defeat the Mages and steal their wand!
362.objectives: Kill Persian Whiterobe Mages to get their wand, then report to Pelagias in Sparta.
362.title: [Lv121]Grand Theft Wand

363.completion: You have renewed our hope by stopping the Persian Clergies' frightening advance.
363.details: Our messenger from Thermopylae reports that the enemy have the city surrounded. Killing the Persian Clergies is our first order of business.
363.objectives: Kill the Persian Clergies and then report to the [Daily Quest]Spartan Issuer.
363.title: [Lv125]Clearing the Clergies

364.completion: Yes! We dealt a serious blow to the enemy!
364.details: Persian Scouts continue to steal our strategies and reveal our position. They must be dealt with quickly.
364.objectives: Kill the Persian Scouts and then report to the [Daily Quest]Spartan Issuer.
364.title: [Lv125]Scout Scalper

365.completion: Hah! Our counterstrike was a success. We sent those Persian Soldiers packing.
365.details: It’s finally time to mount an offensive! The general has ordered a counterstrike against the Persian Soldiers. Let’s teach our foes a lesson they won’t soon forget!
365.objectives: Kill the Persian Soldiers and then report to the [Daily Quest]Spartan Issuer.
365.title: [Lv125]Strike and Counterstrike!

366.completion: You’ve saved us again! With those Persian Bowyers gone, we now stand a chance for victory!
366.details: Our soldiers are no match for those sneaky Persian Bowyers. Their arrows continue to rain down upon us. Take them out. Hurry, you're our only chance!
366.objectives: Kill the Persian Bowyers and then report to the [Daily Quest]Spartan Issuer.
366.title: [Lv125]Death From Above

367.completion: Defeating the Persian Archmages is an amazing accomplishment. You should be proud!
367.details: Few can match the power and skill of the legendary Persian Archmages. Hopefully, you are one of the few. Kill them or we face certain defeat!
367.objectives: Kill the Persian Archmages and then report to the [Daily Quest]Spartan Issuer.
367.title: [Lv125]Archenemies

368.completion: By defeating those Persian Paladins, you sent a strong message to our enemies. And once again, your valor on the battlefield has earned you a reward.
368.details: The enemy is sending forth their most powerful warriors, the deadly Persian Paladins. Are you strong enough to defeat them?
368.objectives: Kill the Persian Paladins and then report to the [Daily Quest]Spartan Issuer.
368.title: [Lv125]Paladin Power!

369.completion: Message delivery can be a dangerous business. Your service has definitely earned this reward.
369.details: I have important information for the Postman at Thermopylae. Deliver him my message at once.
369.objectives: Deliver a message to the Postman in Thermopylae.
369.title: [Lv121]Messenger Service

370.completion: You have killed the Persian Whiterobe Mages! In doing so, you have made your guild proud.
370.details: Fight the Persian Whiterobe Mages at Thermopylae. You don’t want to disappoint your guild so be strong and fight bravely!
370.objectives: Eliminate the Persian Whiterobe Mages at Thermopylae and then report to the Citizen in the main city.
370.title: [Lv121]Orders From Above

371.completion: This war has drained Greece of brave warriors. A good soldier is hard to find these days.
371.details: You are quite brave but an army of one will not win this war. We need more fighters to stand against the invading Persians. However, recruitment is low. Dieneces in Thermopylae is also raising an army. Report to him and find out if his luck has been better than mine.
371.title: [Lv120]You and What Army

372.completion: Your scouting report is distressing! The Persians are in greater numbers than I imagined. Thank you for your service.
372.details: I have an important surveillance mission for you. Sneak behind enemy lines and scout out the Persian Encampment (-140,32). Report what you find to Pelagias in Sparta.
372.objectives: Scout the enemies at the Persian Encampment (-140,32) in Thermopylae and then report what you find to Pelagias in Sparta.
372.title: [Lv120]Scout the Enemy

373.completion: This pledge to deliver supplies is a godsend. Our soldiers will rest easy knowing food and medicine is forthcoming.
373.details: Our reports indicate the army at Thermopylae is running dangerously low on supplies. Report to their leader, Dieneces, and let him know help is on the way.
373.objectives: Deliver Pelagias' message to Dieneces at Thermopylae.
373.title: [Lv120]Supplies for Thermopylae

374.completion: Thank you for killing those Persian Bandits. My only regret is that they can only die once!
374.details: Persian Bandits have infiltrated Thermopylae. They steal our food and our women. We must fight back. Report to Eurybia once you rid us of them all.
374.objectives: Kill the Persian Bandits at Thermopylae and then report to Eurybia in the Nemean Forest.
374.title: [Lv120]Bandits Must Die!

375.completion: We have triumphed! Let the word ring out that a new day has dawned, one of peace and prosperity for all of Greece!
375.details: The people are elated by news of our latest victory! Travel to Thermopylae and tell Dieneces the good news! That man deserves a celebration.
375.title: [Lv120]A Message of Peace

376.completion: You’ve killed the Persian Captain! This will certainly send the enemy’s morale plummeting. Take this modest reward, you deserve it and more!
376.details: We have the enemy on the run! Now is the time to dampen the enemies morale. Kill the Persian Captain, then return to Pelagias in Sparta. Victory awaits!
376.objectives: Kill the Persian Captain and then report to Pelagias in Sparta.
376.title: [Lv120]Death of a Captain

377.completion: The Persians are amassing their armies, and an epic battle is at hand. I may have information that can help.
377.details: Our encounters with the Persian army have been mere skirmishes compared to the huge battle that is coming. We still need to collect more intelligence to ensure victory. Find Dieneces. He may have valuable information for us.
377.title: [Lv125]Gathering Intelligence

378.completion: You have unearthed a wealth of new information. This will indeed come in handy.
378.details: Investigate the Eastern Open Ground (151,153) at Thermopylae but keep a low profile. Pausanians awaits your report.
378.objectives: Investigate the Eastern Open Ground (151,153) at Thermopylae, then report to Pausanians.
378.title: [Lv125]A Little Recon

379.completion: Pausanians is a wise and cautious man. If he believes we should attack now, that’s good enough for me.
379.details: The intelligence you gathered has given us a keen advantage and the time to attack is now. Tell Dieneces it's time to move.
379.title: [Lv125]Pausanians' Attack

380.completion: The once mighty Persian Paladins are now nothing but corpses. Your bravery has once again served Greece well.
380.details: Persian Paladins are attacking again. A clarion call has gone out to all able-bodied soldiers. We must show those paladins no mercy!
380.objectives: Kill all of the Persian Paladins and then report to Eurybia.
380.title: [Lv125]Clarion Call

381.completion: What a bold idea! Killing the Persian leader will not be easy. We must consider all the risks.
381.details: We are all pleased with your recent success, but now is not the time to celebrate. The Persian army remains formidable and we are growing weary of this war. Perhaps if we kill their leader, the rest of their army will disband. Speak to Dieneces to see if he has any suggestions.
381.title: [Lv125]The Bold Plan

382.completion: Mardonius is dead! This is a great victory for Greece! The Persian army must be in shambles. Glory to us all!
382.details: After much consideration, I believe Eurybia's plan is the right course of action. You must assassinate Mardonius, the Persian leader. His death will undo the enemy's morale. Once he is dead, report to Pelagias in Sparta.
382.objectives: Kill Mardonius, then report to Pelagias in Sparta.
382.title: [Lv125]Assassination

383.completion: You are not only a brave war hero, but an accomplished explorer as well! The mystery of the Thermopylae ruins is no longer a mystery, thanks to you.
383.details: The Ruins (19,131) north of Thermopylae have gone unexplored for years. Travel there and see what you can find.
383.title: [Lv122]The Ruins of Thermopylae

384.completion: Take this fashionable item to the Valentines party. Happy Valentine's Day!
384.details: Ha-ha, this will be an unforgettable St. Valentine's Day massacre. Kill those annoying  Snow Demons  that have invaded the suburbs with someone of the opposite sex, and you will get a special gift for Valentine's Day.
384.objectives: Create a team of two with someone of the opposite sex and go kill the  Snow Demons  in the suburbs!
384.title: [Lv20]<2P>Valentine's Day Gifts

385.completion: Because of your bravery, it is with great pride that I bestow upon you the title Guardian of Greece!
385.details: The senate has elected to honor you as the Guardian of Greece. Visit the Senator to claim this prestigious title.
385.objectives: Claim your new title from the Senator in Sparta.
385.title: [Lv1]A New Guardian

386.completion: Those Milier Guardsmen never knew what hit them!
386.details: The Milier Guardsmen have assembled and are heading to the frontline. They are coldblooded killers with little regard for innocent life. Join us in our mission to kill these monsters.
386.objectives: Fight the Milier Guardsmen and then talk to Aeoliah in Argolis.
386.title: [Lv106]It's Milier Time!

387.completion: You really rattled their bones, didn't you?
387.details: The Skeleton Warlocks along the Megara Coast have been spotted consorting with the enemy. Destroy those bony bastads, then report to Menelaos in Argolis.
387.objectives: Fight the Skeleton Warlocks in Megara and then talk to Menelaos in Argolis.
387.title: [Lv110]Bad to the Bone

388.completion: The Isthmus of Corinth runs red with the blood of Young RedDragons.
388.details: It’s that time of year again, when Young RedDragons migrate to the Isthmus of Corinth. As always, they must be killed before they mature.
388.objectives: Kill the Young Red Dragons at the Isthmus of Corinth and then talk to the [Daily Quest]Main City Issuer.
388.title: [Lv104]Dragon Slayer

389.completion: You have finally arrived! Listen carefully, there is much for us to discuss.
389.details: We are again faced with the reality of war. As we speak, guilds from around Greece are taking up arms. Find the Retired Wizard in Sparta; he will tell you the details.
389.objectives: Find the Retired Wizard in Sparta.
389.title: [Lv50]News of War

390.completion: Who sent you? What do you want with me?
390.details: I was once a warrior but the ravages of age forced me to retire. Yet my connections in the army remain intact and they tell me war is imminent. I heard that supplies are running low. Only Simonos can help. You will find him in the Starting Area of the main city.
390.objectives: Find Simonos in the Starting Area of the main city.
390.title: [Lv50]Short on Supplies

391.completion: I'm very busy allocating materials. What is the purpose of your visit?
391.details: The Retired Wizard sent you to speak with me? Any friend of his is a friend of mine but I won’t be much help. For war supplies, you should speak with Muropis in Peloponnesus. He supervises material allocation and can help you obtain whatever items you need.
391.title: [Lv50]Running to Peloponnesus

392.completion: You’ve returned with the supplies our army so desperately needs! The war has yet to begin and you’ve already proven yourself a hero! Choose any material and send it to the War Supplier in either the Main City, the Suburbs, or Peloponnesus. Each city will reward you differently.
392.details: You’re a friend of the Retired Wizard? That old coot never fades away. Well I can never say no to him. I will give you the supplies. Go back and tell him the good news.
392.objectives: Report to the Retired Wizard in Sparta.
392.title: [Lv50]Supplies for the War

393.completion: You sent those pathetic Persian Mages straight to the Underworld, which is just what they deserved.
393.details: Those poor Persian Mages are all alone in Thermopylae. You should cure their loneliness... with death!
393.objectives: Eliminate the Persian Mages at Thermopylae, then report to Eurypylus.
393.title: [Lv113]The Lonely Mages

394.completion: All of Greece thanks you for your heroic actions. I would follow you into battle any day!
394.details: Thermopylae is once again plagued by Persian Bandits. They kill first and ask questions later. Destroy them before they destroy us!
394.objectives: Eliminate the Persian Bandits at Thermopylae and then report to Eurypylus at Thermopylae.
394.title: [Lv117]Bandits of Ill Repute!

395.completion: I’ve never seen anyone take to beast riding as easily as you. Remember, you can fight when riding as well. It’s a great advantage on the battlefield.
395.details: Sparta is a beautiful city but walking can be hard on the feet. The best alternative is riding a beast. But first, you have to learn how to do it. Visit Amvrosiou and he’ll teach you everything you need to know.
395.objectives: Find Amvrosiou in the main city.
395.title: [Lv200]Beast Rider

396.completion: The bond between steed and rider is sacred. He lives to serve you, so treat him well. Start by placing him in the mount bar. Ride on!
396.details: Mastering the art of beast riding was only the first step. Now you need a decent animal to ride! Don’t worry, I’ve asked Ikaros to set aside his finest steed for you. Find him and the steed is yours.
396.objectives: Find Ikaros in the main city.
396.title: [Lv200]First Steed

399.completion: Your visit has been the highlight of my month. It gets so lonely up here by myself. I will not forget your kindness.
399.details: The Priestess feels terribly lonely guarding the Spartan Temple by herself. Pay her a visit. It will surely make her day!
399.title: [Lv70]A Friendly Visit

400.completion: Business has been so bad lately. But if people see a legend like you here, they might actually stop by. Thank you for possibly boosting my sales!
400.details: [Warehouse] Savva moved to Sparta in order to increase her sales but so far this plan hasn't done too well. She feels miserable about her lack of profits but a visit from you would surely lift her spirits!
400.objectives: Visit [Warehouse]Savva in the Spata Newbie Camp.
400.title: [Lv70]Business As Usual

401.completion: What’s the big deal? I’m only playing! Tell my sister not to worry.
401.details: Thalia loves to play pranks. But this time she ran away from home! Her big sister Annis is frantic and believes Thalia is lost somewhere in Peloponnesus. Reunite these siblings and be a hero to them both!
401.title: [Lv70]Lost Child

402.completion: The people of Peloponnesus love peace but if Sparta is threatened they are the first to take up arms in defense.
402.details: We all want peace, but few are willing to risk their lives for it as much as the citizens of Peloponnesus. Talk with Basileiou for more specifics.
402.title: [Lv70]Quest For Peace

403.completion: What? My friend is too sick to help? More like too lazy! Oh well, thanks for the message anyway.
403.details: If you’re headed to Nemea you’ve still got a long journey ahead of you. Since you’re going that way, maybe you can deliver a message for me. I’m supposed to help the Village Head in Nemea but I'm much too sick to be of any help. Can you let him know? Thanks.
403.objectives: Deliver a message to the Village Head in Nemea.
403.title: [Lv70]Special Delivery

404.completion: It was kind of you to visit us. The people of Sparta remind us why we fight. This is just the morale boost we needed!
404.details: What has become of beautiful Nemea? We are constantly under attack from hordes of evil monsters! Our Lame Guards are barely holding the line. Raise their spirits by letting them know all of Athens prays for their safety.
404.objectives: Visit the Lame Guard in Nemea.
404.title: [Lv70]Mission of Mercy

405.completion: This is grave news indeed, but with your advanced notice we now stand a good chance of defending our city.
405.details: The Death Servants are preparing a large-scale invasion of Argolis. Menesthes must be informed. Find him as quickly as you can, but be careful of the mobs nearby. They are unpredictable and it’s best to avoid them.
405.title: [Lv70]The Death Servant Approaches!

406.completion: The spy game is hard for an old man like me. Retirement sure sounds sweet. Thanks for delivering such good news!
406.details: Pylades, our spy in Megara has earned the right to retire after he completes his final mission. Please deliver that message to him. But beware as you’ll be traveling through enemy territory. If you’re captured, tell them nothing!
406.title: [Lv70]Retirement Plan

407.completion: You didn’t find out anything about the vanishing boat? How curious. I guess some mysteries are meant to go unsolved!
407.details: I always fish near an abandoned boat along the East River in the Suburb. But when I went there today, the boat was gone! Look around and find out where it went.
407.title: [Lv70]The Vanishing Boat

408.completion: Balthazar’s reign of terror is over! Not even my best soldiers could bring him down but you sure did.
408.details: The Wizard Balthazar is public enemy number one. He attacks our caravans with ruthless efficieny. We can’t continue to live this way. Kill this magical menace and bring his head back to the Captain. A hero’s welcome awaits you!
408.objectives: Kill Wizard Balthazar in Nemea and then report to the Captain.
408.title: [Lv70]Public Enemy

409.completion: Wow, you just killed 50 Forest Wizards without even breaking a sweat. Word of your great deed will travel fast!
409.details: Nemea has been targeted by a clan of Forest Wizards. They scare our children and suck the joy out of life. You are our only hope to drive them away once and for all!
409.objectives: Kill 50 Forest Wizard in Nemea before reporting to the Captain.
409.title: [Lv70]Wizards of the Forest

410.completion: Yo, those spiders were talking smack until you came around. Now they don’t talk at all cause they’re dead! Word.
410.details: Ain’t no spider like a Peloponnesian spider cause a Peloponnesian spider don’t stop! Exterminate this menace before someone gets hurt!
410.title: [Lv70]Spiders of Doom!

411.completion: You found Thalia's ring! Where did the scorpion keep it? Wait, I don’t want to know, the answer could be gross. In any case, thank you so much!
411.details: Can you help find my Lost Ring? I purchased it as a gift for Thalia the other day but now I can't find it. Perhaps one of the Toxic Scorpions ate it.
411.objectives: Find the Lost Ring in Peloponnesus, then speak with Meges.
411.title: [Lv70]Thalia's Ring

412.completion: You killed those feral beasts! Let us hiss with delight, for tonight we feast on Boa meat!
412.details: This land is perfect for hunters like me. But lately, a large pack of Boas have moved in. They attack me and steal our dinner! These snakes must be stopped or I’lll starve!
412.objectives: Kill 50 Boas and then return to Koronos in the Peloponnesus camp.
412.title: [Lv70]Big Bad Boas

413.completion: You have done Greece a great service. I am sadded though. Chipa was once a noble man. What a tragedy.
413.details: Hero Chipa fought bravely against the Persians but fell at the famous Battle of Thermopylae. He and his men were nearly destroyed by an evil force. Chipa never recovered from that incident and his soul was tainted by that dark power. He blames Greece for his downfall and seeks his revenge as the head of the Dark Necromancers. They are targeting Nemea as we speak. Kill this fallen hero before his evil spreads any further.
413.objectives: Kill Hero Chipa and the return to Antilochos in Nemea.
413.title: [Lv70]Chipa, the Fallen

414.completion: You did it! Be careful, there are more threats out there than just boxes.
414.details: The Newbie Camp is overrun with Juno's Boxes. Each one is deadlier than the last! Okay, that might be an exaggeration, but still... these things need to die!
414.objectives: Kill 30 of Juno's Boxes in the Newbie Camp, then report to Zander in the main city.
414.title: [Lv70]Mo Boxes  Mo Problems

415.completion: The world is a better place without those Forest Magicians and their weird Milier beliefs. You are indeed one of Greece’s most valuable allies!
415.details: Milierism is a mystic cult that used to practice their faith in peace. But paranoia is their master now as they’ve grown to mistrust all outsiders. The Forest Magicians on the Isthmus of Corinth are among the worst Miliers in Greece. They attack our citizens for no reason and must be stopped!
415.objectives: Annihilate 30 Forest Magicians on the Isthmus of Corinth, then report to Menesthes of Argolis.
415.title: [Lv70]Death Cult for Cutie

416.completion: I’m glad to see that the Astrien is dead. Maybe our livestock can feed more than just him! As a reward, I can offer you a boar for a mount.
416.details: The Astrien thinks he is the God's gift to wolves. He also feels entitled to our livestock and is eating us out of house and home. Go stick this stuck-up wolf and let Antilochos in Nemea know what you’ve done.
416.objectives: Kill the Astrien and then report to Antilochos in Nemea.
416.title: [Lv70]Wicked Wolf

417.completion: Oh, revenge sure is sweet. I wish I could have seen Gordon’s face when you beat him up. Thank you, you’re a real friend!
417.details: Gordon is a bully, and he’s mean, and I hate him so much! I bet you could beat him up. Will you? Oh please do me this favor, and I’ll be your best friend forever!
417.objectives: Beat up Gordon in the Suburbs and then find Artem in the Newbie Camp.
417.title: [Lv70]Gordon the Mean

418.completion: You are my number one box basher! Thank you!
418.details: Is this Greece, or Box Land? It’s hard to tell with so many of Empusa's Boxes invading our suburbs. You must be here to get rid of them. Thanks for volunteering!
418.objectives: Drive away Empusa's Boxes in the Suburbs and then report to Foka in the Newbie Camp.
418.title: [Lv70]Random Quest Scroll

419.completion: Thanks! You really saved my hide by killing those wild lions. Sadly, all I have to offer is lion jerky. Oops!
419.details: Oof! Raw lion meat sure is tasty, but you pay a heavy price later. What I would give for a pain-free stomach! I guess that's my price for stealing from the food supply. Now I'm 30 Wild Lions short. Yikes, did I eat all that?
419.objectives: Kill 30 Wild Lions in Nemea and then return to Philoctetes.
419.title: [Lv70]Don't Eat the Lion!

420.completion: Welcome to the Warrior's Tomb, where great heroes of the past are laid to rest in eternal peace.
420.details: All heroes-in-training eventually visit the Warrior's Tomb to pay their respects to the heroes of the past. Are you ready to make that pilgrimage?
420.objectives: Visit Warrior's Tomb (-184,-184) in the Suburb of Sparta.
420.title: [Lv70]Random Quest Scroll

421.completion: With those wicked Servants gone, the stench of death has cleared from the air.
421.details: A gang of Death Servants set up camp in Argolis. You should have no problem killing these servants of death in their own camp!
421.objectives: Kill 50 Death Servants in Argolis and turn report to Agamemnon.
421.title: [Lv70]Random Quest Scroll

422.completion: Those robbers weren't so tough after all. At one point, I thought they were going to cry! Did you get any torches from them?
422.details: The Robber Kelin are back and they’re taking over Argolis. Folks are afraid to leave their homes! This is no way to live. Do us a favor and mow this gang down.
422.objectives: Kill 10 Robber Kelin in Argolis, then report to Mopsus.
422.title: [Lv70]Killin' the Kelin

423.completion: Thank you for bringing me these wonderful birds. Now let the dissections begin!
423.details: Ornithology is the study of birds and I am one of Greece’s most renowned ornithologists. But there is a species of Little Weird Birds around the Isthmus of Corinth that warrants closer study. In the name of science, please bring me those birds!
423.objectives: Capture 30 Little Weird Birds in the Isthmus of Corinth, then return to Eumaeus in Argolis.
423.title: [Lv70]Bye Bye Birdies

424.completion: My fear of angry female warriors is second only to my love for you. Thank you for defeating them! Now we can be fishermen again instead of scaredymen!
424.details: A tribe of Amazon Warriors have overrun Argolis and are making life unbearable for the local fishermen. Defeat these female savages!
424.objectives: Kill 20 Amazon Warriors in Argolis and then report to the Boatman.
424.title: [Lv70]Amazonians of Destruction

425.completion: Thanks to you, those Red Deer are gone! Hopefully this will discourage other fauna from trying to take over our city. May the Gods bless Greece, and no place else!
425.details: Argolis is really going downhill. Now we have herds of Red Deer moving in. This can’t happen! Kill them before they get any other bright ideas!
425.objectives: Kill 10 Red Deer and then report to Aeoliah in Argolis.
425.title: [Lv70]Red Deer Go Home!

426.completion: You really broke some bones out there! I guess those punk Skeleton Mages were all teeth and no bite!
426.details: A rowdy bunch of Skeleton Mages are up to no good in Argolis. They’re mean to little kids and say rude things to the elderly. The only way to teach them any respect is to kill them!
426.objectives: Kill 10 Skeleton Mages and then report to Aeoliah in Argolis.
426.title: [Lv70]Skeletal Punks!

427.completion: You smell like dead Huge Frogs. That’s a good thing! Thanks for getting rid of them.
427.details: A very popular gift for Nemean children this year was an adorable tadpole. Well, the tadpoles quickly grew into Huge Frogs! Kill them before they multiply!
427.objectives: Kill 50 Huge Frog in Nemea and then report to the Captain.
427.title: [Lv70]Frogs of Enormity

428.completion: You put the hurt on those wizards. Awesome! Now maybe things can get back to normal.
428.details: The Wizards in Nemea are a huge problem. Slay those foul magic-users. It’s what they deserve!
428.objectives: Kill 30 Wizards in Nemea, then report to the Captain.
428.title: [Lv70]When Wizards Die

429.completion: It’s nice to see the Suburbs without the skeleton hoodlums cluttering up the place.
429.details: I've got a bone to pick with the Skeletons in the Suburbs. It wouldn’t be so bad if they’d just clean up after themselves, but no! They’re a bunch of slobs and they need to be dead now.
429.objectives: Destroy 40 Skeletons in the Suburbs of Sparta, then speak with Fanouriou in the Newbie Camp.
429.title: [Lv70]Skeleton Slobs

430.completion: The evil that that possessed those puppets is now gone. Greece is in your debt!
430.details: The Wooden Puppets have returned! They used to be so nice, but now someone is controlling them with evil. We need you to take them out.
430.objectives: Kill 20 Wooden Puppets in the Newbie Camp, then report to Fanouriou.
430.title: [Lv70]This Puppet Possessed!

431.completion: Greece has faced many foes but none as scary as those little snakes.
431.details: A Little Snake just bit my tongue. It’s swelling up! Soon I won’t be able to speak! Kill that snake! Avenge my tongue!
431.objectives: Kill the Little Snakes in the Newbie Camp then report to Dorotheou in the main city.
431.title: [Lv70]Little Snake Bites

432.completion: Those skeleton creeps keep coming and you keep knocking them down. I shudder to think where Greece would be without you.
432.details: Skeleton Mages are really awful. They use bad grammar and are really cheap. Oh, and they're also planning to attack our camp. How messed up is that?
432.objectives: Kill 50 Skeleton Mage and then report to Eumaeus in Argolis.
432.title: [Lv70]War with the Mages

433.completion: You’re back! Did you enjoy the river? Natural beauty like that reminds us what we’re fighting to protect.
433.details: Greece isn’t just a world at war. It’s also filled with beautiful landmarks like the Eurotas River. You should really check it out. There is a path to it starting from the Newbie Camp.
433.objectives: Journey to the $Eurotas River (40,157) in Sparta.
433.title: [Lv70]Enjoy the Eurotas

434.completion: Great work! Maybe I’ll make some Harpy Underling soup out of the corpses you left behind. Sounds yummy!
434.details: Here’s a riddle: What has long nails, pale faces, and rhymes with sharpy funderlings? The answer is Harpy Underlings, of course! There’s a bunch of them flying around the Isthmus of Corinth ready to be killed.
434.objectives: Kill 40 Harpy Underlings at the Isthmus of Corinth, then report to Eumaeus in Argolis.
434.title: [Lv70]Harpy Hunting

435.completion: With those Huge Skeletons gone, the sun feels warmer and the sky seems bluer.
435.details: The only thing worse than a skeleton is a Huge Skeleton! And we have dozens of them running around Peloponneus. Kill these big-boned brutes!
435.objectives: Kill 30 Huge Skeleton in Peloponnesus, then return to [Props]Aithra.
435.title: [Lv70]Big Bones

436.completion: You have done me a great favor. I don’t’ know how I’ll ever repay you.
436.details: I am but a humble merchant struggling to make ends meet. Times are hard and those Evil Wizard make things even harder. They raid my shops and must be stopped. Do me a favor and kill those heinous hoodlums!
436.objectives: Bring down 10 Evil Wizards and then report to [Props]Aithra, the Prop merchant in Peloponnesus.
436.title: [Lv70]The Merchant's Tale

437.completion: Welcome to the Spartan Lighthouse! It’s a crowning achievement of our culture and ingenuity. Plus, the pretty light keeps ships from crashing into our coast. Everybody wins!
437.details: Ever wonder where the beautiful light that fills the night sky over Sparta comes from? It’s from the Spartan Lighthouse and it's worth a visit! When you get there, make a wish. Legend has it, any wish made at the Lighthouse will eventually come true!
437.title: [Lv70]The Spartan Lighthouse

438.completion: Knowing those Forest Warriors are dead is a great relief but nothing will bring my beloved back to me. You have helped right a great wrong today.
438.details: My name is Thoma and my story is one of heartbreak and pain. I foolishly neglected the love of my life and she ran away with some Forest Warriors. They killed her and left me with nothing but regret. In the name of love, avenge her by killing those forest warriors!
438.objectives: Kill 40 Forest Warriors and then report to Thoma in Nemea.
438.title: [Lv70]Love and Revenge

439.completion: Those Giant Boas were starting to freak me out. Glad to see you put an end to them.
439.details: When the Persians invaded, they brought with them a menagerie of terrible monsters. Although we defeated our enemy, their monsters continue to multiply. The latest outbreak is at Derveni where a new breed of Giant Boas have been spotted. Eliminate these reptilian freaks.
439.objectives: Kill 20 Giant Boas in Derveni and then report to Aeoliah in Argolis.
439.title: [Lv70]Reptilian Freaks

440.completion: The Magic Tortoises are dead! Thank you for freeing Argolis from their tyranny! You are braver than I could ever be!
440.details: For years, Argolis authorities refused to believe that Magic Tortoises lurked in the shadows. But people kept disappearing, and they were forced to face the truth. Now those same authorities are determined to rid their town of these monsters once and for all.
440.objectives: Kill 50 Magic Tortoises and then report to Eumaeus in Argolis.
440.title: [Lv70]Random Quest Scroll

441.completion: You have done a great service to our suburb today. Please help yourself to as much wolf steak as you can stomach!
441.details: Ferocious Wolves play a vital role in keeping our lovely suburb thriving. But too many can cause big problems. Thin their numbers a bit. Afterwards, we will celebrate with a fancy wolf barbeque!
441.objectives: Kill 50 Ferocious Wolves in the Suburbs and then report to [Scholar merchant]Ianeira in the Sparta Newbie Camp.
441.title: [Lv70]Thin the Pack

442.completion: You proved yourself to be more than a match for those cowardly lions. Good work!
442.details: Several Lions are attacking people. You don’t believe me? Go to the Suburbs and see for yourself. While you’re there, destroy as many of those killer cats as you can!
442.objectives: Kill 50 Lions in the Suburbs and then report to [Scholar merchant]Ianeira in the Sparta Newbie Camp.
442.title: [Lv70]Cowardly Lions

443.completion: Your courage inspires me in ways you'll never know. Thanks!
443.details: Years ago, Eurystheus's father, Sthenleus, expelled Amphitryon from Argo. Poor Eurystheus has been wandering in Derveni ever since. Maybe you can help him.
443.title: [Lv70]Sins of the Father

444.completion: Um, whoever told you I make sedge potions was sadly mistaken. But I’m always happy to meet someone new, so welcome to Derveni!
444.details: There is a Sedge Merchant in Derveni who makes the most incredible potions. I must know her secret. Visit her and see what you can find out.
444.objectives: Find the Sedge Merchant in Derveni.
444.title: [Lv70]Secret Potion

445.completion: Not only did you kill the Huge Scorpions, but you looked good while doing it. Style and bravery is a rare combination.
445.details: Have you ever seen one of Peloponnesus' $Huge Scorpions? No? I’m not surprised. Most people who get close enough to see one don’t live to tell the tale. But you aren’t most people. You should have no problem killing these enormous monsters.
445.objectives: Kill 20 Huge Scorpions at Peloponnesus and then report to Meges.
445.title: [Lv70]Scary Scorpions

446.completion: I’ve seen many heroes in my time but none could kill a Dark Wizard like you.
446.details: I can’t go anywhere these days without running into a bunch of big-bellied Dark Wizards. They’re mostly in the lands south of Marathon. It’s time for these magicians to disappear!
446.objectives: Kill 10 Dark Wizards at Peloponnesus, then report to Meges.
446.title: [Lv70]Light Up the Dark

447.completion: Thanks to you, the Cursed Zone has one less monster. Maybe someday, we can reverse the God’s curse and return this land to its original splendor.
447.details: This land used to be heaven on Earth until a few drunken citizens offended the Gods. The angry deities were quick to cast a blight upon the land, turning it into the Cursed Zone. Now horrible monsters roam freely and attack people with little consequence. The Centauri Heathen has been running amok through this area. Kill it and help relieve our eternal curse.
447.objectives: Kill the Centauri Heathen in the Cursed Zone, then report to [Jewelry]Glauce in the Sparta Newbie Camp.
447.title: [Lv70]The Centauri Assassination

448.completion: Are you enjoying the splendor of the Natural Moat? Of course you are. Who wouldn’t?
448.details: According to legend, the Natural Moat at the Isthmus of Corinth was created when one of the Gods threw an ax into the ground. Whether or not you believe these ancient tales, the moat is definitely worth seeing.
448.objectives: Visit the Natural Moat (-31,22) at the Isthmus of Corinth.
448.title: [Lv70]The Natural Moat

449.completion: It is with great honor that I bestow upon you the title of Guardian of Greece. May Greece continue to benefit from your service.
449.details: The Gods of GodsWar are pleased with your service and have deemed you worthy of a new title. We dub thee Guardian of Greece! You can claim this title from the Senator in Sparta.
449.objectives: Claim your new title from the Senator in Sparta.
449.title: [Lv1]Guardian of Sparta!

450.completion: You must be the brave hero everyone is talking about. I have your special title here, and am honored to present you with it. From this day forward, you are Orion the Magnificent!
450.details: Your tireless devotion to Greece has won favor with the gods of GodsWar. They wish to award you with the special title of Orion the Magnificent! Few have ever earned this great honor. Congratulations!
450.objectives: Claim your new title from the Senator in Sparta.
450.title: [Lv1]A New Orion!

451.completion: In all my years as a Senator, I have never met an actual Legendary Hero. I am honored beyond words to present this title to you. Your service makes us all proud!
451.details: There are many heroes in GodsWar, but few become actual legends in their own time. You are one of the few. The gods of GodsWar wish to crown you Legendary Hero! Well done!
451.objectives: Claim your new title from the Senator in Sparta.
451.title: [Lv1]Legendary Hero

452.completion: The amount of monsters you have slain is truly impressive. Greece is a better place for it. Take the title of Monster Slayer and be proud!
452.details: You are no friend of monsters, that much is obvious. But the gods of GodsWar have chosen to award you with the title of Monster Slayer, and that puts you in a class few ever achieve. Huzzah!
452.objectives: Claim your new title from the Senator in Sparta.
452.title: [Lv1]Monster Slayer

456.completion: That was a hard won victory. I hate to imagine what those Huntresses and Wolves would have done had you not stopped them.
456.details: An unholy alliance has been forged between a coven of Persian Huntresses and packs of wild Flame Wolves. They are attacking Thermopylae as we speak! Destroy them all.
456.objectives: Slay 25 Persian Huntresses and 25 Flame Wolves at Thermopylae, then find Eurypylus.
456.title: [Lv121]Unholy Alliance

457.completion: The Oracle of Ares is pleased with your service and hopes you are equally pleased with this reward.
457.details: The Oracle of Ares has requested you rid the Suburbs of 500 Ferocious Wolves. They have overbred again and must be destroyed.
457.objectives: Kill 500 Ferocious Wolves in the Suburbs of Sparta and then report toAchilles.
457.title: [Lv1]Ares' Oracle I

458.completion: For ridding Greece of all those Huge Skeletons, the Oracle of Ares presents you with this bountiful reward.
458.details: By order from the Oracle of Ares you have been tasked with the killing of 500 Huge Skeletons in Peloponnesus.
458.objectives: Slay 500 Huge Skeletons in Peloponneus and then report to Achilles in Sparta.
458.title: [Lv31]Ares'  Oracle II

459.completion: You have been blessed by the Oracle of Ares for killing those wicked Wizards in Nemea. Well done!
459.details: There are 500 Wizards taking up residence in Nemea and the Oracle of Ares wants them dead. Do what you do best, and send those sinful sorceresses to an early grave.
459.objectives: Destroy 500 Wizards in Nemea and then report to Pit.
459.title: [Lv51]Ares'  Oracle III

460.completion: Those who obey the will of the Oracle of Ares are rewarded handsomely. Congratulations!
460.details: If there’s one thing the Oracle of Ares can’t stand, it’s Huge Frogs. This may explain why you’ve been tasked with killing 500 of those toxic critters in Nemea. Hop to it!
460.objectives: Eliminate 500 Huge Frogs in Nemea and then report to Pit.
460.title: [Lv61]Oracle Orders - IV

461.completion: For bringing death to those Death Servants, the Oracle of Ares has blessed you with this special reward.
461.details: An army of Death Servants are gathering at Argolis. The Oracle of Ares believes this is our best chance to take them out and has trusted you to do it!
461.objectives: Kill 500 Death Servants in Argolis and then report to Menesthes.
461.title: [Lv71]Oracle Orders - V

462.completion: You were wise to follow the Oracle of Ares' order. Now you may reap the rewards of that wisdom.
462.details: One or two Magic Tortoises in Argolis is no big deal. But now there are at least 500 there and people are worried. The Oracle of Ares wants them dead and believes you are the best suited to make it so.
462.objectives: Eliminate 500 Magic Tortoises in Argolis and then report to Menesthes.
462.title: [Lv81]Oracle Orders - VI

463.completion: The Oracle of Ares believes you to be a trusted servant of Greece and has rewarded you accordingly.
463.details: What makes a Giant Boa so giant? Who cares, the Oracle of Ares wants them dead! Kill 500 of them in Derveni. The future of Greece depends on it!
463.objectives: Destroy 500 Giant Boas in Derveni and then report to Menesthes.
463.title: [Lv91]Oracle Orders - VII

464.completion: Killing those Centaur Warriors has earned you the gratitude of the Oracle of Ares as well as this lavish reward.
464.details: I once met a Centaurs Warrior that had ten legs. It was very confusing, but none of that matters now. There are 500 of those monsters in Derveni, and the Oracle of Ares wants them gone.
464.objectives: Slay 500 Centaur Warriors in Derveni and then report to Memsthes.
464.title: [Lv101]Oracle Orders - VIII

465.completion: Your deeds on the battlefield have not gone unnoticed by the Oracle of Ares. Take this well-earned reward with pride!
465.details: Derveni was a lot nicer before the Persian Missionaries moved in. Now things are falling apart and the Oracle of Ares wants order restored. Kill 500 of them and bring peace back to Derveni
465.objectives: Eliminate 500 Persian Missionaries in Derveni and then report to the Achaean Soldier.
465.title: [Lv106]Oracle Orders - IX

466.completion: For killing all of those obnoxious Harpies, the Oracle of Ares is pleased to present you with this special reward.
466.details: The air over Derveni is foul with the stench of Harpies. The Oracle of Ares is not pleased about it and wishes you to kill 500 of them as soon as possible!
466.objectives: Kill 500 Harpies in Derveni and then report to the Achaean Soldier.
466.title: [Lv111]Oracle Orders - X

467.completion: By order from the Oracle of Ares, you are to be recognized for your bravery and duty with this special reward.
467.details: An evil combination of Persian Huntresses and Flame Wolves has invaded Thermopylae. The Oracle of Ares will not be at peace until they are dead! Kill 250 Huntresses and Wolves each and all will be well again.
467.objectives: Get rid of 250 Flame Wolves and 250 Persian Huntresses at Thermopylae. Afterwards, report to Eurypylus.
467.title: [Lv121]Oracle Orders - XI

468.completion: Because you fought for Greece so bravely, I will allow you to read the Profession Skillbook. Study it closely and it will serve you well.
468.details: Find Ikaros in the Sparta main city and ask him about the mysterious Profession Skillbook. Within its pages are the ultimate secrets to almost every trade!
468.objectives: Find Ikaros in the Sparta Main City.
468.title: [Lv70]The Book of Secrets

469.completion: You have answered the call to battle! Good, your skills of battle will be put to the test this on fateful night. Fight well and you shall be rewarded!
469.details: Cry “Havoc!” and let slip the dogs of war! The fair Helen has been seduced by Paris, the playboy prince of Troy. This act of insolence will not be tolerated! As we speak, Agamemnon is preparing an attack on Troy, vowing to bring Helen back. We need all the brave soldiers we can find. If this means you, then report to Menelaus at the Trojan beach at 8:00pm on Thursday's.
469.objectives: Report to Menelaus at the Trojan beach every Thursday at  8:00pm.
469.title: [Lv50]Trojan War

470.completion: All this fuss just for little ol’ me? I’m flattered but not surprised. When you’re as beautiful as I am, these things tend to happen. But enough is enough. I’m ready to go back to my husband Menelaus now.
470.details: I have heard tale of your skills on the battlefield and am grateful you chose to answer Agamemnon’s call to war. My wife Helen is the most beautiful woman in all Greece and must be returned to my side. Once we’ve broken through Troy’s formidable defenses, retrieving her will be your duty. For love and glory, we will win this fight!
470.objectives: Fight your way into Troy and rescue Helen.
470.title: [Lv50]Rescuing Helen

472.completion: Welcome to the Pindus Mountains Battlefield. I hope you are thirsty for war!
472.details: Check in for duty at the Pindus Mountains Battlefield by hitching a ride with the Battlefield Transporter, then sign up with the Battlefield Crier. Times are between 11:00am to 11:45am Wed. and Sun. 9:00pm to 9:45pm Sat.
472.objectives: Fight in the Pindus Mountains Battlefield.
472.title: [Lv60]The First Expedition

473.details: There’s only one way to win this war, and that’s by delivering holy water to the altars. This will earn us the points we need for victory! You can obtain holy water from the War Supplier.
473.objectives: Collect [Holy Water] from the [Sparta]War Supplier, then deliver it to the Battlefield Crier.
473.title: [Lv60]Holy Water Solution

474.completion: Greetings! I hear you have been killing Cooers in Thermopylae. My confused friend will be pleased. You have won his trust as well as mine.
474.details: What is this strange place? Who are you? A great hero? Ha, that has yet to be seen! If you want to win my trust, go to Thermopylae and kill 50 White Cooers and 50 Rot Hide Cooers. Why? I have my reasons! When you’re done, report to the Spartan Traveler. He’s my friend and will know where to find me, I think. Now I just need to figure out where me is!
474.objectives: Go to Thermopylae to kill 50 White Cooers and 50 Rot Hide Cooers, then report to the Spartan Traveler.
474.title: [Lv121]A Confused Man's Trust

475.completion: I see you’re back from Thermopylae, still covered in the blood of those wicked Persian Mages and Bandits. Good job!
475.details: Ouch! I hit my head and can’t remember anything other than how much I hate Persian Mages and Persian Bandits. They need to die! Can you to kill them for me? I overheard a man say there are some in Thermopylae. Slay those devils and then report to the Spartan Traveler. Oh, my memory is getting worse. What were we talking about? Right! How much I hate centaurs.
475.objectives: Collect 10 Sacred Staffs in Thermopylae, then report to the Spartan Traveler.
475.title: [Lv121]The Angry Amnesiac

476.completion: You killed those Snakes as if they were helpless worms! I love it!
476.details: Is there anything more disgusting than a snake? They don’t have any limbs! That’s just gross. Whenever I see a snake, I kill it. But there are too many of them these days. I can’t keep up! Help me kill these snakes and I’ll make it worth your while!
476.objectives: Kill enough Snakes in the Sparta Starting Area, then talk to Ion.
476.title: [Lv200]Snake Slayer I

477.completion: You must have killed a million Snakes! Maybe more! And no, I never exaggerate.
477.details: Kill more Snakes. Kill more Snakes. Kill more Snakes. I’m trying to influence you subliminally. Is it working? Great! Now go kill more Snakes!
477.objectives: Kill enough Snakes in the Sparta Starting Area, then talk to Ion.
477.title: [Lv200]Snake Slayer II

478.completion: I used to go through life never worried about Dressing Boxes, but then one came to life and bit my face! We live in strange times. Thanks for killing so many of them!
478.details: It may be hard to imagine a box as a monster but with Empusa’s Dressing boxes the threat is all too real. They really hurt, especially their pointy corners. Do us a favor and kill these boxes before someone loses an eye!
478.objectives: Kill enough of Empusa's Dressing Boxes in the Suburbs of Sparta, then find Ion in the Sparta Starting Area.
478.title: [Lv200]Box Buster I

479.completion: The only good Dressing Box is a dead Dressing Box, and that’s exactly what they are thanks to you.
479.details: You were brave against those boxes earlier, but I fear more have returned. Is there no end to this box blight? Hopefully after another round of killing them, they will get the hint and leave.
479.objectives: Kill enough of Empusa's Dressing Boxes in the Suburbs of Sparta, then find Ion in the Sparta Starting Area.
479.title: [Lv200]Box Buster II

480.completion: If these Ferocious Wolves weren’t so ferocious, then they wouldn’t have to die. But they are, so they do. Thanks for doing what needed to be done.
480.details: Ferocious Wolves aren’t so bad. They really just want to be loved but they go about it the wrong way. Too bad for them, because now they must die!
480.objectives: Kill enough Ferocious Wolves, then find Ion in the Starting Area of the main city.
480.title: [Lv200]Wolf Killer I

481.completion: With those Ferocious Wolves now dead, I shall howl at the moon all by myself tonight. It will be magnificent! Stop by, if you’re around. Just be quiet during my performance!
481.details: I was peacefully baying at the moon last night, when suddenly a pack of Ferocious Wolves joined in. Don’t they know I howl alone? Kill them all so I’m never interrupted again!
481.objectives: Kill enough Ferocious Wolves, then find Ion in the Starting Area of the main city.
481.title: [Lv200]Wolf Killer II

482.completion: You got rid of all those Mountain Lions! I’m speechless, except for the words I’m saying now.
482.details: My first pet was a Mountain Lion named Seymour. We went everywhere together but then he ran away. Now every time I see a Mountain Lion, I think of Seymour and it makes me sad. Stop these painful memories from resurfacing by driving these beasts out of Sparta!
482.objectives: Kill enough Mountain Lions and then speak with Ion in the Starting Area of the main city.
482.title: [Lv200]Dyin' Lions I

483.completion: What do you get when you cross a mighty hunter with a bunch of Mountain Lions? A bunch of dead Mountain Lions! Hahaha! I crack myself up.
483.details: Mountain Lions are considered the kings of the forest. Well, Greece is the birthplace of democracy, and we have no patience for royalty. Death to the king! Death to all Mountain Lions!
483.objectives: Kill enough Mountain Lions and then speak with Ion in the Starting Area of the main city.
483.title: [Lv200]Dyin' Lions II

484.completion: When I asked you to kill all those Vipers, I wondered if you could actually do the job. But you certainly put those doubts to rest!
484.details: What kind of world do we live in where deadly Vipers can slither around wherever they please? This is not the Greece I grew up in. Kill these serpents and restore my homeland to its former glory!
484.objectives: Kill enough Vipers, then find Ion in the Sparta Starting Area.
484.title: [Lv200]Viper Sniper I

485.completion: Another day, another Viper slaughter. Where would we be without you? Knee-deep in Vipers, probably.
485.details: Listen carefully and you can hear the Vipers laughing at the fact that you haven’t killed them yet. Are you going to let them get away with that?
485.objectives: Kill enough Vipers, then find Ion in the Sparta Starting Area.
485.title: [Lv200]Viper Sniper II

486.completion: I wish I could have seen you take out all those Skeletons. Did their bones snap? I bet they did.
486.details: The evil spirits that possess these Skeletons must be taught to let sleeping bones lie! You’re just the one to teach this lesson. Ring the bell, class is in session!
486.objectives: Kill enough Skeletons in the Suburbs of Sparta, then find Ion in the Starting Area.
486.title: [Lv200]Scary Skeletons

487.completion: Eww! I accidentally stepped in the carcass of one of those Huge Spiders you killed. They really leave a mess!
487.details: Some say Huge Spiders are cuddly and misunderstood creatures. I say to Tartaros with that nonsense! They are a menace and must be killed.
487.objectives: Kill enough Huge Spiders and then report to Basileiou in Peloponnesus.
487.title: [Lv200]Spider Fighter I

488.completion: I saw what you did to those Huge Spiders! Brutal stuff! The image will haunt my dreams but it’s my fault for looking.
488.details: My spider sense tells me another wave of Huge Spiders is just on the horizon. Take up arms again and slay these vile arachnids.
488.objectives: Kill enough Huge Spiders and then report to Basileiou in Peloponnesus.
488.title: [Lv200]Spider Fighter II

489.completion: I love the sound of Huge Spiders screaming for their lives. You really made them howl! I know you think that's sadistic and I guess I can't disagree.
489.details: Each Huge Spider mother can lay over 14 billion eggs a day! That’s why there are so many. Get out there again and wipe out as many as you can!
489.objectives: Kill enough Huge Spiders and then report to Basileiou in Peloponnesus.
489.title: [Lv200]Spider Fighter III

490.completion: You make killing Huge Scorpions look so easy, I might even try it myself. On the other hand, I’m a lover not a fighter.
490.details: Peloponnesus is tired of being known as the land of the Huge Scorpions. But they can’t establish a new reputation until those oversized monsters are gone. Kill them and reap the rewards.
490.objectives: Kill enough Huge Scorpions and then talk to Basileiou in Peloponnesus.
490.title: [Lv200]Scorpions of Doom I

491.completion: Killing Huge Scorpions is your business, and business is good!
491.details: You did a great job killing those Huge Scorpions earlier, but guess what? A new generation has hatched and they are meaner than their parents! Slay those cold-bloodedbeasts before they take over Peloponnesus permanently!
491.objectives: Kill enough Huge Scorpions and then talk to Basileiou in Peloponnesus.
491.title: [Lv200]Scorpions of Doom II

492.completion: The long reign of terror by those Huge Scorpions is finally over!
492.details: The Huge Scorpions are back! I don’t know what providence protects them, but you can end it now. Kill these maximized monsters once and for all! Peloponnesus is counting on you!
492.objectives: Kill enough Huge Scorpions and then talk to Basileiou in Peloponnesus.
492.title: [Lv200]Scorpions of Doom III

493.completion: By slaughtering all those Boas, you have avenged my stolen lunch. My lunch and I thank you.
493.details: I used to love Boas, but then one of them ate my lunch! Now I hate them all and want them dead! Nobody eats my lunch and gets away with it!
493.objectives: Kill enough Boas and then talk to Basileiou in Peloponnesus.
493.title: [Lv200]Boa-cide I

494.completion: Every time a Boa dies, an Spartan baby survives the night. Thanks to you, the children of Peloponnesus are smiling today.
494.details: I’m starting to feel bad about killing all those Boas but there’s no turning back now! Drive them out of Peloponnesus and we’ll both be heroes. Well, you will at least.
494.objectives: Kill enough Boas and then talk to Basileiou in Peloponnesus.
494.title: [Lv200]Boa-cide II

495.completion: Because of you, the secret that I am part snake will be buried with all those Boas you killed.
495.details: I just found out I’m part Boa. Apparently, my great-great-grandfather married a snake. Oh the shame! If this ever got out, I’d be ruined! Finish off these gossipy serpents before one of them blabs my family secret!
495.objectives: Kill enough Boas and then talk to Basileiou in Peloponnesus.
495.title: [Lv200]Boa-cide III

496.completion: I can’t remember the last time I saw so many Toxic Scorpions slaughtered. You’re a maniac, but in a good way.
496.details: Toxic Scorpions are dumb. There’s no other way to put it. In fact, they’re so dumb that killing them is an act of mercy. Do the humane thing and put as many of those dumb Toxic Scorpions out of their misery as you can.
496.objectives: Kill enough Toxic Scorpions and then talk to Koronos in Peloponnesus.
496.title: [Lv200]Scorpion Slaughter I

497.completion: It will be a long time before those Toxic Scorpions recover from the smackdown you just handed them. They never saw it coming!
497.details: I remember you! You’re the Toxic Scorpion killer. Wow, you really slaughtered a lot of those dumb beasts. But there’s more. There’s always more. The time to kill more Toxic Scorpions is now. Why? Because they’re so dumb, that’s why!
497.objectives: Kill enough Toxic Scorpions and then talk to Koronos in Peloponnesus.
497.title: [Lv200]Scorpion Slaughter II

498.completion: Knock-knock. Who’s there? Toxic Scorpions. Toxic Scorpions who? Toxic Scorpions are dead, thanks to this Spartan hunter! Ha ha ha! Here’s your reward.
498.details: The relatives of those Toxic Scorpions you killed are looking for revenge. Better get out there and face them before they catch you off guard.
498.objectives: Kill enough Toxic Scorpions and then talk to Koronos in Peloponnesus.
498.title: [Lv200]Scorpion Slaughter III

499.completion: How did you kill all those Huge Skeletons? Bravery and skill? I don’t know what those things are, but I do know when to give a reward for a job well done!
499.details: When I was a child, a gang of Huge Skeletons attacked my head. I’ve never forgiven them for that and am now on a crusade to kill every Huge Skeleton I find. Help me fulfill this lifelong mission and you will be rewarded in kind!
499.objectives: Kill enough Huge Skeletons and then talk to Koronos in Peloponnesus.
499.title: [Lv200]The Bigger They Are... I

500.completion: Nice work! You really ripped the spines out of those skeletons!
500.details: When I was a child, a gang of Huge Skeletons attacked my... oh, you’ve already heard this story. Sorry, my hatred for bony bastards makes me forgetful sometimes. In any case, there are more of them walking around. I’ve got another reward, if you agree to help again!
500.objectives: Kill enough Huge Skeletons and then talk to Koronos in Peloponnesus.
500.title: [Lv200]The Bigger They Are... II

501.completion: Nothing pleases me more than knowing all those Huge Skeletons are dead. Let’s pause for a moment and really enjoy this. Okay, that’s enough. Here’s your reward.
501.details: Remember a long time ago when you agreed to drive away some Huge Skeletons for me? Wasn’t that fun? Want to do it again? Sure you do! Yay!
501.objectives: Kill enough Huge Skeletons and then talk to Koronos in Peloponnesus.
501.title: [Lv200]Bigger They Are... III

502.completion: A lot of hunters have promised to kill the Evil Wizards but either forgot about it or were too scared to do so. Not you!
502.details: Have you ever met an Evil Wizard? They are mean! I hate mean things! Kill those dastardly wizards before they get even meaner!
502.objectives: Kill enough Evil Wizards and then talk to Koronos in Peloponnesus.
502.title: [Lv200]Wizardly Wicked I

503.completion: I knew you would have no problem with those Evil Wizards. They’re all talk... and magic. And don’t forget the wicked hexes. Come to think of it, you’re lucky to be alive!
503.details: Evil Wizards aren't born that way. As children, they’re just a little cranky. By adolescence, they grow grumpy and sullen. It’s only when they reach adulthood that they become truly evil. Okay, lesson over. Time to kill them!
503.objectives: Kill enough Evil Wizards and then talk to Koronos in Peloponnesus.
503.title: [Lv200]Wizardly Wicked II

504.completion: For bravery above and beyond the call of duty, and for killing those Evil Wizards like a total badass, I present you with this nifty reward.
504.details: All these Evil Wizards are effecting the mood in Peloponnesus. People are starting to argue over the littlest thing. Maybe if you kill those magic-users, everyone will mellow out. It’s worth a try!
504.objectives: Kill enough Evil Wizards and then talk to Koronos in Peloponnesus.
504.title: [Lv200]Wizardly Wicked III

505.completion: Ding Dong! The Wizards are dead. Which old Wizards? The mean Dark Wizards! Ding Dong the mean Dark Wizards are dead!
505.details: Everybody knows that Dark Wizards make lousy friends. They’re just a nuisance and can only cause harm. Might as well kill them.
505.objectives: Kill enough Dark Wizards and then talk to Koronos in Peloponnesus.
505.title: [Lv200]Afraid of the Dark I

506.completion: It pleases me beyond measure to know that all those Dark Wizards are finally dead. Does this mean I have a problem? Maybe. In any case, here’s your reward!
506.details: Do you know the difference between an Evil Wizard and a Dark Wizard? Neither do I. But don't let that stop you from sending a few of the Dark variety to the next life!
506.objectives: Kill enough Dark Wizards and then talk to Koronos in Peloponnesus.
506.title: [Lv200]Afraid of the Dark II

507.completion: Hey, why did you kill all those Dark Wizards? Oh right, because I asked you to. My bad. Thanks for doing it! Ha ha!
507.details: Do you know what Peloponnesus needs? More Dark Wizards. NOT! One is one too many, so kill those heinous, wicked, evil, icky beasts! Bleargh!
507.objectives: Kill enough Dark Wizards and then talk to Koronos in Peloponnesus.
507.title: [Lv200]Afraid of the Dark III

508.completion: The Amazon Scouts of Nemea are gone! Long live the brave hero that killed them. And long live me for hiring the brave hero!
508.details: Nemea has long been known for its wonderful cuisine, beautiful vistas, and evil Amazon Scouts. One of these things is bad for tourism and it’s not the food or scenery. Make Nemea the paradise it was meant to be and kill those Scouts!
508.objectives: Kill the Amazon Scouts in Nemea.
508.title: [Lv50]Wanted: Amazon Scout

509.completion: Argolis used to be a haven for Robber Kelin, but not any more. You drove those jerks out for good! For all you do, this reward’s for you!
509.details: When people think of Argolis, they immediately think of Robber Kelin. This is driving down home prices, something the people of Argolis can’t afford. For real estate purposes, kill those robbers as soon as possible!
509.objectives: Destroy the Robber Kelin at Argolis.
509.title: [Lv70]Wanted: Robber Kelin

510.completion: It’s a dark day for Acadian Warriors in Nemea Forest. You shined a light on their evil and drove them back to the shadows of the Underworld.
510.details: The good news is that you're here. The bad news is so are the Acadian Warriors. I hate bad news and I hate Acadians. What are you waiting for? Go kill those warriors!
510.objectives: Defeat the Acadian Warriors at the Nemea Forest.
510.title: [Lv90]Wanted: Female Acadian Warrior

511.completion: Those centaurs won't be bothering us anymore. What a bloodbath! Your glory on the battlefield knows no bounds!
511.details: When the Centaur Warriors invaded Derveni, they soon turned that sleepy town into a hive of scum and villainy. The people have pooled their resources and are looking to hire someone to put those man-beasts in an early grave!
511.objectives: Eliminate the Centaur Warriors in Derveni.
511.title: [Lv110]Wanted: Centaur Warrior

512.completion: The lovely ladies of Thermopylae are happy to see those jezebel Persian Huntresses dead. They wish to express their thanks with this lavish reward.
512.details: Persian Huntresses are gorgeous women who attract every man they meet. This explains why the ladies of Thermopylae want them gone! Their jealousy has financed a handsome bounty for anyone who drives these huntresses out for good!
512.objectives: Destroy the Persian Huntresses at Thermopylae.
512.title: [Lv120]Wanted: Persian Huntress

513.completion: I’m sure the satisfaction of killing that Forest Warrior was the only compensation you seek. Ha! Just kidding. You should've seen the look on your face! Okay, here’s your reward.
