513.details: The people of Nemea are fed up with the Forest Warrior that lives there. Apparently, she’s a bad tipper and is always scowling, so hunt her down and take her out!
513.objectives: Kill the Forest Warrior of Nemea.
513.title: [Lv50]Wanted: Forest Female Warrior

514.completion: I saw you kill that Skeleton Mage. It was amazing! He begged for his life, but you weren’t hearing any of it. I’d sure hate to be your enemy! That being said, take this reward.
514.details: There lives a Skeleton Mage, somewhere near the Argolis Coast. He likes to dabble in witchcraft, and brag and bluster and boast. All of the people fear him, well if not all then certainly most. So kill this Skeleton Mage, and release his imprisoned ghost!
514.objectives: Kill the Skeleton Mage of Argolis.
514.title: [Lv70]Wanted: Skeleton Mage

515.completion: You killed the Jungle Minotaur in what experts are already calling the fight of the year!
515.details: For years, poets wrote about the nasty Jungle Minotaur of Nemea Forest. But now those poets are dead, and yet the Jungle Minotaur continues to live. That hardly seems fair, so kill this monster and reunite him with the poets he adored.
515.objectives: Kill the Jungle Minotaur of Nemea Forest.
515.title: [Lv90]Wanted: Jungle Private

516.completion: You made that Harpy cry like a baby. Ha! Derveni will always remember you as their greatest hero. Take this reward.
516.details: A storm hit Derveni and with it blew in a most notorious Harpy. She hides in the day and hunts the town at night. Like all harpies, she should be removed from the human realm. You’re the only one to do it!
516.title: [Lv110]Wanted: Harpy

517.completion: The Persian Archmage is dead! That lousy punk owed me money. I probably should have collected before you killed him. Oh well, my loss.
517.details: The Persian Archmage of Thermopylae is public enemy number one! He’s a dangerous scoundrel with no regard for our noble Grecian ways. Hunt down and kill this magic user like the dog he is!
517.objectives: Eliminate the Persian Archmage of Thermopylae.
517.title: [Lv120]Wanted: Persian Archmage

518.details: Welcome to Sparta, young friend. You've come at the right time. Sparta needs your help! Our soldiers have been struggling to maintain the peace here, but everyday there's some new menace that must be dealt with. Do your duty and help defend Sparta! Go talk with Acacia for more information on what you can do to help. He is just behind me with an exclamation mark over head.
518.title: [Lv1]New to Sparta

519.completion: Wow, what a strong new soldier!
519.details: finally got a true hero willing to step up. The village leader will certainly be very glad to see you. Go see him as soon as possible to see what plan Ares has in store for us,. Press the Q key to unfold the quest pane and then click the name of the village leader, Ares will then guide you towards him automatically.
519.objectives: Unfold the quest pane and use the autotrack function to automatically move towards [Village Leader]Stefanos.
519.title: [Lv2]Meet the Leader

520.completion: Good job! This piece of gear is now yours.
520.details: Glad to know you are ready to help Sparta! Your first mission is to eliminate the Dumb Wood Men that are wandering near the northern edge of the forest. No one knows what strange magic gave them life, but they must be stopped before they get too close to the village.
520.objectives: Kill 10 Dumb Wood Men and then go talk with [Village Leader]Stefanos.
520.title: [Lv3]Dumb Wood Men

521.completion: Well done! You certainly are skilled with a weapon.
521.details: You've got a powerful weapon. Why not try using it? The Wooden Puppets nearby have been creeping closer to the village. No one knows who created them or why they move on their own. Why not use your new weapon to chop them down? When you're done, pay Acacia a visit. I've heard he has received some new information.
521.objectives: Kill 12 Wooden Puppets and then go talk with Acacia.
521.title: [Lv4]Polishing a New Blade

522.completion: Alright, get ready to learn a new spell.
522.details: I've recently received a secret report about Green Snakes in the forest acting strangely, including attacks on farmers. I want you to help investigate what is going on. Before you do this, first pay [Skill]Thisbe a visit to upgrade your skills.
522.title: [Lv5]Before an Investigation

523.completion: Hey, how did you know what I wanted you to do?
523.details: Did You come here to investigate the Little Snakes? Listen to me, kill any Little Snakes you see, immediately. I believe Acacia will be very happy with you if you can do this.
523.objectives: Kill 12 Little Snakes and then talk to Acacia.
523.title: [Lv6]Eliminate the Little Snakes

524.details: I think I've found some clues into the plot behind what's happening. The Litte Snakes were not driven crazy without reason. Something—or someone—is stirring unrest in the forest. Please go deep into the woods to investigate and eliminate the source. For now, clear out the more aggressive Snakes in the area. When you are done, report to [Village Leader]Stefanos.
524.objectives: Kill 15 Snakes and then report to [Village Leader]Stefanos.
524.title: [Lv7]Plotting Behind the Scenes

525.completion: Huh, the village leader sent somebody to look for me.
525.details: As expected, some Persians are making trouble. The Persians have been planning an invasion for a long time, but I still never expected them to send a force so deep into our territory. We must find the leader of this group before they become an even bigger threat. Go talk with the villagers nearby and see if you can find any clues. Start with [Warehouse]Savva, she often brings goods through the forest, so she may know something.
525.title: [Lv8]Capture the Ringleader

526.completion: These tails might give us clues about their strange behavior. Good work.
526.details: They slithered through the grass, spreading fear and confusion. I panicked and ran back to the village. These weren't ordinary snakes — they were Little Snakes, acting strangely aggressive. We need to know more. Go and kill some of them, and bring back a few Snake Tails so we can examine what's going on.
526.objectives: Kill 15 Little Snakes and collect 5 Snake Tails. Then report to [Village Leader]Stefanos.
526.title: [Lv9]Little Snakes and Their Tails

527.completion: If Juno’s Box was truly broken open... we may face greater horrors soon.
527.details: They say some ancient relics should never be disturbed. One such artifact, Juno's Box, was hidden deep in the forest long ago. But now, something has awakened — and the cursed boxes themselves have begun to appear. I fear the seal may have been broken. Go and destroy them before more danger spills out.
527.objectives: Kill 15 Juno's Box and then report to [Village Leader]Stefanos.
527.title: [Lv10]Juno's Box

528.completion: With Addiya defeated and the cursed treasures gone, the forest can finally breathe again.
528.details: The disturbances in the forest all trace back to Addiya the Destroyer, a powerful wielder of dark magic and the leader of the Persian invaders. What’s more troubling is the discovery of fake treasures scattered across the land—cursed objects meant to lure and weaken brave warriors like you. End this by defeating Addiya and destroying all the cursed treasures. Bring a trusted friend—this is no ordinary task.
528.objectives: Kill Addiya the Destroyer and destroy 8 Fake Treasures, then report to [Village Leader]Stefanos.
528.title: [Lv11]Kill Addiya the Destroyer

529.completion: Now all Spartans know there is a new hero in their midst. It is you, the hero who discovered the Persians' plot and kept our beautiful city safe. This badge is your reward.
529.details: What an exciting moment! You deserve everybody's worship, as well as some rewards! Head over to the main city and pay [Sage]Neo a visit. He will tell you about real glory!
529.title: [Lv12]Spartan Savior

530.completion: Get ready right now. No more gossiping.
530.details: There is trouble brewing in the suburbs. Though we've sent quite a few people out to deal with it, we need more help. Please do us a favor and head out to the suburbs to talk with Inspector Nolan and find out more about the current situation.
530.objectives: Head to the suburb to pay a visit to Inspector Nolan.
530.title: [Lv13]Trouble in the Suburbs

531.details: There have been a lot of reports of wolf sightings in the eastern farmland. They rush in a devour everything in sight. There's even a report of them stealing fish from a fishermen. Do us all a favor and drive these hateful wolves away.
531.objectives: Kill 20 Woodland Wolves and then report to Inspector Nolan.
531.title: [Lv14]Annoying Woodland Wolves

532.details: Some obstinate Persian spies have made their way to the suburbs with the intent to continue their plan of sabotage and terror. It seems you didn't get all of 'em when you eliminated all the Persians in the main city of Sparta. Now you must finish the job. Eliminate the remaining Persians.
532.objectives: Kill 20 Persian Spies and then report to Inspector Nolan.
532.title: [Lv15]The Persians' Struggle

533.completion: Great, we've recaptured the woodlands and our farmland.
533.details: Some bandits have been staging raids in the east woodlands and farmlands. Please drive them away.
533.objectives: Kill 15 Peninsula Bandits and 15 Bloodthirsty Blademasters, and then report to Inspector Nolan.
533.title: [Lv16]Recapturing the Woodlands

534.completion: Was Nolan the one who asked you to come here?
534.details: Don't be too proud of recapturing the woodlands. Many farmlands in the suburbs are also in danger. Go west and ask Farmer Layland if he needs some help.
534.title: [Lv17]Farmer Layland

535.details: Garr the Fiend has been up to no good in the eastern mountains for a long time now. Rumor has it he practices dark magic up there, but no one knows for sure. Nobody has ever been able to capture him either, despite many attempts and a large bounty on his head from the Spartan capital. Maybe you should give it a try, you seem to be able to accomplish things others cannot on a regular basis.
535.objectives: Defeat Garr the Fiend and then claim rewards from the board.
535.title: [Lv20]Wanted: Garr the Fiend

536.details: I think Scorpion Lord Alzet must be lurking somewhere in the northwestern woodlands. He is definitely a great threat to travelers in the area. Whoever kills him will be rewarded handsomely.
536.objectives: Defeat Scorpion Lord Alzet and then claim rewards from the board.
536.title: [Lv20]Wanted: Scorpion Lord Alzet

537.completion: Hmm, the situation is changing quickly. Perhaps they will be useful after all.
537.details: I don't know where the strange creatures in my farmland come from. Some of them look like flowers and some have the heads of oxen and the bodies of men. I am scared and unsure about whats going on. Please go see whats wrong and bring me back some clues.
537.objectives: Kill 1 Flower Pixie and 1 Minotaur and then report to Farmer Layland.
537.title: [Lv18]Hidden Troubles

538.completion: Right click on the egg to begin hatching the pet. Warriors and Champions should strongly consider taking a Minotaur as a pet, while Mages and Priests should take a Flower Pixie.
538.details: Though the creatures look very strange, you can easily tame them and then force them to serve as your pet if you manage to capture them using a certain tool. Take a tool and attempt to capture some.
538.objectives: Capture 1 Flower Pixie and 1 Minotaur and then report to Farmer Layland.
538.title: [Lv19]Tame Them!

539.details: Thanks for helping me, but would you mind also helping my buddy, Kozma? If you can, please also get rid of any scorpions you see along the way.
539.objectives: Kill 20 Suburban Scorpions and 20 Gold Tipped Scorpions, and then go talk with Farmer Kozma.
539.title: [Lv20]A Gift for Kozma

540.completion: Well done! I am less worried, but I still need a favor.
540.details: My friend hasn't forgotten about me! Getting me someone so capable to help is very good. The lions nearby keep trying to eat me! Please get rid of them before I wind up as dinner.
540.objectives: Kill 30 Silver Mane Lions and then go talk to Farmer Kozma.
540.title: [Lv20]Too Much Trouble

541.completion: Cool, now I can go home.
541.details: Why am I here? It's all the fault of those annoying dragons. They've taken over my hut and took my fishing pole. Would you please drive them back to the sea?
541.objectives: Kill 25 Sea Dragons and 25 Young Sea Dragons, and then report to Fisher Calisto.
541.title: [Lv20]The Seaside Dragons

542.completion: Great, that's just what I've been looking for.
542.details: Are you attempting to eliminate those terrifying dragons nearby? If you really want to do it right, would you please bring me some dragon eggs? It's said their eggs have some peculiar uses, like preserving heat.
542.objectives: Get 10 Dragon Eggs for [Skill]Theophilus. Press the M key to unfold the map and then click the specified words to move towards the quest area(116, 145) automatically.
542.title: [Lv21]I Want Dragon Eggs

543.completion: Many thanks! This gem is for you.
543.details: I do appreciate the favor, but could you please help eliminate the Vicious Fawns in my farmland?
543.objectives: Kill 30 Vicious Fawns and then report to Farmer Kozma.
543.title: [Lv22]Vicious Fawns

544.completion: Many thanks! This gem is for you.
544.details: I am worried about my buddy, Kozma. There are too many dragons occupying his farmland. Their claws turn the earth and destroy crops. Please help get rid of them.
544.objectives: Kill 30 Brown Dragons and then report to Fisher Calisto.
544.title: [Lv23]Brown Dragons

545.details: You've mastered a rich variety of skills for coping with difficult situations. In the western part of the suburbs, there are a lot of strange flying weapons which have been making trouble. Please destroy all of them.
545.objectives: Destroy 30 Fluttering Swords, 30 Animated Axes and 30 Wild Spears, and then report to Farmer Kozma.
545.title: [Lv24]Flying Weapons

546.completion: You are far stronger than I'd imagined.
546.details: I am not sure whether the young dragons have something to do with Red Dragon Puluo, but I know their leader is Divine Staff Selayan, who is very tough. If you wish to beat him, you'd better get somebody to help you.
546.objectives: Kill [Elite]Divine Staff Selayan and then talk to Farmer Kozma.
546.title: [Lv25]Kill Divine Staff Selayan

547.completion: Many thanks. We will never forget you.
547.details: The real source of all the trouble is Gordon. He has been occupying the suburbs for a long time and almost all the evil creatures in the suburb are under his control. Unless he is slain, the suburbs will never be at peace. Get somebody to help you before you fight him and watch out for his tough guards.
547.objectives: Kill Gordon and then deliver the good news to Farmer Kozma.
547.title: [Lv26]Gordon Must Die!

548.details: Report the situation here to Gerasimou in Peloponnesus and ask them to be on high alert.
548.objectives: Report the situation here to Gerasimou in Peloponnesus.
548.title: [Lv27]Peloponnesus

549.completion: Thanks, but could you do me another favor?
549.details: Were you harried by any boa along the way? As a matter of fact, lots of Plains Boas have been harassing travelers there for a long time. This is probably because we're focused more on fighting against the Athenians in the north. Now we must spare some time to deal with these terrifying creatures.
549.objectives: Kill 35 Plains Boas and then report to Gerasimou.
549.title: [Lv28]Clear the Way

550.completion: Good job. Now report to the official nearby.
550.details: What the hell is going on? Why are there so many beasts becoming violent and uncontrollable? The Huge Scorpions in the lowlands have been particularly troublesome. Please eliminate them before more travelers get hurt.
550.objectives: Kill 35 Huge Scorpions and then report to Gerasimou.
550.title: [Lv29]Huge Scorpion Threat

551.completion: Are you coming to help us?
551.details: Peloponnesus is right in the middle of an intense battle and in dire need of help from strong warriors like you. Basileiou will be very pleased to see your coming to help us.
551.objectives: Head to Peloponnesus and pay Basileiou a visit.
551.title: [Lv30]Reinforcement

552.details: I know Gerasimou asked you to eliminate the wasps along the way, but I don't think you'll be able to stop the attacks unless their source is dealt with. I've discovered that a nest of Toxic Scorpions has appeared in a camp to the south. Would you like to pay them a visit?
552.objectives: Kill 40 Toxic Scorpions and then report to Basileiou.
552.title: [Lv31]Toxic Scorpions

553.completion: You are much stronger than I'd imagined!
553.details: Though you've done what Basileiou asked you to do, it doesn't work unless you slay the leader. Their leader is Sharon, a brutal mage. To break his influence completely, you’ll also need to gather remains left from his followers—ten bones should do. Go find him and kill him, and make sure you bring someone to back you up.
553.objectives: Kill [Elite]Brutal Mage Sharon and collect 10 Bones, then report to Muropis.
553.title: [Lv31]Sharon Must Die!

554.completion: You are everything they said you would be!
554.details: Not only must the threats inside the camp be dealt with, but the Huge Scorpions roaming the outskirts are becoming a serious hazard. Their venomous stings endanger both soldiers and supply lines. Head out and eliminate them before they cause further harm!
554.objectives: Kill 40 Huge Scorpions and then report to Koronos.
554.title: [Lv31]Huge Scorpions

555.completion: Wow, you are a really great fighter!
555.details: Have you ever been caught in a giant web? Or seen a spider the size of a man? If not, I suggest you go check the Huge Spiders nearby. Their numbers are growing, and people are getting nervous. If you could get rid of them, you'd be doing everyone a favor.
555.objectives: Kill 40 Huge Spiders and then report to Meges.
555.title: [Lv31]Spiders Attack!

556.completion: Huh, were they using forbidden magic?
556.details: The wizards to the west have been acting strange lately. Their power seems to have grown, and they've become far more aggressive, attacking travelers without warning. Something dark is stirring among them. Please investigate and stop them before things get worse.
556.objectives: Kill 40 Irascible Evil Wizards and then report to Varnava.
556.title: [Lv31]Irascible Evil Wizards

557.completion: You've earned it. This mount is now yours.
557.details: Greetings! Do you wish to become a true knight? If this is your goal, the first thing you must have is a proper mount. You may buy one from me or earn one by proving your strength—hunt down the fierce Boas that roam the northeast and bring back the Snake Fangs as proof of your valor.
557.objectives: Kill 100 Boas and collect 10 Snake Fangs, then claim your reward from [Props]Aithra.
557.title: [Lv40]Knighthood 101 I

558.details: Once you've got a proper mount, you are still not qualified to call yourself a 'knight' because you can't ride it yet. Learning to ride a mount can be difficult, but if you can do something for me, I'll teach you the riding skill. Prove your determination by eliminating the Toxic Scorpions that have been causing trouble in the northeast.
558.objectives: Kill 100 Toxic Scorpions and then claim your reward from [Props]Aithra.
558.title: [Lv40]Knighthood 101 II

559.completion: Well done. This silk will serve its purpose.
559.details: You've done some great things, but your work is far from over. Dangerous spiders have overrun the plains to the north, threatening travelers and wildlife alike. I need you to clear out these spiders and bring back a sample of their Spider Silk as proof of your deeds.
559.objectives: Eliminate the spiders and bring Spider Silk to Muropis as proof. Press the M key to unfold the map and click the specified words to move towards the quest area (0, 0) automatically.
559.title: [Lv32]Spider Silk Recovery

560.details: Did you see Athenian Captain Mills when you fought against the Athenian Cadians? He is their leader. Just kill him, and they'll stop fighting. What are you waiting for? Go take care of him and let's end this!
560.objectives: Kill Athenian Captain Mills and then report to Muropis.
560.title: [Lv33]Fight for Sparta!

561.completion: You’ve done well—these relics reek of dark power. I’ll have them destroyed. Prepare for your next task.
561.details: The problems with the Athenians are ongoing, but disturbing news has emerged about an evil wizard corrupting the lands near Peloponnesus. His dark magic has twisted the creatures in the area, and he must be stopped. Defeat him and recover 10 Cursed Relics from his ritual site to break his hold.
561.objectives: Defeat the Evil Wizard and collect 10 Cursed Relics. Then report to Muropis.
561.title: [Lv34]Cursed Wizard's Relics

562.completion: Those Bone Shards are humming with foul energy... You did well to bring them back. There's more to be done.
562.details: A massive skeletal figure has been seen wandering the outskirts of Peloponnesus. Its presence alone strikes fear into nearby villages. Whatever force animates this creature must be vanquished. Defeat the Huge Skeleton and gather 8 Bone Shards left from its body.
562.objectives: Kill the Huge Skeleton and collect 10 Bone Shards, then report to Muropis.
562.title: [Lv35]The Bone Shard Menace

563.completion: These seals... they're remnants of forbidden rites. I know what's wrong.
563.details: I know you've dealt with strange foes before, but the Dark Wizards are unlike anything we've faced. Their magic is corrupting the land. Defeat them and bring back the Cursed Seals they carry. We may uncover the source of this corruption.
563.objectives: Kill Dark Wizards and collect 10 Cursed Seals, then report to Muropis.
563.title: [Lv36]Cursed Magic

564.completion: Great, the hidden threat in Peloponnesus has finally been taken care of.
564.details: I am certain that these evil creatures are in thrall to Sate Lord Kross. Kross was once one of the most decorated and honorable Spartan warriors, but since he was revived by that evil necromancer during a fierce battle, he has been hostile and overly aggressive, even to close friends. He is now a threat and must be eliminated, along with his guards.
564.objectives: Kill Sate Lord Kross as well as 60 Dark Wizards, and then report to Muropis.
564.title: [Lv37]Sate Lord Kross Must Die

565.completion: Welcome to Nemea. This is the battlefront in our struggle against those Athenian weaklings.
565.details: Thanks to you, the battle for Peloponnesus has been won and we con finally focus on the fierce fighting still going on in Nemea. Go to Nemea and meet with General Antilochos. He will be very glad to see you.
565.objectives: Head to Nemea and pay a visit to Antilochos.
565.title: [Lv38]Battle in Nemea

566.details: Kill 10 Athenian Frontline Soldiers on the battlefront, and I will reward you.
566.title: [Lv70]Athenian Frontline Soldiers

567.details: Some Athenian Frontline Patrols are carrying some especially good wine. They won't appreciate it as much as we will. Kill them and take the wine.
567.objectives: Loot wine from the Athenian Frontline Patrols.
567.title: [Lv70]Enemy Wine is Delicious

568.details: Wow, you must be very brave since you're here on the battlefront. But are you brave enough to fight against any hostile adventurer that crosses your path? We'll see, go defeat a hostile Level 70+ player and you will be rewarded.
568.objectives: Defeat a player Level 70 or higher.
568.title: [Lv70]Fight to the Death 1

569.details: Wow, you must be very brave since you're here on the battlefront. But are you brave enough to fight against any hostile adventurer that crosses your path? We'll see, go defeat a hostile Level 75+ player and you will be rewarded.
569.objectives: Defeat a player Level 75 or higher.
569.title: [Lv70]Fight to the Death 2

570.details: Wow, you must be very brave since you're here on the battlefront. But are you brave enough to fight against any hostile adventurer that crosses your path? We'll see, go defeat a hostile Level 80+ player and you will be rewarded.
570.objectives: Defeat a player Level 80 or higher.
570.title: [Lv70]Fight to the Death 3

571.details: This is the most critical time of the battle. We must strike now and kill their General and secure victory!
571.title: [Lv70]Checkmate

572.completion: Great, now I can have a nice Spring Festival. Here is a Spring Festival Firecracker for you, but I need more goods. Can you get me more?
572.details: In order to enjoy a peaceful Spring Festival, we must defeat the Lunar Beast. This is not too difficult, but it is not without dangers. To get started we must first lure it out. People say the best way to lure this monster out from the shadows is with Spring Festival Firecrackers. This is where you come in. I need some special goods for Spring Festival, and if you bring them to me I will reward you with Spring Festival Firecrackers. You can recapture my special goods for the Spring Festival from the Spring Yetis in the suburbs or get some from others.
572.objectives: Recapture Spring Festival Greetings Cards, Preserved Hams and Rice Cakes from the Spring Yetis in the suburbs for the Spring Merrymaker in the main city.
572.title: [Lv20]Festival Firecracker

573.details: The flames of war have spread beyond the boundaries of Athens and Sparta. Surely in this chaotic world there must be someone we can trust, a reliable ally. Lately, I've been tied up by ... pressing matters. Could I entrust you with the noble task of helping someone in Thebes? You may take a shortcut through the transporter or via Derveni.
573.title: [Lv130]A New Ally

574.completion: You've got skill, I'll give you that. But don't get too proud. This is only the beginning.
574.details: Your heroic deeds have spread across all of Greece. Indeed, I feel honored meeting you in person. Formalities aside, we do have some problems that may need urgent attention. Those Theban scum have recently set up an encampment and have been raiding us aggressively. If you would do us a favor by destroying them, perhaps it would make this alliance more justifiable.
574.objectives: Eliminate 200 Theban Spearmen, then return to Nestor.
574.title: [Lv130]Thebes' Worries

575.completion: What can I do for you, friend?
575.details: Has Mycenae allied with Sparta? Hurry to Oedipus to find out!
575.title: [Lv130]Mycenae and Sparta?!

576.completion: Finally, the time has come to settle this man-to-man! Let's prepare for battle!
576.details: As Kreon suspected, they have allied their forces, and are intent on attacking us. Hurry to deliver a message to Mycenae - by killing the Mycenaean Maulers!
576.objectives: Slay 200 Mycenaean Maulers, and report to Oedipus.
576.title: [Lv130]Face Off!

577.completion: It's great running into a fellow homelander in this area!
577.details: Jason in Sparta has sent countless messengers before you. Podaleirios arrived here a few days ago. As friends of Sparta, we have provided him the greatest of comforts. If you're free, drop by his quarters. I'm sure you'll have a dozen things to talk about.
577.title: [Lv130]Another Spartan

578.completion: They seem reliable enough. Well then, let's work on the terms of the alliance.
578.details: Thebes is preparing to forge an alliance with us, but first, we need to remove an imminent threat - Mycenaen forces approach as we speak. Take out their captain.
578.objectives: Slay Mycenaean Swordsmen and the Mycenaean Vanguard. Then, report to Hippolytus.
578.title: [Lv130]Proof of Sincerity

579.completion: You have eliminated Thebes' worries for now - hurry to my father, Theseus, to tell him that Thebes will join forces with Athens against Mycenae and Sparta!
579.details: You have eliminated Thebes' worries for now - hurry to my father, Theseus, to tell him that Thebes will join forces with Athens against Mycenae and Sparta!
579.objectives: Look for King Theseus in Athens to deliver the good news.
579.title: [Lv130]Forging an Alliance

580.completion: We're glad to see you here! Come, we have much to do!
580.details: Thebes is our ally now - go forth, and aid their cause! You are easily one of our most trusted warriors!
580.title: [Lv130]Back To Thebes

581.completion: Are you here to assist me?
581.details: Please help - my daughter, Ismene, seems to have found something curious nearby. Can you check it out?
581.title: [Lv131]A Request

582.completion: Not bad! I couldn't have done better myself!
582.details: Oh no, it's nothing serious - the Ravenous Deers have been rather aggressive of late is all. Can you find out why?
582.objectives: Slay 200 Ravenous Deers, and report to Ismene.
582.title: [Lv131]Ravenous Deers

583.details: My observations tell me that the recent changes in the environment are not by coincidence. Tell Kreon of our findings.
583.title: [Lv131]To Kreon

584.completion: Masterfully done! I am proud of you!
584.details: The Centaur Bandits have been attacking us under someone's orders. We have no idea who, but we'll deal with these unruly bandits first.
584.objectives: Slay 200 Centaur Bandits, and report to Kreon.
584.title: [Lv131]Hidden Dangers

585.completion: Do you have some good news? Why don't you tell me about it?
585.details: Tell Ismene that our worries are over.
585.objectives: Tell Ismene of the good news.
585.title: [Lv131]Some Good News

586.completion: Well done! Stick around a bit. I might have another task for you to handle.
586.details: Kreon brings good news indeed, but it isn't over - the Amazon Raiders must too be eliminated.
586.objectives: Eliminate 200 Icy Basilisks, then return to Hygeia.
586.title: [Lv131]Counterattack!

587.completion: Looks like you still have much to learn.
587.details: You see those Vagrant White Bulls over there? They're responsible for the recent turn of events.
587.objectives: Slay 200 Vagrant White Bulls, and report to Tiresias.
587.title: [Lv132]Vagrant White Bulls

588.completion: We are surrounded by enemies, both near and far. There is much at stake.
588.title: [Lv132]More Information

589.completion: Looks like you're not just brute and muscle; you have good stamina too!
589.details: Centaur Bandits and Amazon Raiders are running amok all over Thebes, attacking anyone in sight. You must do something!
589.objectives: Slay 100 Centaur Bandits and Amazon Raiders in Thebes, and report to Polynices.
589.title: [Lv132]Enemy of Distant Zone

590.completion: You'd a long day. Take a rest for now. Our other tasks can wait.
590.details: Attention! At ease! You have done well, soldier. Report to Tiresias, and take a rest.
590.title: [Lv132]A Rest Between Tasks

591.details: Vagrant Brown Bulls are getting out of hand. You know the drill.
591.objectives: Slay 200 Vagrant Brown Bulls, and report to Tiresias.
591.title: [Lv133]Vagrant Brown Bulls

592.completion: Perfect timing! I need you to do me a small favor.
592.details: The Mycenaens seem to prefer using wild animals as their troops of late. Talk to Polynices and see what he thinks.
592.title: [Lv133]Mycenae's Plot

593.completion: Among all my friends, you may not be the best, but you are certainly the strongest!
593.details: There has been a host of weird and aggressive monsters found in Mycenae of later - they must be eliminated!
593.objectives: Slay 100 Vagrant White Bulls and Vagrant Brown Bulls in Thebes, and look for Polynices.
593.title: [Lv133]The Expedition

594.completion: You're alive! Thank the gods, you're alive!
594.details: Fine work! Look for Tiresias for your reward!
594.title: [Lv133]Victory!

595.completion: Congratulations, my friend. I hope to see you again sometime soon.
595.details: Nothing can express the gratitude and admiration I have for you, but I must try. Here, this is for you. Take it!
595.title: [Lv133]Rewards

596.completion: What in blazes? Who called you here?!
596.details: Jocasta and I have... conflicting interests, but we do have a common goal. The revived soldiers are controlled by some dark magic, and Jocasta will be able to tell you more.
596.title: [Lv134]The Undead?

597.details: Eurydice sent you? Well, the enemies at hand are countless, but we 've gotta start somewhere.
597.objectives: Slay 200 Undead Raiders and report to Jocasta.
597.title: [Lv134]Not Staying Dead

598.completion: How did you know about me?
598.details: Killing them doesn't solve the problem at all - they feel no pain, and they keep coming! Seek Rhadamanthus for help.
598.title: [Lv134]A Search for a Solution

599.completion: You've got them? Great! Let's continue the research.
599.details: Oh, those! Are you having trouble with them? You are just in time. I have been researching an effective way to shut them down, but I'm out of samples. Perhaps you could get me some?
599.title: [Lv134]Undead Creature Swatch

600.details: I believe I can find the source of this dark magic now. Tell Jocasta of this; I'll be there shortly.
600.title: [Lv134]Hope for Good News

601.completion: Good. Now we can await further news with fewer woes.
601.details: Rhadamanthus needs TIME to invesigate? We don't have time! Go out there, and keep those undeads at bay!
601.objectives: Slay 200 Undead Halberdier and report to Jocasta.
601.title: [Lv134]Defend and Destroy

602.details: This dark magic probably has something to do with Immortal Nolsan. Tell Jocasta!
602.title: [Lv135]The Findings

603.details: Immortal Nolsan? That is an ancient evil, for lord's sake. I refuse to delve further - seek Eurydice instead.
603.title: [Lv135]Terrible Tidings

604.details: If you wish to lift this dark magic, there is but one way - to FACE this evil. Destroy the Death Mages to weaken his power.
604.objectives: Slay 200 Death Mages and report to Eurydice.
604.title: [Lv135]Weakening

605.details: Bring your comrades, and let's bring Immortal Nolsan down for good!
605.title: [Lv135]The Battle

606.completion: You deserve this, though I do feel somewhat saddened.
606.details: Rhadamanthus would be overjoyed to know that the curse has been lifted!
606.title: [Lv135]Death Of An Immortal

607.completion: I knew you could do it.
607.details: This is unfortunate news indeed. The undead are still wreaking havoc. I have received word that faraway Thebes is still very much plagued by them. Most of them are powerful mages. If you are confident of your ability to face these undead, please lend Mycenae a hand.
607.objectives: Wipe out the undead monsters in Thebes.
607.title: [Lv136]It's Not Over Yet!

608.details: I sense the mastermind's frustration... talk to Polynices.
608.title: [Lv136]More Terror Awaits

609.details: ...it's Soul Harvester Maxxi! I can sense him!
609.title: [Lv136]Soul Harvester Maxxi

610.details: This ought to be the final battle against the undead. Go to Thebes and kill Immortal Nolsan. End this once and for all!
610.title: [Lv136]Once and for All

611.completion: Wonderful tidings indeed! I'm heartened to see such courage and valor. You will be handsomely rewarded!
611.details: This is grave news indeed - you should speak to King Kreon about this.
611.title: [Lv136]All's Well that Ends Well

612.details: This is but a small matter - speak with Oedipus.
612.title: [Lv137]An Easier Problem

613.completion: How can I help you, brave one?
613.details: She's wrong. The monsters plaguing us this time are no small matter. Sarpedon should know more about this. It would be best if you spoke to him.
613.title: [Lv137]Strange Monsters I

614.details: The Revived Khazra are moving in on us, so let's strike them before they strike us!
614.objectives: Slay 200 Revived Khazras, and report to Rhadamanthus.
614.title: [Lv137]Strange Monsters II

615.details: It's not over yet. More strange monsters have been sighted in Thebes. I'm afraid we need your help again.
615.objectives: Kill 200 Revived Khazra, and report to Rhadamanthus.
615.title: [Lv137]Strange Monsters III

616.completion: I'm truly grateful for your help.
616.details: Tell Oedipus that all is well again.
616.title: [Lv137]Peace for Now

617.details: I ran into the Lurking Mountain Scorpions when I was out hunting the other day - you MUST get rid of them!
617.title: [Lv138]Purple Dragons

618.completion: Ha! They will be really grateful for my help. Oh, um, your help, I mean.
618.details: There's been sightings of Lurking Mountain Scorpions in Thebes - we sure could give those Mycenaes a hand when it comes to a common enemy, can't we?
618.objectives: Head to Thebes and kill 200 Lurking Mountain Scorpions.
618.title: [Lv138]Ready to Help!

619.details: All this killing we've been doing has yet to hit the nail on its head. Speak to Oedipus.
619.title: [Lv138]The Elite Monster

620.completion: I feel sorry that things had to turn out this way, but still, thank you.
620.details: The true monster that needs killing is none other than Golden Scorpion Sukur. See it done!
620.title: [Lv138]The Broken Promise

621.completion: Did he ask you to find me again?
621.details: The Mycenaens are at it again... this time, with their mages. Speak to Oedipus.
621.title: [Lv139]Mycenaen Showdown

622.completion: I've always had great trust in your abilities.
622.details: The Mycenaens have sent out their strongest troops - the Mycenaean Female Mages. They don't stand a chance against you, right?
622.title: [Lv139]Theban Magic

623.details: They have a secret weapon... the Mycenaean Royal Sorcerer! Dare to challenge yourself?
623.title: [Lv139]Formidable Foes

624.details: Tell Kreon I've had enough of settling HIS troubles for him!
624.title: [Lv139]A Disgruntled Message

625.completion: It's time for the final battle.
625.details: Scorpion Lord Selket has finally shown himself... and belittle him not, for his very existence threatens the stability of this entire world! Destroy him you MUST!
625.title: [Lv140]Scorpion Servants

626.completion: By Zeus, you did it! You did! You did!
626.details: Are you ready? Have you rallied your comrades? This is an ancient god you will be facing. Its prowess is far beyond anything you have seen thus far. I won't be surprised if you lose the battle. However, know that only the greatest glory and rewards await your victory.
626.title: [Lv140]The Final Fray

627.details: The Mycenaens never learn - now, they're at it again with their Mycenaean Spearmen! Eliminate them!
627.title: [Lv130]Break Them

628.details: Mycenaean Maulers  make up the main force of Mycenae's strength. Eliminate them, and their advance will be stopped!
628.title: [Lv130]Hammer Time

629.completion: They should know who not to mess with now!
629.details: They've gone and sent out their palace guards - the Mycenaean Swordsmen! Crush them!
629.title: [Lv130]Rain of Blades

630.details: There will be no end to their brainless desperation if we don't put an end to their leader - the Mycenaean Vanguard.
630.title: [Lv130]Put-out

631.completion: That's right! Drive home the meaning of FEAR to them!
631.title: [Lv131]Pursuit

632.completion: All is going according to plan.
632.details: The Amazon Raiders must be put down! See to it.
632.title: [Lv131]Wretched Amazons

633.details: A pack of Vagrant White Bulls have been posing greater and greater threat to our villages! Get rid of them!
633.title: [Lv132]Wandering Threat

634.completion: They should be no threat anymore.
634.details: A pack of Vagrant White Bulls have been posing greater and greater threat to our villages! Get rid of them!
634.title: [Lv133]A Grave Matter

635.completion: Ha! Now they should stay down, literally!
635.title: [Lv134]The Undying

636.completion: You really showed them their place, literally!
636.details: Undeads again - need I say more?
636.title: [Lv135]Refusing To Die Too

637.details: No rest for the wicked! These defilers of the holy MUST be destroyed at all costs!
637.objectives: Head forth to Mycenae and eliminate 100 Undead Dark Mages.
637.title: [Lv136]A Long Arm

638.completion: More poems for you? No? Why not?!
638.details: Goats that don't stay dead are just plain nasty. See to it.
638.title: [Lv137]No More!

639.completion: You can run, but you can't hide! Ha!
639.details: Scorpions are bad. BAD, you know? Get rid of them!
639.title: [Lv138]Hidden

640.details: The Mycenaean Female Mages have been an absolute threat to Thebes - stop them, please!
640.title: [Lv139]Thebes' Judgement

641.completion: Now it should know who it's dealing with.
641.details: An ancient god resides in the recesses of Thebes - the Scorpion Lord! Kill his servants to tell him we're not to be trifled with.
641.objectives: Head forth to Thebes and eliminate 100 Scorpion Lord's Servants.
641.title: [Lv140]Showing Some Muscle

642.completion: You're getting the hang of this, aren't ya?
642.details: Things that don't stay dead are a HUGE pain in the rear. Try your best!
642.title: [Lv130]The Undying

643.details: The Mycenaean Female Mages are their best troops - the more we kill, the weaker they become!
643.title: [Lv133]Mycenae's Magic

644.details: The Scorpion Lord is our goal - but to get to him, we must first eliminate his numerous servants.
644.title: [Lv137]Weakening The King

645.completion: Your contributions shall not go unrewarded.
645.details: Sicily used to be a safe haven in its former glory, but it is now nothing but a cesspit of death and disease thanks to Hades! Head to the main city and look for the Event Transporter (use Auto Routing to locate the NPC with ease) to be transported to Sicily immediately.
645.objectives: Head forth to Sicily and kill 100 Gela Hunter. Then report to the Sicilian Refugee. (The Event Transporter can teleport you to Sicily instantly.)
645.title: [Lv131]Keeping It Clean (9)

646.completion: You have proven yourself a true warrior indeed. You have earned our gratitude, our trust, and our respect for your abilities. We are at your service, hero.
646.details: You have awoken us from our eternal slumber. You say you followed the goddess Persephone's clues to find this place? Very well. Prove your mettle to us by slaying Skeleton Captain York! Then relay the good news to the Sicilian Refugees.
646.objectives: Eliminate Skeleton Captain York to avenge the slain.
646.title: [Lv131]Summons (4)

647.completion: It is said that this monster has numerous clones of itself. We may yet need your help again.
647.details: Atlas, having lost his faith and sanity, went forth to amass a gigantic army of demons. Now they are camped in the Wonderland! Our scouts have reported a numerous sightings of savage demons in the ranks of Atlas' army, with Alpha Demon at the front line.  It's up to you, hero, to deliver our wrath upon these demons!
647.objectives: Enter the Wonderland instance via the instance NPC located in the main city and eliminate Alpha Demon.
647.title: [Lv120]Die, No. 1!

648.completion: Don't you ever get tired of swinging that blade?
648.details: The target... Undead Raider. The number... 1,000.
648.title: [Lv130]Wanted: Day Of The Dead

649.completion: Hope you had a good rest after all that killing! Whew!
649.details: The target... Undead Halberdier. The number... 5,000. Accomplish this and you will overcome your fear of scorpions - at least for THIS lifetime.
649.title: [Lv130]Wanted: No More Halberdier!

650.details: The Nemean Lion is a dire threat to our safety. It has been prowling around the settlements hunting for live human prey. You must make haste and remove this threat before it gets out of hand.
650.title: [Lv40]Help Needed

651.details: 500 Centaur Bandits need to die. Go!
651.objectives: Slay 500 Centaur Bandits in Thebes, and report to Rhadamanthus.
651.title: [Lv131]Ares' Prophecies (12)

652.details: 50 Ravenous Deers need to die. Go!
652.objectives: Eliminate 50 Ravenous Deers, and report to Rhadamanthus.
652.title: [Lv131]Gluttons

653.details: A certain individual in Mycenae threatens our safety. Head to Woods Watcher's Home, and do what you must.
653.title: [Lv130]King of the Woods

654.details: A certain individual in Mycenae threatens our safety. Head to Northern Flatland, and do what you must.
654.title: [Lv130]King of the North

655.details: A certain individual in Mycenae threatens our safety. Head to Southern Flatland, and do what you must.
655.title: [Lv130]King of the South

656.details: A certain individual in Mycenae threatens our safety. Head to Blood Tree, and do what you must.
656.title: [Lv130]King of the Trees

1000.completion: Well done! You certainly are no amateur when it comes to killing monsters.
1000.details: Greetings brave Athenian! You look like a fierce fighter, but you still must prove your valor. A pack of mischievous Crispy Wood Men are plaguing the outskirts of Newbie Village. Go there and kill 10 of them to show me what you can do!
1000.objectives: Kill 10 Crispy Wood Men and return to the Newbie Guide. Click the quest names in green text to start auto-track.
1000.title: [Lv200]Welcome to Athens!

1001.completion: Welcome back! You have earned my trust, as well as another quest!
1001.details: Word of your skill and courage has reached Ion, the head of Newbie Village. He wishes to speak with you about some challenging missions, if you are up to the task.
1001.objectives: Speak with Ion, the head of Newbie Village.  Click the character names in green text to start auto-track.
1001.title: [Lv200]Where's Ion?

1002.completion: Excellent work with those pesky deer.  I look forward to more heroic deeds from you in the future.
1002.details: You are a skilled warrior, but still have much to learn. To continue your training, slay 10 Little Deer just outside Newbie Village and then report to [Skill]Thisbe.
1002.objectives: [original quest brief is inconsistant with quest description.]
1002.title: [Lv200]The Deer Hunter

1003.completion: Thank you for taking care of the Vipers.
1003.details: Defend the glory of Athens by slaying the monsters in the Suburbs!
1003.objectives: Destroy the Vipers in the Suburbs of Athens.
1003.title: [Lv200]Athenian Honor

1004.details: It seems that those Snakes were just the tip of the iceberg. Rid us of the Vipers hiding in the suburbs and I will see that you are handsomely rewarded.
1004.objectives: Help Demetrius to kill some  Vipers and then report to the [Round Quest]Main City Issuer in Athens.
1004.title: [Lv200]Viper Attack!

1005.details: The Boas out here have been attacking many of the athletes. I heard from Demetrius that you are quite the snake wrangler. Can you get rid of the Boas for me?
1005.objectives: Help Iakovou to kill some  Boas, then report to the [Round Quest]Marathon Issuer.
1005.title: [Lv200]Snake Wrangler

1006.completion: Hey, I've heard of your achievements. I am the deputy Village Head of the Starting Area. Every day I stand here to greet heroes like you. I am so excited to finally meet you!
1006.details: What do you think of this Starting Area? Its surely lost some of its charm when all the monsters moved in. Would you please give my message to Ion, the one with a ponytail? Tell him the monsters have all cleared out. For your information, my friend, he is the Village Head of the Starting Area. And he is one of the advocates of Apollo!
1006.objectives: Talk to Ion, the head of the Starting Area.
1006.title: [Lv5]Pay a Visit

1007.completion: Yeah, I am Thisbe, the Skill Merchant here! What, you didn't know?
1007.details: If you have any trouble, ask others for help. Now go to talk with [Skill]Thisbe , she has a lot of praise for you!
1007.objectives: Talk to [Skill]Thisbe in the Starting Area of Athens.
1007.title: [Lv5]Start training

1008.completion: You did a good job, you have definitely earned these skill points!
1008.details: Want to learn some skills? There are two kinds of skills, active skills and passive skills. Active skills must be learned from specialized books while passive skills require accumulated skill points. You can do some practice to earn experience. There are many Little Deer outside the Starting Area, would you catch some for me? All big heroes develop from basic training - like deer hunting.
1008.objectives: Clear the Little Deer outside the Starting Area,and return to have a talk with [Skill]Thisbe.
1008.title: [Lv6]More challenges

1009.completion: Oh weary traveler, your bag is weighing you down! I am [Warehouse] Belen, deposit your things with me and I will keep the safe. Withdraw them for free from any of my fellow Warehouse colleagues.
1009.details: News travel fast in this place, and I have spoken about you with [Warehouse] Belen in great length. Go talk to him - but don't go empty handed. The Little Bees in his region have increased to a plague-like level. Kill some to show your sincerity.
1009.objectives: Kill some Little Bees outside the Athens Starting Area and talk to [Warehouse] Belen.
1009.title: [Lv200]The Warehouse

1010.completion: You have done well, and many have requested your help. Now lend your strength to the troubled citizens in this area. They will reward you handsomely.
1010.details: You have done well here, young hero. But I hear the Newbie Guide has some news for you and wants you to go back. Return to him at once. It must be important!
1010.objectives: Speak with Newbie Guide in the Newbie Village in the main city.
1010.title: [Lv200]Return to the Guide

1011.details: Your arrival is timely, for the Village Head had recommended you to assist the Main City of Athens. Go find Ion for more details.
1011.title: [Lv200]Recommendation

1012.completion: Greetings, I am Zander, an Officer of Athens. We are seeking heroes to join our war against Sparta. Every Athenian must do their part!
1012.details: Recently, the city’s official, Zander, has asked me to gather some young talented warriors for a mission. I think you’d be a good fit for it. Bring this reference letter to Zander, and he’ll fill you in on all the details. Before you hit the road, can you help clear some Little Snakes along the way?
1012.objectives: Clear some Little Snakes outside the Athens Starting Area amd talk to Zander.
1012.title: [Lv200]Zander's Snakes

1013.completion: My troops know that I am a man of few compliments. But you did well, young hero.
1013.details: Before we strike Sparta, you must first demolish the Wasp infestation outside the city. Defeat them and bring back 10 stingers to prove yourself!
1013.objectives: Clear some Wasps outside the Starting Area of Athens, and bring 10 stingers to Zander.
1013.title: [Lv200]Zander's Test

1014.completion: Welcome, recruit! May the Gods bless you!
1014.details: I recently sent a message to Meletiou in Athens and I believe you should speak with him. Since you don’t know your way around, bring up the Quest window and go to the Search tab. Search for his name to find him.
1014.title: [Lv200]Searching for Meletiou

1015.completion: What is this, some kind of a joke? I thought I had asked for someone with more experience! Well, I guess you'll have to do... but you won't be fighting any Spartans looking like this. Heh!
1015.details: Welcome to Athens, citizen! I'll bet you've never been to a place like this before. Make your way aroundthe city and get to know the streets. Say, if you're interested, you should head to the Recruits Camp. The Captain of the Guards, Neocles, has a task for you.
1015.title: [Lv200]The Main City

1016.completion: Well done, recruit! This is the kind of hard work we're looking for! Here, you earned this!
1016.details: The Athenian citizens near the starting area are being terrorized by a swarm of Wasps. I need you to clear those insects out of here. I wouldn't be surprised in the least if this was the work of Elis up in the North.
1016.objectives: Clear the Wasps from outside the Athens Starting Area, and then return to talk to Neocles in the main city.
1016.title: [Lv200]Athens Is All A "Buzz"!

1017.completion: Ha! Yeah, I guess you can say I'm a bit of a joker. But hey, it's good for morale, right? Here, this was passed down to me by some of the great warriors of Athens. I think it might do you some good.
1017.details: There is no such thing as a one man battalion, so be prepared to make friends with your comrades. You might also want to get aquainted with Azanes. He's helped a lot of the new recruits in the past.
1017.title: [Lv200]Meet the Troops

1018.completion: Well, hi there. Would you like to try something off of the menu? This might be your last chance, since I'm closing my shops to hide from the monsters! If only there was a way to take care of them.
1018.details: The whole city is panicking about the monster infestation. Bubassus the chef is losing his mind over this. What a coward, he's even thinking of packing up and leaving the city! What will the citizens eat without him? Do you think you can talk him out of moving away? Tell him anything you want. Just make sure he stays!
1018.objectives: Find the Chef Bubassus and put his mind at ease.
1018.title: [Lv200]The Troubled Chef

1019.completion: So, any luck getting the chef to stay?
1019.details: What? You'll get rid of all these monsters? Well, if you're sure you can, I guess I'll stay. Oh, I'm so glad you're doing this for me. Tell you what. How would you like to be my personal bodyguard? I've got to prepare a lot of food for the Festival of Athena and just can't risk any of these monsters ruining this!
1019.title: [Lv200]The Chef's Bodyguard

1020.completion: Well done! You might be even stronger than I was at your age!
1020.details: So, Bubassus needs a bodyguard, huh? Ha ha! What a coward! You know, it's the Lamia's Dressing Boxes that are really getting to him. They're causing all sorts of trouble in the suburbs. If you get rid of those fiends, he'll be much more willing to stay in the city! Come back after you've slayed those monsters.
1020.objectives: Destroy the Lamia's Dressing Boxes and talk to Azanes.
1020.title: [Lv200]Azanes' Advice

1021.completion: My word! Did you really destroy all of those nasty toothy things? Fantastic! Here, let me reward you for all of your hard work.
1021.details: Nicely done. Now show them to the Chef! But don’t hold them too close to him or he might get scared again! Haha!!
1021.objectives: Talk to chef Bubassus in Athens.
1021.title: [Lv200]The Chef's Surprise

1022.completion: *Sniff sniff* Did Chef Bubassus send you? I know he did. You smell like you're just fresh out of his kitchen! What's that? He made this for me? How sweet of him! Thank you for bringing it!
1022.details: At last, it's complete. Would you mind taking one to my darling, the beautiful Hybla? She is truly breathtaking. Don't you go falling in love with her now. Ha ha.
1022.objectives: Talk to Bubassus' love, the Tailor Hybla.
1022.title: [Lv200]Lunchtime Delivery

1023.completion: Are you the Tailoress Hybla's assistant? Please tell me you've brought the gloves!
1023.details: Say, while you're here, may I ask a favor of you? Senator Kreion has asked that I make a pair of gloves for him but I'm afraid I'm short on supplies. Would you mind informing the Senator that his order has been delayed? I could have more supplies delivered if only the roads weren't teeming with monsters.
1023.objectives: Talk to Senator Kreion in Athens.
1023.title: [Lv200]Helping Hybla

1024.completion: Oh dear! Had I have known I would have made these gloves my top priority. Thank you for telling me this!
1024.details: Oh no, this is quite disastrous. If this was my order, I would have no complaints about waiting. But unfortunately, they were ordered for Meletiou the Executor to use during the Happy Ceremony. Please tell Hybla that I insist that they be finished on time!
1024.title: [Lv200]Rush Delivery

1025.completion: Wonderful! This will most definitely be enough material to finish the gloves! How sweet of you!
1025.details: Unfortunately, I still haven't received the new batch of Viper Skin that I need to finish the gloves. Luckily, there are lots of Vipers slithering around the city. Would you mind getting 8 Viper skins for me to complete these gloves?
1025.objectives: Defeat the Vipers to collect 8 Viper Snake Skins for Hybla.
1025.title: [Lv200]Emergency Supplies

1027.completion: Hmm? What could a youngster like you want with such a a boring old fogey like myself?
1027.details: Ah, a weight has been lifted from my shoulders! Now I can get back to preparing for the Happy Ceremony. There's so much to do and so little time! Actually, can you please tell Mr. Hesper, my law expert, that I need to speak with him immediately?
1027.title: [Lv200]The Senator's Envoy 1

1028.completion: ...The manuscript? How did you hear about that?
1028.details: Ah, so my old friend Amvrosiou needs me again? Ha ha! He'd be helpless without me. Well, I would like to go but I'm afraid I'm busy searching for my Manuscript. I've looked all over. Hmm... perhaps my student Nausipahnes has taken it. No matter what, I must find it! It's very rare and was made from the sacred Nile's Sedge. Well, I guess it would be best if I didn't keep the Senator waiting too long. Would you mind searching for my Manuscript while I'm away?
1028.title: [Lv200]The Lost Manuscript

1029.completion: Oh, how forgetful of me. I've been so busy lately that I'd forget where I put my head if it wasn't attached to me! I just spoke with Senator Kreion and will gladly join his speech group tp bring peace to Athens. Surely even the Goddess Athena herself will bless our mission. You may be unaware, but a secret war is raging between Athens and Sparta. We must end it!
1029.details: Well, of course I have his manuscript. I told him I was going to borrow it before I left! But he's getting older now, and his hearing is plain terrible when he's busy. Could you please explain to Mr. Hesper that I have his Manuscript?
1029.title: [Lv200]The Manuscript

1030.completion: Ah, you're back! I am very pleased to hear that Hesper will be joining me for the Happy Ceremony. Here, take this for your hard work.
1030.details: If we had time, I'm sure you and I could hold an excellent debate! But it will have to wait until I resolve my writer's block and complete the speech. That reminds me, can you tell the Senator I'll see him soon?
1030.objectives: Talk with Senator Kreion in Athens.
1030.title: [Lv200]The Naggy Tutor

1031.completion: Sure. I can fix the Parthenon. To be honest, I'm not a big fan of Senator Kreion. But I've heard good things about you and all the good you've done.
1031.details: Another important figure is Master Polyclitus. I need him to repair the Parthenon before the Happy Ceremony commences. Would you please go to speak with him for me?
1031.title: [Lv200]The Senator's Envoy 2

1032.completion: Well what do you know. Great job, kid!
1032.details: I'm currently doing some research on skeletons but I'm running out of usable materials. Can you bring me three complete Skeletons? I hear there are several roaming around the Suburbs.
1032.objectives: Defeat and collect three Skeleton in the suburbs and bring them to Polyclitus.
1032.title: [Lv200]Bare Bones Research

1033.completion: What? How dare he refuse such a glorious task? Any other Athenian would be thrilled!
1033.details: What's that? Oh, right, the repairs. You know, now that I think about it, I really don't have the time. Surely, the Senator can understand that.
1033.title: [Lv200]The Sculpter's Scullduggery

1034.completion: A perfect life is just a man and his saw. What do you need from me?
1034.details: Don't worry, I'm not angry. I recall that Polyclitus has a good friend called Alns who lives in the Athens Starting Area. Perhaps he can convince his stubborn friend.
1034.objectives: Talk to Alns in the Athens Starting Area.
1034.title: [Lv200]The Senator's Advice

1035.completion: Why did Alsn send you? My troubles with Alexiou is my business. Has that sneaky warrior been spreading rumors about me?!
1035.details: Heh, I see Polyclitus is being stubborn again. Very well, I will talk to him. While I'm gone, can you visit Nemodes the ironsmith? His loud quarrel with [Warrior]Alexiou is driving me mad.
1035.objectives: Talk to Nemodes in the Athens Starting Area.
1035.title: [Lv200]The Carpenter 1

1036.completion: Stingy? I never said such a thing! Ever since he became friends with Dionysus, he has had too much wine at his disposal!
1036.details: Listen here, I will tell you the true story behind my anger. I had sent Alexiou a gift a few days ago, and yet that ungrateful god still dares to call me stingy! I swear by Athena's name that I will never forgive this!
1036.objectives: Talk to $Alexiou in the Athens Starting Area.
1036.title: [Lv200]Angry Nemodes

1037.completion: ...Those are his words? It seems I have overreacted to silly rumors. Yes, I will make him a new weapon as an apology. And I will make one for you also, little one!
1037.details: No, I will be the bigger man and end the misunderstanding. Nemodes has been very irritated lately. Please send my good wishes to him.
1037.objectives: Talk to Nemodes in the Athens Starting Area.
1037.title: [Lv200]Alexiou's Defense

1038.completion: I knew he would come to his senses, heh heh. Thank you for all your leg work!
1038.details: Here, may this little number assist you in your bold adventures! But before you leave, can you send my apologies to Alexiou? I am too embarassed to face him.
1038.objectives: Talk to Alexiou in the Athens Starting Area.
1038.title: [Lv200]The Jolly Ironsmith

1039.completion: That was quite a trip, I'm about to lose my voice from all the debates!
1039.details: I heard Alns is back from his visit to Polyclitus and is looking for you. You may want to head his way soon.
1039.objectives: Talk to Alns in the Athens Starting Area.
1039.title: [Lv200]The Carpenter 2

1040.completion: *Sigh* So much to do, so little time...
1040.details: Thank you for taking care of Nemodes. Now go see Polyclitus. I believe you will find good news.
1040.title: [Lv200]The Carpenter 3

1041.completion: Aha! Excellent. This must be the map for the hidden statue! But these ancient words mean nothing but gibberish to me...
1041.details: The Skeletons outside the village found out about my Skeleton model and have taken upon themselves to seek revenge! My precious Titan statue is no where to be found. You must return it to me!
1041.objectives: Defeat the Skeleton to find clues about the missing item.
1041.title: [Lv200]Pesky Thieves

1042.completion: Why, greetings, child. There is a sparkle in your eyes that resembles my dear friend Plato.
1042.details: No, this map is not the Skeletons' work. They are incapable of such feats! For now, we need the wisdom of [Priest]Saizeriya. He is the most learned scholar in all of Athens.
1042.objectives: Talk with Priest Saizeriya in Athens.
1042.title: [Lv200]The Decipherer

1043.completion: What are you doing with that map?
1043.details: A map, you say? Hmm... these symbols are ancient letters from Crete, and they seem to lead to some type of treasure. This is very sophisticated. Even the ink is of rare origin! No, this could not be the work of Skeletons. I believe an Athenian made this. If I am correct, Alns was once very fond of this ink.
1043.objectives: Talk to Alns in the Athens Starting Area.
1043.title: [Lv200]The Detective

1044.completion: You're looking for the statue? Well, you've come to the right place.
1044.details: Yes, I took his statue. But before your eyebrow raises further, let me explain! I was jealous that the Senator had only invited Polyclitus for the preparations. A sculptor can't complete a project alone you know! Anyway, I intended on returning it to him a few days later, but I misplaced the map and could not remmeber the statue's whereabouts. Can you find it? You should ask Belen for help. He was my accomplice.
1044.objectives: Talk to [Warehouse]Belen in the Starting Area of the main city.
1044.title: [Lv200]The Carpenter 4

1045.completion: Alns and Belen? I never would have thought. Well, at least it is safe. Thank you.
1045.details: Yes, Alns asked me to hide the statue. I knew he didn't really want to take it, he was just jealous of his friend. So I put it in the warehouse. Anyway, please don't think badly of Alns. Tell Polyclitus he can get it from me any time.
1045.title: [Lv200]The Carpenter 5

1046.completion: Feh! The trouble one must go to in order to get good help these days!
1046.details: Well, thank you very much for this wonderful news! No need to worry, I'm not actually angry at anyone. I'll gladly help with the project. Please tell Kreion that he'll have my assistance.
1046.title: [Lv200]A Moldable Sculptor

1047.completion: Ah, yes! I sensed you would be in need of my visions.
1047.details: Ah, how fortuitous to have someone as skilled as Polyclitus leading the repair project! Unfortunately, I'm afraid I must punish Alns for his foolishness by making him do all the painting for the ceremony!                                                Now, may I as you for another favor? There's a great athelete who lives on Marathon Plain. I need you to find him. If you need more clues on his whereabouts, talk to Dionigi
1047.objectives: Gather information from Dionigi about the athlete.
1047.title: [Lv200]The Senator's Envoy 3

1048.completion: Thank the Gods you came! My herd were so frightened.
1048.details: Ah, yes! I know of whom you seek. He is mighty hero, is he not? I know where he spars but first, you must assist me with something in return. There are several Huge Spiders tormenting the Shepherds and their flocks. Slay these beasts, and speak with the Shepherd Spyridon. He will tell you what to do.
1048.objectives: Defeat the Huge Spider and talk with Spyridon at Marathon.
1048.title: [Lv200]The Prophet's Parlor

1049.completion: Oh, hello there. What's that? Spyridon thinks I have his sheep?
1049.details: I am so sick of all these monsters! And now one of my sheep has gone missing. Can you help me search for him? My only hope is that Penelope took it on a stroll. Please be careful where you look. There are several snakes in these fields.
1049.objectives: Defeat the Boa and talk with Penelope at Marathon.
1049.title: [Lv200]Snakes on the Plains

1050.completion: Oh, help! There's a poor little sheepy in danger!
1050.details: I'm afraid I haven't seen this lost sheep as of late... I hope he was not devoured by the monsters. Oh, that would just be terrible! My sister Circe has also gone missing. Please, while you're looking for that poor sheep, keep an eye out for my sister too.
1050.objectives: Find Circe at Marathon.You must reach level33before delivering this quest.
1050.title: [Lv200]The Sisters 1

1051.completion: Oh no... this is sheepy's wool!!! Nooo!!
1051.details: Penelope is looking for me? She must be worried sick. Oh dear, I'll be in deep trouble when I go home! But I can't go back yet. Not until I know this sheep is safe from all of those Vicious Wolves. Won't you please do something?
1051.objectives: Defeat the Vicious Wolves. Then, talk to Circe at Marathon.
1051.title: [Lv200]The Sisters 2

1052.completion: Oh dear, that was our family's favorite sheep. I'll give Spyridon the bad news.
1052.details: I've cried away all my strength... Please let my sister know that I'm alright, and give my brother the sad news. I'll be home after a little rest.
1052.title: [Lv200]The Sisters 3

1053.completion: Ahh! Please help! One of those evil Vipers just bit me!
1053.details: Wait, Circe is still out there! It's getting ever so late and there are wicked monsters out there. Please tell her to come home!
1053.title: [Lv200]The Sisters 4

1054.details: It hurts so much! Am I dying? Please! Find Dorotheou the doctor! He'll know what to do.
1054.objectives: Talk to Dorotheou in the Starting Area of the main city.
1054.title: [Lv200]The Viper Strikes!

1055.completion: Oh... good... I was beginning... to worry.
1055.details: You got here just in the knick of time! This is my very last Antidote. Here, take it and hurry. Even if the Snake's venom does not kill her, the pain is unbearable. I just hope I can get more medicine before this happens again.
1055.title: [Lv200]Is there a Doctor in the house?

1056.completion: Hah! Foul serpents! These beasts are growing more ferocious every year!
1056.details: Oh, I am much better now. While you were away, Spyridon cleaned the wound with some olive oil and sheep's wool. But he was so upset and has rushed into the forest to hunt down the Boas! Please make sure he's alright.
1056.objectives: Find Spyridon.You must reach level35before delivering this quest.
1056.title: [Lv200]The Missing Brother

1057.completion: Unbelievable. Spyridon was bitten as well? I'll make the antidote right away.
1057.details: Ah... I'm afraid those vile monsters got the best of me... do you have more antidote? What's that? No more? Then you must act quickly!. Kill the Boas and take a sample of their venom to the doctor. Hurry!
1057.objectives: Collect Venom from the Boas and take it to Dorotheou at the Athens Starting Area.
1057.title: [Lv200]Natural Remedies

1058.completion: Well, you know what they say. Just what the doctor ordered, eh?
1058.details: There, that ought to do the job. Take this antidote to Spyridon quickly!
1058.title: [Lv200]Help Is On The Way!

1059.completion: Fantastic job! Once again, you've earned this.
1059.details: Thanks a lot, friend. What's that? You're looking for a great athlete? Well, here I am. Don't look so shocked! I was a legend in the arenas before I took to tending the flocks. Tell you what, let Kreion know I'll be glad to be there.
1059.objectives: Talk with Senator Kreion in Athens.
1059.title: [Lv200]The Athletic Shepherd

1060.completion: Hello there, soldier. Well haven't you become a fine civil servent. That's not necessarily a compliment. Heh heh.
1060.details: Well it looks as though my party is assembled! This is most splendid! Say, while you were out, your old commander Captain Neocles was looking for you. Why don't you pay him a visit.
1060.title: [Lv200]The Senator's Envoy 4

1061.completion: Hey, it's not safe to travel out here alone.
1061.details: Recent scouting reports show that one of the main trade routes is blocked. I need you to investigate this. Before you go, speak with Gerrhus. He's the Vanguard Captain in Marathon. He'll have more information for you.
1061.objectives: Talk with Gerrhus at Marathon.You must reach level37before delivering this quest.
1061.title: [Lv200]Traffic Patrol

1062.completion: Just as Hercules slayed the Nemean Lion, you have demolished these big cats as well! Bravo!
1062.details: The trade routes have been growing increasingly unstable. In fact, Syos the merchant was just attacked! What's worse, a pride of Huge Lions near the trade route is preventing our advance. Help us!
1062.objectives: Defeat the Huge Lions and talk to Gerrhus at Marathon.
1062.title: [Lv200]Into the Lions Den

1063.completion: Who goes there? Gerrhus sent you? Fine. Have a look at this.
1063.details: Vice Captain Crophi sent an envoy while you were away. He says he's uncovered information that may help us clear the roads. I cannot leave this camp. You will have to assist him.
1063.objectives: Talk with Crophi at Marathon.You must reach level39before delivering this quest.
1063.title: [Lv200]A Vital Discovery

1064.completion: Well now, let’s hear what they have to say for themselves.
1064.details: Our scouts have spotted several bandits and theives along the trade route. According to witnesses, these are the same ruffians who have been attacking the merchants. Bring back these lawless Robber Lolos for interrogation.
1064.objectives: Fight off the Robber Lolos and return to Crophi.
1064.title: [Lv200]The Road Warriors

1065.completion: Grand work, soldier! You up for another challenge?
1065.details: It looks like these Lolos won't be causing trouble any time soon. You may return to Captain Gerrhus. I'm sure he'll be as proud of you as I am.
1065.title: [Lv200]Justice is Served

1066.completion: Well well. You just keep turning heads, don't you? Here, this skill book has helped me over the years. Let's hope it does you some good as well.
1066.details: We may have the upperhand now, but victory is never sure to last. Return to Guard Captain Neocles and inform him that we are in need of reinforcements.
1066.title: [Lv200]Reinforcements

1067.details: Heh! Leave it to those no good Robber Lolos to take advantage of a bad situation. To dispatch more men, I will need a direct order from General Barca. The men I have are needed to guard the city of Athens.
1067.objectives: Talk with Barca at Marathon.You must reach level44before delivering this quest.
1067.title: [Lv200]Authorizing Deployment

1068.completion: Take cover, kid. The front line ain't no plaground.
1068.details: Just hold on a second. We'll get to your problem soon enough. First, it has been months since I received word from Bias. Go to him and bring me his report. He is probably trapped by those darned Crocodiles.
1068.objectives: Clear out the Crocodiles from the Marathon Plain. Then, find Bias at Parnitha.
1068.title: [Lv200]A Load of Croc!

1069.completion: Hey there. What's that? Withdraw my squad?
1069.details: Reassign the men? During a WAR? I myself have been in need of reinforcements, but all communication to Athens have been lost. The only troop that can spare a few men belongs to Telemachus. Go check with him.
1069.objectives: Talk to Telemachus in the Parnitha.You must reach level47before delivering this quest.
1069.title: [Lv45]A Tight Situation

1070.completion: That should work well enough as a decoy.
1070.details: To be honest, we haven't seen action in a while. All this restlessness is bad for morale. But an open withdrawal will be a sign of weakness to our enemies. Take the men to defeat some wild Boars. Perhaps this will make the Spartans think we are merely hungry for meat.
1070.objectives: Get rid of enough $Boars and then talk to Telemachus in the Parnitha.
1070.title: [Lv47]What a Boar

1071.completion: I do like your armor. Is that the newest trend?
1071.details: Great job. Go and speak with Philander. His unit will return to Athens with you.
1071.objectives: Talk to Philander in the Parnitha.
1071.title: [Lv48]Soldiers to Spare

1072.completion: By Zeus' beard! What are you talking about?
1072.details: Well, how you doin' today? Say what? Telemachus wants me to go home? No! I re-re-refuse! I was just starting to have fun. Whee!
1072.objectives: Talk to Telemachus in the Parnitha.
1072.title: [Lv49]Philander's Phunny Games

1073.completion: My, oh my. A Chaos Spell you say?
1073.details: I've seen this before. Philander is under a Chaos Spell! We must cure him before anyone else notices. Quick, get Ctesias.
1073.objectives: Talk to Ctesias in the Parnitha.
1073.title: [Lv50]The Chaos Spell

1074.completion: Are you ready? I have worked out the solution.
1074.details: A Chaos Spell is no laughing matter. Well, maybe it is a little. Heh heh. But I know just the cure. Give me a moment...
1074.objectives: Talk to Ctesias in the Parnitha.You must reach level52before delivering this quest.
1074.title: [Lv51]Alchemy at its Finest

1075.completion: Yes, yes yes. An excellent job.
1075.details: What I need are some Willow Seeds. Unfortunately, you'll have to get them from the Witches Coven nearby.
1075.objectives: Clear away the witches and collect some Willow Seeds. Then, talk to Ctesias in the Parnitha.
1075.title: [Lv52]The Witch and the Willow

1076.completion: Why, yes I have the dispensing kit right here. What? He wants it back already?
1076.details: The potion needs time to complete. Meanwhile, will you find Iakovou in the Marathon Plain and get my Dispensing Kit? I will have the potion finished when you return.
1076.objectives: Talk to Iakovou in the Marathon Plain.
1076.title: [Lv53]Dispensing Kit

1077.details: Actually... I lent it to a guy called Panayiotis. He's in Parnitha. If you find him, you'll find the dispensing kit.
1077.objectives: Talk to Panayiotis in the Parnitha.
1077.title: [Lv54]Borrowing from Borrowers

1078.completion: Who? Pana-who? Well that's what I get for lending to scoundrels like Iakovou.
1078.details: I'm sorry. I was under the impression it belonged to Iakovou. Well if it must be returned to it's rightful owner then so be it.
1078.title: [Lv55]Paladin's Apology

1079.completion: No! I don't like medicine! It tastes yucky! Aaaahh!! *Gulp*
1079.details: Here we are. Run this potion out to Philander. He'll be fine.
1079.objectives: Bring the medicine to Philander.You must reach level57before delivering this quest.
1079.title: [Lv56]A Cure for Chaos

1080.completion: Ah, you've returned. I see you've been fighting Wizards and Witches. You're covered in magic dust!
1080.details: Wh-what happened? I can't remember anything, except I was fighting Witches and Wizards! Yes, I can send my squad back to Athens, but we cannot leave while these spellshapers are at large. Alas, I am still weak... surely you can get rid of them?
1080.objectives: Defeat the Dark Wizards and then talk to Telemachus in  the Parnitha.
1080.title: [Lv57]Philander's Awakening

1081.details: I'll easily be able to spare a few men now. But first, I need you to visit the north Megara Coast. I just received word that there are some intruders in that area. Head that way and meet with Iphicrades.
1081.objectives: Talk to Iphicrades in the Megara Coast.
1081.title: [Lv58]The Last Patrol

1082.details: My job is to patrol the border between Athens and Sparta. But the local citizens refuse to stay clear of this dangerous area. Can you make them leave? Find Serafim if you need help.
1082.objectives: Talk to Serafim in the Megara Coast.You must reach level60before delivering this quest.
1082.title: [Lv59]Border Patrol

1083.details: So you wish to be persuasive? I find that people like to follow those with unusual skills. If you wish to strengthen your reputation, defeat the Death Mages and bring me some Amber Pieces. I'll teach you how to conjour Thunderbolt Balls.
1083.objectives: Defeat the Death Mages and collect Amber Pieces. Then talk to Serafim in the Megara Coast.
1083.title: [Lv60]A Test of Might

1084.details: The leader of Megara is a man named Eyfimias. If you can convince him to redirect his men into military service, we will be much more united before our foes!
1084.objectives: Talk to Eyfimias in the Megara Coast.
1084.title: [Lv62]For Greater Good

1085.completion: Look at you. You must've come all the way from the Main City.
1085.details: Cooperate with those military goons? Hah! What we really need are the experienced Thracian fighters! If you want my trust, have a word with Sebastiane for me. Let him know his men will be paid handsomely.
1085.objectives: Talk to Sebastiane in the Megara Coast.
1085.title: [Lv64]Athens Militia

1086.details: Sure, we can help. But at a cost. Let's start with 100 Silvers. Bring that and we can talk.
1086.objectives: Bring Sebastiane 100 Silvers.You must reach level68before delivering this quest.
1086.title: [Lv66]Hired Help

1087.completion: Well, well, well. Looks like I picked the right side after all.
1087.details: This is more than enough to share with the boys. But you know, my men have families and we don't fight losin' battles! Athens or the Persians, we're still debatin'. Tell you what, if you can salvage some Melee Gear from those Mobs, we have a deal.
1087.objectives: Defeat the evil Mobs and bring back their Melee Gear. Then talk to Sebastiane in the Megara Coast.
1087.title: [Lv68]Proof of Power

1088.completion: Is that so? They really agreed to help us?
1088.details: Alright. Go and tell Eyfimias that we'll join his men. But make it quick! A great hero like me doesn't have all day. Heh heh heh.
