1088.objectives: Talk to Eyfimias in the Megara Coast.
1088.title: [Lv70]The Mercenaries

1089.completion: That's fantastic! Say, why aren't you Captain status yet?
1089.details: If Sebastiane is joining, my men will to. And I heard that Bias fella was looking for you. I'm sure he'll be pleased to hear about this. Athena be with you!
1089.objectives: Talk to Bias in the Parnitha.
1089.title: [Lv72]United Front

1090.completion: Alright, we're all ready to go!
1090.details: Go tell Philander to prepare his men to move out. Telemachus should also be ready about now.
1090.objectives: Talk to Philander in the Parnitha.
1090.title: [Lv74]Reassignment

1091.completion: Orders from Philander? I hope this isn't part of that Chaos Spell he was under.
1091.details: I've got some bad news, kid. Some of our enemys from Aegeas are hiding in the Parnitha. Those evil Persians are planning an attack on our capital from the sea. Head east and find the Guard out there. All are for Athens!
1091.objectives: Talk to the Guard in the Parnitha.
1091.title: [Lv75]Seaside Trouble

1092.details: I'm afraid I can't give orders. You'll need to speak with the Captain about this.
1092.objectives: Talk to the Captain in the Parnitha.You must reach level79before delivering this quest.
1092.title: [Lv77]Higher Command

1093.completion: That'll do just fine. And don’t worry. They won't go to waste. We can turn their hides into armor and use the bodies as sacrifices to the Gods.
1093.details: Alright. My men will begin patrolling the coasts. But first, I'll need you to get rid of the Crocodile Selous that are out there. Fish food don't make good soldiers, you know?
1093.objectives: Get rid of the Crocodile Selous and then talk to the Captain in the Parnitha.
1093.title: [Lv79]Crocodiles Rocked

1094.completion: Greetings, mighty hero! To what do I owe the pleasure?
1094.details: My men can easily guard the coastline now. Head to the nearby village and tell the Village Head not to be alarmed by the military reassignment.
1094.objectives: Talk to Village Head in the Parnitha.You must reach level82before delivering this quest.
1094.title: [Lv80]It Takes a Village

1095.completion: It is an honor to be in your presence. We owe you our eternal gratitude.
1095.details: By the power of Zeus, a hero stands before me. I know you must be very busy, but could you help us get rid of the Skeleton Warriors nearby? They are driving my villagers to the brink of madness!
1095.objectives: Fight off the Skeleton Warriors from the Megara Coast and then talk to the Village Head in the Parnitha.
1095.title: [Lv82]The People's Champion

1096.completion: Well done! I see our troops have kept you busy!
1096.details: I don't mean to sound ungrateful, but something continues to keep my villagers from returning home. Could you please report this crisis to Meletiou?
1096.objectives: Talk to Meletiou in Athens.You must reach level87before delivering this quest.
1096.title: [Lv85]Report to the Council

1097.completion: Oh! I am so relieved for your return!
1097.details: I have spoken with the Priest Saizeriya. He believes the root of the problem lies in the Skeleton Warlocks. I know that I can count on you to eliminate them. Please keep the Village Head informed on your progress.
1097.objectives: Fight the Skeleton Warlocks in the Megara Coast and then speak to the Village Head.
1097.title: [Lv87]Council's Orders

1098.completion: The Village Head's concerns are valid. I shall think more on this.
1098.details: No, no, no. It cannot be that easy. My village will not be safe until all intruders are gone! Please, you must tell Bias that I need more help!
1098.objectives: Talk to Bias in the Parnitha.
1098.title: [Lv89]Mr. Inconsolable

1099.completion: Greetings. I have heard much of your good deeds.
1099.details: Very well. I know what we can do to solve this problem. Deliver this letter to Aiputos in the Parnitha. He will have a solution. May the Gods protect you!
1099.objectives: Talk to Aiputos in the Parnitha.You must reach level91before delivering this quest.
1099.title: [Lv90]Aiputos, the Mighty!

1100.completion: Well done. We are extremely proud of you. Your name will echo throughout the ages!
1100.details: There have been reports of Illyria Brigands hiding out in the Plataea. Take a team of soldiers and eliminate them. Remember, you're defending more than just a Village today - you are defending all of Athens!
1100.objectives: Defeat the Illyria Brigands in the Plataea and then talk to Aiputos in the Parnitha.
1100.title: [Lv91]The Final Defense

1101.details: Did Neocles ask you to clear the Little Snakes outside of the Athens Starting Area? You'd better get to it!
1101.objectives: Clear some Little Snakes outside the Athens Starting Area and talk to Paris.
1101.title: [Lv200]Little Snakes, Big Deal

1102.completion: Outstanding! You have earned my respect!
1102.details: There are a lot of Bad Tempered Deer attacking the travellers in the Marathon Plains. I know a great hunter like you can thin the herd.
1102.objectives: Hunt the Bad Tempered Deer from Marathon Plain, then talk to Paris in Athens.
1102.title: [Lv200]Paris' Mission 2

1103.completion: You are the greastest hunter in all of Greece!
1103.details: There is a band of Dark Necromancers terrorizing the citizens at Parnitha. Please stop them before they kidnap more Villagers for their Army of Darkness!
1103.objectives: Defeat the Dark Necromancers in Parnitha, then speak with Paris in Athens.
1103.title: [Lv200]The Most Dangerous Game

1104.completion: Well, looks like you're quite the champion after all.
1104.details: Those accursed Skeleton Warriors have returned! My friend Paris told me your are quite skilled. Prove yourself and defeat this undead menace.
1104.objectives: Defeat the Skeleton Warriors along the Megara Coast. Then, speak with Acacia in the Newbie Village of the Main City.
1104.title: [Lv80]Orestes[1]

1105.completion: Aha! Athens is safe again! Well done.
1105.details: The Illyria Brigands are attempting a second assault on Athens. Go to the Plataea and stop them before they have a chance to strike.
1105.objectives: Prevent the Illyria Brigands in Plataea from attacking Athens a second time. Then talk to Acacia.
1105.title: [Lv90]Orestes[2]

1106.completion: Well done, my friend. You are quite the hero indeed.
1106.details: There is a class of Scholar Kals hiding in the Plataea. They are developing a plan to bring Athens to its knees. You must stop them from putting their plan in to action. Return to me when you are finished and you will be greatly rewarded.
1106.objectives: Stop the Scholar Kal in Plataea and then talk to Acacia in the Newbie Village of the Main City.
1106.title: [Lv100]Orestes: Back to School

1107.completion: Hello. What can I do you for?
1107.details: I heard that a mysterious treasure has been found. I am an archeologist and I would like to learn more about it. Help me ask Kreion about it.
1107.title: [Lv20]Treasure Hunt 1

1108.completion: Oh, would you like to know more about the treasure?
1108.details: Yes. We have sent someone to investigate it. You should go to find Barca in the Marathon Plain.
1108.objectives: Talk to Barca in the Marathon Plain.
1108.title: [Lv22]Treasure Hunt 2

1109.completion: Well done. However, I will take the treasure map. You can obtain other rewards.
1109.details: Oh, no. How did you know that I would like to find it? Ok, you have to kill all of those Robber Lolos.
1109.objectives: Get rid of enough Robber Lolos and take the map back. Then talk to Barca in the Marathon Plain.
1109.title: [Lv40]Treasure Hunt 3

1110.completion: Ah, safe at last! Thank you.
1110.details: Help! I was ambushed by some Dark Wizards. Please avenge me!
1110.objectives: Defeat several Dark Wizards and then talk to the Wounded Guard in the Parnitha.
1110.title: [Lv50]The Hurt Guard 1

1111.completion: What's the matter? What? Is he alright?
1111.details: Please tell my Captain to send help.
1111.title: [Lv60]The Hurt Guard 2

1112.completion: Well what do you know. You're much stronger than I was at your age.
1112.details: I need you to fill in for the injured guard. Some Pallas Pit Vipers have been spotted in the Megara Coast. Legend has it they can swallow people whole! I hope that's not true. Nonetheless, please chase them off.
1112.objectives: Clear Pallas Pit Vipers from the Megara Coast and then talk to Captain in the Parnitha.
1112.title: [Lv75]The Hurt Guard 3

1113.details: Hello. Can you do me a favor? Rumor has it there is a wine in Greece that can grant immortallity to whoever drinks it. Can you help me find it? You should ask Jacinta , the grogshop owner first.
1113.title: [Lv100]The Wine of Immortality 1

1114.completion: Alms for Oedipus! Alms for Oedipus! Oh, hello there. I didn't see you arrive.
1114.details: Yes, it exists. But to obtain it is no easy task! If you truly wish to know more, go to Parnitha and speak with Oedipus. He will tell you about Dionysus.
1114.objectives: Talk to Oedipus in the Parnitha.
1114.title: [Lv101]The Wine of Immortality 2

1115.completion: Oh no. Someone drank the wine. Now all we have is this shoddy cup. It's not even real jade!
1115.details: Ah, the Wine of Dionysus. It sits in a Jade Cup guarded by a pack of vicious Corinthian Boas. Defeat them and the the wine is yours.
1115.objectives: Get rid of the Corinthian Boas from the Isthmus of Corinth and bring the Jade Cup back. Then talk to Oedipus in the Parnitha.
1115.title: [Lv99]The Wine of Immortality 3

1116.completion: Well, what do they say about the queen? Off with her head, right?
1116.details: Greetings, warrior. You may not know of me, but I am Medea, and I watch over these lands. The Vicious Queen Nina has hurt many civilians. Please, end her reign of terror.
1116.objectives: Defeat [BOSS] Vicious Queen Nina near the suburb of Athens. Then talk to Medea in Athens.
1116.title: [Lv200]Vicious Queen Nina

1117.completion: Excellent work. You deserve every bit of your reward.
1117.details: Your valor is greatly admirable, and I have another bounty available if you're interested. The Frogs in Marathon Plain have become incredibly aggressive. I need you to reduce their numbers.
1117.objectives: Get rid of the Frogs from the Marathon Plain and then talk to Medea in Athens.
1117.title: [Lv200]List As Wanted 2

1118.completion: Your courage continues to amaze me.
1118.details: Your valor is greatly admirable, and I have another bounty available if you're interested. Recently, the Boar King Tomas has been raging uncontrollably. Put him in his place and you'll be handsomely rewarded.
1118.objectives: Defeat the [BOSS] Boar King Tomas in the Parnitha. Then speak with Medea in Athens.
1118.title: [Lv56]List As Wanted 3

1119.completion: Terrific. You freed the minds of many of the villagers. The rest will follow.
1119.details: Your valor is greatly admirable, and I have another bounty available if you're interested. A cult of Death Mages is hexing civilians in the Megara Coast and controlling the weak-minded for their evil biddings. Please, slay them and release the innocent citizens!
1119.objectives: Defeat the Death Mages in the Megara Coast and then talk to Medea in Athens.
1119.title: [Lv70]A Cult of Death Mages

1120.completion: You would do well as a member of our national security. Hmm..
1120.details: Your valor is greatly admirable, and I have another bounty available if you're interested. There is an unruly Mob in the Megara Coast attacking the locals. I know you can get rid of them. Come back when you're finished and collect the bounty.
1120.objectives: Disperse the Mob in the Megara Coast and talk to Medea in Athens.
1120.title: [Lv72]List As Wanted 5

1121.completion: Well an eye for an eye and whole world goes blind, right? I guess that's twice as bad for a Cyclops. Good work.
1121.details: Your valor is greatly admirable, and I have another bounty available if you're interested. A pack of lumbering Cyclops in the Plataea are causing trouble for the local guardsmen. Keep your eyes open and chase them back to where they belong!
1121.objectives: Chase back the blood thirsthy Cyclops from the Plataea. Then speak with Medea.
1121.title: [Lv90]The Eye of the Cyclops

1122.completion: Fee Fi Fo Fum! You made Alcyoneus look pretty dumb! Excuse my rhymes, your work has inspired me so. Thank you.
1122.details: Your valor is greatly admirable, and I have one last bounty for you. The Giant Alcyoneus is pillaging the residents of the Plataea. There is no better candidate to rid us of this menace than you.
1122.objectives: Defeat the Giant Alcyoneus in the Plataea. Then talk to Medea.
1122.title: [Lv100]List As Wanted 7

1123.completion: Great! It's a gift for you.
1123.details: You are now level 10. I believe that you have some basic knowledge of the game now. Take my recommendation and find Gideon. He will guide you further into game.
1123.title: [Lv12]Hero's Skill 1

1124.completion: Great! It is a gift for you.
1124.details: Congratulations. You have leveled up. Go to find Gideon and claim your rewards.
1124.title: [Lv30]Hero's Skill 2

1125.completion: Great! It is a gift for you.
1125.details: We hope Athens can be peaceful and free forever. Kid, go to find Gideon. He is waiting for you.
1125.title: [Lv50]Hero's Skill 3

1126.completion: Great! It is a gift for you.
1126.details: Leveling up is like no other feeling. Know yourself. Gideon is waiting for you.
1126.title: [Lv70]Hero's Skill 4

1127.completion: Great! It is a gift for you.
1127.details: Are you ready? You can claim a Spell Book from Gideon now.
1127.title: [Lv90]Hero's Skill 5

1128.completion: You can choose one from the following items. But be careful. Choose wisely...
1128.details: Congratulations. You have shown yourself to be an outstanding warrior. Come to find me when you are ready.
1128.title: [Lv40]Warrior Guide 1

1129.completion: Great! It's a gift for you.
1129.details: You are now level 10. I believe that you have some basic knowledge of the game now. Take my recommendation and find Demetrius. He can guide you further into game.
1129.objectives: Talk to the Warrior Supplier Demetrius in Athens.
1129.title: [Lv12]Sadhu's Skill 1

1130.completion: Great! It is a gift for you.
1130.details: Congratulations. You have leveled up. Go to find Demetrius and claim your rewards.
1130.objectives: Talk to the Warrior Supplier Demetrius in Athens.
1130.title: [Lv30]Sadhu's Skill 2

1131.completion: Great! It is a gift for you.
1131.details: We hope Athens can be peaceful and free forever. Kid, go to find Demetrius. He is waiting for you.
1131.objectives: Talk to the Warrior Supplier Demetrius in Athens.
1131.title: [Lv50]Sadhu's Skill 3

1132.completion: Great! It is a gift for you.
1132.details: Leveling up is like no other feeling. Know yourself. Demetrius is waiting for you.
1132.objectives: Talk to the Warrior Supplier Demetrius in Athens.
1132.title: [Lv70]Sadhu's Skill 4

1133.completion: Great! It is a gift for you.
1133.details: Are you ready? You can claim a Spell Book from Demetrius now.
1133.objectives: Talk to the Warrior Supplier Demetrius in Athens.
1133.title: [Lv90]Sadhu's Skill 5

1134.completion: You can choose one from the following items. But be careful. Choose wisely...
1134.details: Congratulations. You have shown yourself to be an outstanding warrior. Come to find me when you are ready.
1134.objectives: Talk to the Warrior Supplier Demetrius in Athens.
1134.title: [Lv40]The Sage Guide 1

1135.completion: Hello, I am an Athenian priest. I am in charge of assigning Gods and worshippers. You can choose one from among the 14 Gods. Different Gods can help you in different ways. In addition, you can learn corresponding skills.
1135.details: Hello. Have you ever been on a pilgrimage to the temples?  That is where the Gods' statues are. Go to find Saizeriya and she will give you more information about these fascinating places.
1135.objectives: Talk to Priest Saizeriya in Athens.
1135.title: [Lv12]The Faith 1

1136.completion: Well done. May the Gods bless you! Come back to find Europa once you have reached level 30.
1136.details: At present, Athena is the patron and protector of Athens. In order to make sacrifices to her, we need more offerings. Can you go to catch several Wild Oxen, from outside the city?
1136.objectives: Get rid of enough Wild Oxen near the suburbs of Athens and then talk to the Priest Saizeriya in Athens.
1136.title: [Lv16]The Faith 2

1137.details: Hello. Do you have a favorite God? Do you know how to use their corresponding skills?
1137.title: [Lv30]The Faith 3

1138.details: Hello. Saizeriya asked me to prepare an offering for the sacrifice. Can you go to kill some Little Crocodiles and bring me their skins back?
1138.objectives: Kill some of the Little Crocodiles in the Marathon Plain. Take their skins back and talk to
1138.title: [Lv40]Sacrifice

1139.completion: Hello, weary pilgrim. I hope this journey has been enlightening for you.
1139.details: Say, have you ever completed the pilgrimage to the Megara Coast? If you would be so inclined, walk the path of Athena and meet with Serafim in the Megara Coast.
1139.objectives: Talk to Serafim in the Megara Coast.
1139.title: [Lv60]Pilgrimage to the Coast

1140.details: Ah! It must be good to be so young. I would have liked to travel everywhere in my youth. Of course that was a very long time ago. Are you busy now? I have many letters that need to be delivered to Athens. Please help me deliver this letter to Homer.
1140.objectives: Talk to Homer in the suburbs of Athens.
1140.title: [Lv10]Athens 1

1141.details: Humans need to work. Take it easy. Don't be nervous! Click confirm to accept my quest. Go to catch some Bad Tempered Deer in the Marathon Plain.
1141.objectives: Clear those Bad Tempered Deer from the Marathon Plain and then talk to Homer in the suburb of Athens.
1141.title: [Lv40]Athens 2

1142.completion: What's this? A letter from Homer? How thoughtful of him.
1142.details: Say, do you have some time to spare? My dear friend Aioutos has been sent to guard the Parnitha. Would you please deliver this letter to him?
1142.objectives: Deliver a letter to Aiputos in Parnitha.
1142.title: [Lv52]Homer's Mailed Odyssey

1143.completion: Epic Battle with an Epic Poet
1143.details: I need your help, friend. The General has sent word that there are several Skeleton Warlock amassing in the Megara Coast. I need you to kill them before the Spartan army takes advantage of a bad situation.
1143.objectives: Kill the Skeleton Warlocks on the Megara Coast and then talk to Homer in the Starting Area of the main city.
1143.title: [Lv80]To Protect and Sever

1144.completion: Ha ha! Well done! That will teach these greedy pigs not to double cross anyone ever again.
1144.details: I may be skilled with words but I am just as skilled with a sword. Will you fight alongside me? There are several Jaba Astrologists in the Isthmus of Corinth. Their thirst for wealth leaves no space for moral in their hearts. We must chase them out!
1144.objectives: Clear the Jaba Astrologists from the Isthmus of Corinth and then talk to Homer in the Starting Area of Athens.
1144.title: [Lv100]Smash Scheme

1145.completion: Excellent work! This will help keep our army strong.
1145.details: I'm in charge of supplying the Athenian Army, but our supplies are dwindling. I would be much obliged if you can bring me the pelts of some Vicious Wolves.
1145.objectives: Fight the Vicious Wolves on the Marathon Plain, collect 12 pelts and then talk to Ion in the Athens Starting Area.
1145.title: [Lv200]Sheep in Wolf's Clothing

1146.completion: Excellent work! This will help keep our army strong.
1146.details: Our army is preparing for war, but defense supplies are low. I need the 12 Buckteeth from the Wild Boars to build deadlier shields. Can you handle that?
1146.objectives: Fight the Wild Boars at Parnitha, collect 12 pairs of their Buckteeth, and then talk to Ion in the main city.
1146.title: [Lv49]Supply Drives: Long in the Tooth

1147.completion: Excellent work! This will help keep our army strong.
1147.details: Yes, you would be perfect for this next task. We need 12 beads from the stomachs of Pallas Pit Vipers$. They will make excellent shot weapons.
1147.objectives: Clear the Pallas Pit Vipers from the Megara Coast, get the bead and then talk to Ion in the Athens Starting Area.
1147.title: [Lv81]Snakes and Beaders

1148.details: A dangerous thing has happened. It seems that the Cyclops have stolen our Tartaros' Hammers! Be careful when you try to get them back.
1148.objectives: Fight the Cyclops, collect Tartaros' Hammer and then talk to Meletiou in Athens.
1148.title: [Lv96]Hammer and Nail

1149.completion: Could it be..? I have dreamt of this for so long...
1149.details: I am in search for a Persian Rug, but they are very rare. In fact, the only people who seem to have some are the Milier Guardsmen in the Isthmus of Corinth. I must have one.
1149.objectives: Fight the Milier Guardsmen, get their Persian Rug and then talk to Meletiou in Athens.
1149.title: [Lv105]Pulling the Rug Out

1150.completion: Thanks very much. You're a swifter messenger than Hermes himself.
1150.details: A postman's life is not as easy as it seems. In fact, I'm running quite behind! Please take this letter to the Postman at Megara Coast. Chop chop!
1150.objectives: Talk to the Postman at Megara Coast.
1150.title: [Lv50]Express Delivery

1151.details: Hiya! Could you do me a favor? I need some fresh wood, but I lack both gold and strength to get my own. Perhaps you could collect it from the Wood Men near the Athens Starting Area.
1151.objectives: Clear the Wood Men to collect some wood, and then talk to Moya in the Athens Starting Area.
1151.title: [Lv2]The Lumberjack

1152.details: Hiya! Could you do me a favor? I'm studying the medicinal effects of Antlers. Could you help me collect a few from the Little Deer near the Athens Starting Area?
1152.objectives: Hey, can you help collect some Antlers from the Little Deer, and then go talk to [Scholar]Moya in the Athens Starting Area.
1152.title: [Lv4]The Antlers

1153.completion: Wow, you have finished it so quickly.
1153.details: Hey, I heard that you are a real go-getter. Help me get Apitoxin from the many Wasps in the suburbs.
1153.objectives: Fight the Wasps, collect their Apitoxin and then talk to Alastor.
1153.title: [Lv10]Collect Apitoxin

1154.details: I've heard reports of several Snakes in the suburbs attacking the local citizens. Can you help me get rid of them?
1154.objectives: Help Demetrius to kill some  Snakes and then report to the [Round Quest]Main City Issuer in Athens.
1154.title: [Lv200]Snake Snake Snake

1155.completion: You will be a skilled snake-killer someday.
1155.details: There are many Vipers hidden among the tall grass in the suburbs. Can you help me kill them all. I will give you some big rewards.
1155.objectives: Help Demetrius to kill some  Vipers and then report to the [Round Quest]Main City Issuer in Athens.
1155.title: [Lv21]Snake Hunter 2

1156.completion: That's awesome. You really are great.
1156.details: The Boas are a dangerous enemy on the Marathon Plain. Demetrius told me that you are good at trapping snakes. Go to kill all of the Boas for me.
1156.objectives: Help Iakovou to kill some  Boas, then report to the [Round Quest]Marathon Issuer.
1156.title: [Lv31]Snake Hunter 3

1157.completion: I used to be as swift as you are.
1157.details: Hi, the Frog's spawn can be used to make medicine. Can you help me to collect some. There are many frogs living on the plain. Just be careful.
1157.objectives: Fight the Frogs, collect their Spawn and then talk to Thoas on Marathon Plain.
1157.title: [Lv38]Drug Stuff

1158.details: Can you help me get rid of the Poisonous Spiders in the area? Eurgh!
1158.objectives: Fight the Poisonous Spiders and then talk to Prothoenor at Parnitha.
1158.title: [Lv46]Spider Slayer

1159.details: Alright, soldier. I need you to take out the Witches outside of the village and put an end to their evil spells!
1159.objectives: Fight the Witches and then talk to Novoross at Parnitha.
1159.title: [Lv50]Fight the Darkness: Witch Hunt

1160.details: Alas, I'm afraid I am in need of your service once again. The witches have sought help from a group of Dark Necromancers. Fight them and I will offer you a great reward.
1160.objectives: Fight the Dark Necromancer and then talk to Novoross at Parnitha.
1160.title: [Lv54]Fiendish Reinforcements

1161.details: I've just received word that the Mob near the Megara Coast are planning to aid the Sparta in a campaign against Athens. I need you to show them the cost of treason.
1161.objectives: Fight the Mobs and then talk to Iphicrades at Megara Coast.
1161.title: [Lv68]The Mobsters

1162.details: The Crocodile Selous have grown extremely aggressive as of late. Eliminate them and bring me their teeth as a sign of your work.
1162.objectives: Fight the Crocodile Selou, get their teeth and then talk to Eyfimias at Megara Coast.
1162.title: [Lv70]Tooth & Scale

1163.details: The Pallas Pit Vipers are attcking the residents of the Megara Coast. Please exterminate these foul serpents.
1163.objectives: Fight the  Poisonous Pallas Pit Viper and then talk to Eyfimias at Megara Coast.
1163.title: [Lv76]Venomous Scourge

1164.details: The Skeleton Warriors are on the move! Without a fear of death, they are unyielding in their goal to take over Athens. Now lay their souls to rest once and for all.
1164.objectives: Fight the Skeleton Warriors and then talk to Iphicrades at      Megara Coast.
1164.title: [Lv80]Boney Brigade

1165.details: The Frogs at Plataea are mutating! Please destroy these monsters before they overrun our lands.
1165.objectives: Fight the mutated frogs at Plataea and then talk to Sebastiane at      Megara Coast.
1165.title: [Lv86]Life Found a Way

1166.details: The Cyclops have broken through our stone walls and are marching south towards Athens. We are the last line of defense against these bulgy-eyed brutes.
1166.objectives: Fight the Cyclops at Plataea and then talk to Sebastiane at      Megara Coast.
1166.title: [Lv90]One Eye on the Prize

1167.details: The Deigo Pirates in Derveni have banded with their enemies. We must wipe them out now, before their ruthlessness ruins our land.
1167.objectives: Fight the Deigo Pirates in Derveni and then talk to Serafim at Megara Coast.
1167.title: [Lv94]Pirates on the Move

1168.details: The Persian Missionaries in Derveni are rallying many of the Roving Bandits to their cause. Let us crush this conspiracy!
1168.objectives: Fight the Persian Missionary  in Derveni and then talk to Serafim  at Megara Coast.
1168.title: [Lv100]Persuasive Persians

1169.completion: I really want you to join us.
1169.details: The Milier Guardsmen have assembled and are heading toward the front line. But they will stand by and watch blades cutting each other's throats. I cannot bear this. Will you join us and tell them not to behave so coldly.
1169.objectives: Fight the Milier Guardsmen and then talk to Sebastiane at Megara Coast.
1169.title: [Lv106]Chaotic Front

1170.details: Go to Argolis and arrest the Skeleton Mages. They have disgraced their names by mixing with our enemies.
1170.objectives: Fight the Skeleton Mage and then talk to Eyfimias at Megara Coast.
1170.title: [Lv110]Go to Argolis

1171.completion: Ah, Phaedrus must have sent you. Listen carefully to what I say. Your problems are not solved by hatred. The Gods are acting against each other. We are humans must be considerate to one another. Listen to your heart, child. I will pray for you.
1171.details: Greetings. My name is Phaedrus. I am but a humble bard, but my heart beats boldly for Athens. If you are interested in serving Athena, perhaps I can offer you some work as a spy. You shall take my disguise andl speak to Eumaeus in Argolis. He will provide you with much help. But be wary of those around you. The Spartans number in the thousands. May Hermes lend his speed to yours. I will speak with you soon... assuming you survive of course.
1171.title: [Lv50]Athenian Espionage

1172.details: If you've got some spare time, I might be able to use your help. There was an abundance of Baby Teratorn born this season. Do not let their cuteness fool you. They are tyrants when fully grown!
1172.objectives: Ease the Baby Teratorn problems at the Isthmus of Corinth. Then speak with the [Daily Quest]Main City Issuer.
1172.title: [Lv48]The Baby Teratorn

1173.details: The Halflings and Centaurs are building an army in the Isthmus of Corinth. They are currently seeking an allegience with the Forest Magicians. We must be quick, and offer a truce to the magicians. Though we make a powerful ally to any that fight beside us, you may still need to win them by force. Go and prevent this bond from forming.
1173.objectives: Kill the Forest Magicians on the Isthmus of Corinth and then talk to the [Daily Quest]Main City Issuer.
1173.title: [Lv64]Lords of the Leaves

1174.details: Those wretched Harpies have allied with the Halflings. They've attacked our trade caravans and seized our military articles. Can you help us get rid of them?
1174.objectives: Kill the  Harpy's Underlings at the Isthmus of Corinth and then talk to the [Daily Quest]Main City Issuer.
1174.title: [Lv74]Half & Harp

1175.details: The war between Athens and Sparta has drawn the ire of the Elves living in the woods near the Isthmus of Corinth. They have come to regard both sides as their enemy. Perhaps by facing them in combat we can earn their respect.
1175.objectives: Duel with the Elf's Servants at Isthmus of Corinth and then talk to the [Daily Quest]Main City Issuer.
1175.title: [Lv82]Elvish Betrayal

1176.details: Have you ever heard of the Bronze Lions? They are descendents of the Golden Lions. Return them to their metallic slumber or they will wreak havoc through Athens. They are often found at the Isthmus of Corinth.
1176.objectives: Kill the Bronze Lions at the Isthmus of Corinth and then talk to the [Daily Quest]Main City Issuer.
1176.title: [Lv88]Bronze Lion

1177.details: A spell has been casted on the Scary Turtles at the Isthmus of Corinth. They are devouring everything that crosses their path - even elephants! Undo the curse cast upon them to restore their peaceful souls.
1177.objectives: Break the spell controlling the Scary Turtles at the Isthmus of Corinth and then talk to the [Daily Quest]Main City Issuer.
1177.title: [Lv96]Turtle Power

1178.details: The Young RedDragon are wandering around Isthmus of Corinth. Go to capture them before they are fully grown.
1178.objectives: Kill the Young RedDragons at the Isthmus of Corinth and then talk to the [Daily Quest]Main City Issuer.
1178.title: [Lv104]Hunt RedDragon

1179.details: The Spartan Patrolmen are planning an invasion of Athens. Can you help us to resist their attack and protect our country? There is a squad of them near Derveni.
1179.objectives: Fight the Spartan Patrolmen wandering around Derveni and then report to Faction Quest Issuer in the main cities.
1179.title: [Lv90]Athenian Defense

1180.details: The Spartan Raidingmen have assembled in Derveni and are ready to attack. Our intelligence shows that many of our people have already been slaughtered by this strike force. You must go and defend Athens from total invasion.
1180.objectives: Fight the Spartan Raidingmen around Derveni and then report to Faction Quest Issuer in the main cities.
1180.title: [Lv100]Spartan Invasion

1181.completion: At last! Now I can continue my work. Thank you so very much!
1181.details: There are some very useful herbs growing on the Marathon Plain but the Huge Lions living there make them too risky to collect. Wipe them out for me, will you, for the sake of our people's well being?
1181.objectives: Help Dionigi kill the Huge Lions at Marathon and then report to the [Round Quest]Marathon Issuer.
1181.title: [Lv200]Taking the Lions Share

1182.completion: Well done! These souls may now rest quietly in the Underworld.
1182.details: Excuse me, brave youth! I need help freeing the tormented loast souls trapped in the Wandering Skeletons. Will you assist me in this endeavor?
1182.objectives: Kill the Wandering Skeletons at Parnitha. Then speak with Panayiotis.
1182.title: [Lv60]Aiding the Paladin

1183.details: Acacia in the Newbie Village is looking for you at the moment.
1183.objectives: Speak with Acacia in the Newbie Village of main city.
1183.title: [Lv3]In Circles 1

1184.details: Dionigi at Marathon has helped a lot of people. Pay him a visit.
1184.title: [Lv3]In Circles 2

1185.completion: Ah, all of this on another citizens behalf? My, you are quite the generous youth.
1185.details: Could you help me? I need to speek with the Issuer in Athens but my leg is broken and I can't make the journey. He needs one of the Crispy Wood Men. Please take this letter to him explaining my condition.
1185.objectives: Kill the Crispy Wood Men in the Starting Area of the main city and then report to the Faction Quest Issuer in Athens.
1185.title: [Lv3]In Circles 3

1186.completion: Well, hello again. Would you be willing to assist me with something?
1186.details: Acacia needs our help. Let's go find her in the Newbie Village.
1186.objectives: Speak with Acacia in the Newbie Village of main city.
1186.title: [Lv3]Aiding Acacia

1187.completion: Oh, wonderful! Now I can begin selling sweet treats to the people of Athens!
1187.details: I'm looking to start selling honey to the people of Athens but I'm afraid I don't have any bees to harvest with. Would you mind collecting some Little Bees while I work here?
1187.objectives: Capture some Little Bees outside the Newbie Village of the main city, and talk to Acacia.
1187.title: [Lv3]Bee in your Bonnet

1188.details: There is a Harp Tablet in the Suburbs of Athens that maight interest you. It is located at (38, 27) on your map. Good luck.
1188.objectives: Find the Harp Tablet at (38, 27) in Athens
1188.title: [Lv200]Trip-Harp Tablet

1189.details: Two monuments worthy of visiting are the Freedom Square (122,-164) and the Wedding Hall (64,-172). All's fair in love and war and, well, I'd say these two architectural masterpieces are equal in magnificence as well!
1189.objectives: Find Freedom Square at (122, -164) and the Wedding Hall at (64, -172) in Athens.
1189.title: [Lv200]Scavenger Hunt: Acropolis

1190.details: Can you help me kill some Wild Oxen?
1190.objectives: Get rid of the requested monsters, then go talk with the Merchant.
1190.title: [Lv20]Wild Ox

1191.details: Can you help me catch some Lamia's Dressing Boxes?
1191.objectives: Get rid of the requested monsters, then go talk with the Merchant.
1191.title: [Lv25]Succuba's Box

1192.completion: You and your friends have performed admirably!
1192.details: Your journey in life will be easier to travel if you have friends fighting beside you. Take a group of friend and wipe out the Wasps near the Athens Starting Area.
1192.objectives: Get rid of the Wasps in a team and then talk with Antigone.
1192.title: [Lv14]Team Quests: Buzzkill

1193.completion: You've come back? I hope you have more friends this time.
1193.details: Why not try to kill the Vicious Queen Nina with your friends? However, you really should have formed a team including five people before accepting this quest...
1193.objectives: Get rid of the Vicious Queen Nina in a team and then talk with Antigone.
1193.title: [Lv22]Team Spirit

1194.completion: You've come back? I hope you have more friends this time.
1194.details: Why not try to kill the Skeletons with your friends? However, you really should have teamed up before accepting this quest...
1194.objectives: Get rid of the Skeletons in a team and then talk with Antigone.
1194.title: [Lv31]Boys and Girls

1195.completion: You've come back? I hope you have more friends this time.
1195.details: Bring a friend to see me!
1195.objectives: Form a team with at least two people and then talk with Antigone.
1195.title: [Lv21]Making Friends

1197.details: Hello, can you help me catch some Skeletons?
1197.objectives: Get rid of the requested monsters and talk with the Merchant.
1197.title: [Lv30]Skeleton Corps

1198.completion: My sister said she likes you very much.
1198.details: Hello, can you help me catch some Vicious Wolves?
1198.objectives: Get rid of the requested monsters and talk with Eileen.
1198.title: [Lv36]Sister's Need 1

1199.completion: My sister said she likes you very much.
1199.details: Hello, can you help me catch some Robber Lolos?
1199.objectives: Get rid of the requested monsters and talk with Eileen.
1199.title: [Lv41]Sister's Need 2

1200.completion: Thank you so much! You've saved my business!
1200.details: The trade routes are blocked! I can't deliver my wares until the road has been cleared. Can you please fight off the Witches blocking the way?
1200.objectives: Get rid of the requested monsters and talk with the Merchant at Parnitha.
1200.title: [Lv56]Clear the Road: Witches

1201.completion: Thank you so much! You've saved my business!
1201.details: The trade routes are blocked! I can't deliver my wares until the road has been cleared. Can you please fight off the Poisonous Frogs blocking the way?
1201.objectives: Get rid of the requested monsters and talk with the Merchant at Parnitha.
1201.title: [Lv66]Clear Barrier

1202.completion: Thank you so much! You've saved my business!
1202.details: The trade routes are blocked! I can't deliver my wares until the road has been cleared. Can you please fight off the Mobs blocking the way?
1202.objectives: Get rid of the requested monsters and talk with the Merchant at Parnitha.
1202.title: [Lv76]Clear the Road: Mobs

1203.completion: Thank you so much! You've saved my business!
1203.details: The trade routes are blocked! I can't deliver my wares until the road has been cleared. Can you please fight off the Skeleton Warriors blocking the way?
1203.objectives: Get rid of the requested monsters and talk with the Merchant at Parnitha.
1203.title: [Lv86]Skeleton Warriors

1204.completion: At last, I can send out my deliveries!

1217.completion: Sameng is gone! Thank you so much. He and Akar drove my sister to madness. Please avenge her.
1217.details: So, you want to be the next great hero, huh? Well one way to become a hero is to prove your merit not only to the Gods but to the people of Greece. The easiest way to do this is to protect them from those who would wish to wreak havoc on our lands. In a strange way, you're in luck. There just happens to be three warlords trying to overthrow the rulers of Greece: Soul Holder Sameng, Akar the Living Devil, and Lord Baryonyx the Beast Master. Defeating them will aid you on your quest to become the next great hero of Greece. The Soul Holder Sameng is currently nearby slaying the innocent and gathering their souls for his dark army. Defeat him and move one step closer to completing the trial. After you have killed him, find Penelope on Marathon Plain. She will guide you to the next warlord.
1217.objectives: Defeat Soul Holder Sameng. Then meet with Penelope on Marathon Plain.
1217.title: [Lv75]3 Warlords: Soulless

1218.completion: Oh.. my dear sister Circe. As her only caretaker for over a decade, I've tried my hardest to protect her. Twelve years ago, our father went to search for a legendary holy weapon. Only recently did he return. The night after his return, Circe followed a white sheep deep into the forest. Despite how weak he was from his travels, my father ran out to look for her. He never returned. The next day, Circe was seen wandering near our front gate. She was only a shell of herself. From what we can understand, Akar and Sameng attacked her in the night. Our father was able to rescue her... but at the cost of his own life.
1218.details: No! Please stay away from me! I don't want to die! Guards, help me! Akar is going to kill me!
1218.title: [Lv75]Hero's Trial 2

1219.completion: Thank goodness! You've come back safely.
1219.details: Please help us. None of the villagers dare face the warlords. You defeated Sameng in battle and I know you can defeat Akar as well. His army is currently in Megara awaiting his orders.
1219.objectives: Find the Black Flag Camp in Megara.
1219.title: [Lv80]3 Warlords: Devil's Camp

1220.completion: Thank you for all you have done for my family. The living devil will be punished for all eternity in the fires of Tartarus.
1220.details: I have waited for this day. Akar will pay for what he has done to my family. Please send the living devil to the Underworld where he will be punished for all eternity.
1220.title: [Lv85]3 Warlords: Devil's Deal

1221.completion: The three warlords are gone forever. Banished to the Underworld where they will suffer eternally for their crimes against Greece. Likewise, I will be eternally grateful you, my brave hero.
1221.details: I don't think I'll ever be able to thank you enough. These warlords have been harrassing my family ever since they learn that my father returned with the lost holy weapon.  Lord Baryonyx, the Beast Master himself, has tried constantly to steal it from us. He is a master of deception. Each time he came to our door, it was in the shape of a different creature. The last time Baryonyx threatened us, he swore that if my father did not give up the weapon he would lose his most valued possesion. Now I know he meant Circe. He disguised himself has a sheep the night of my father's death and lead Circe and my father to their doom. Please end this torture once and for all.
1221.objectives: Defeat the Beast Master, Lord Baryonyx.
1221.title: [Lv95]3 Warlords: Beast Master

1222.completion: Now you understand the true meaning of a hero. While strength and skill will guard you on the battlefield, it is you heart that guides your actions. A brave heart like yours will earn the trust of many. It's how you protect and honor that trust that makes you a hero. That is the meaning of the Warriors Spirit.

1283.completion: May this new gear help protect you from harm and strike down your enemies!
1283.details: Your bravery and commitment to duty has won you another gear upgrade, by order of the general himself!
1283.objectives: When you reach level 65, speak to the Gear Giver to claim the general's reward.
1283.title: [Lv65]General's Award 8

1284.completion: Another upgrade in gear for the bravest warrior in all of Athens!
1284.details: The general recognizes your invaluable service on the battlefield, and hopes a reward of new gear will inspire more great things from you.
1284.objectives: When you reach level 70, speak to the Gear Giver to claim the general's reward.
1284.title: [Lv70]General's Award 9

1285.completion: I can think of no warrior more deserving of this fine gear than you!
1285.details: The general considers you one of the best warriors in history, and believes your gear should be the best as well. Your reward is waiting with the Gear Giver.
1285.objectives: When you reach level 75, speak to the Gear Giver to claim the general's reward.
1285.title: [Lv75]General's Award 10

1286.completion: This is some of the finest gear in all the world. Rejoice, for you have earned it!
1286.details: Your heroic deeds have won the hearts of and minds of everyone. As a result, the general extends his deepest gratitude, and offers you an upgrade to the finest gear available.
1286.objectives: When you reach level 80, speak to the Gear Giver to claim the general's reward.
1286.title: [Lv80]General's Award 11

1287.completion: So, how do you like the gifts?
1287.details: You have grown into a hero. The wise sage asked me to give you some gifts.
1287.objectives: When you reach level 10, talk to the Gift Envoy and claim the sage's gifts which will improve your gear's basic attributes.
1287.title: [Lv5]Sage's Gift 1

1288.completion: So, how do you like the gifts?
1288.details: You have grown into a hero. The wise sage asked me to give you some gifts.
1288.objectives: When you reach level 15, talk to the Gift Envoy and claim the sage's gifts which will improve your gear's basic attributes.
1288.title: [Lv10]Sage's Gift 2

1289.completion: So, how do you like the gifts?
1289.details: You have grown into a hero. The wise sage asked me to give you some gifts.
1289.objectives: When you reach level 20, talk to the Gift Envoy and claim the sage's gifts which will improve your gear's basic attributes.
1289.title: [Lv15]Sage's Gift 3

1290.completion: So, how do you like the gifts?
1290.details: You have grown into a hero. The wise sage asked me to give you some gifts.
1290.objectives: When you reach level 25, talk to the Gift Envoy and claim the sage's gifts which will improve your gear's basic attributes.
1290.title: [Lv20]Sage's Gift 4

1291.completion: So, how do you like the gifts?
1291.details: For your heroic performance, the sage has asked me to give you this gift as a reward. Please accept it!
1291.objectives: When you reach level 30, talk to the  Gift Envoy  and claim the gear awarded by the sage.
1291.title: [Lv25]Sage's Gift 5

1292.completion: Thank you for ridding Sicily of those annoying elves. Please take these rewards as a humble symbol of our gratitude. You have earned them!
1292.details: Hades has unleashed an army of inhuman monsters onto nearby Sicily. It’s now infested with hordes of wicked elves! Slay 100 of them to begin restoring this once beautiful island to its rightful splendor. Transporting there is easy, simply speak to the 'Event Transporter' in the main city. Once in Sicily, hit the “Search” button to find the Quest Envoy... they know exactly where these monsters are hiding. Good luck!
1292.objectives: Go to Sicily via the Event Transporter. Once there, kill 100 Sicilian Elves and then report to the Sicilian Refugee.
1292.title: [Lv25]Purify Sicily: The Elves

1293.completion: You’ve killed the wolves! Such bravery will always be remembered in Sicily. Please accept these rewards, it is the least I can do.
1293.details: Thank you, brave warrior. The elves are finally gone! Unfortunately, they have been replaced with packs of ravenous Numb Wolves. Kill 100 of these cruel creatures, and every Sicilian will be forever grateful. The Quest Envoy knows exactly where they are hiding. May the gods be with you!
1293.objectives: Go to Sicily via the Event Transporter. Once there, kill 100 Numb Wolves and then report to the Sicilian Refugee.
1293.title: [Lv45]Purify Sicily: The Wolves

1294.completion: Those creepy puppets are gone! Thank you, brave warrior. Songs of your selfless deeds will be sung by children for generations! On behalf of every Sicilian, I present you with these rewards.
1294.details: Life in Sicily is much better without those Numb Wolves roaming around, but as you can see, legions of Ruthless Puppets have appeared. They scare the children and ruin the peace! Kill 100 of these maniacal marionettes, and you will be handsomely rewarded. The Quest Envoy can help you find these monsters. May the wind always be at your back!
1294.objectives: Go to Sicily via the Event Transporter. Once there, kill 100 Ruthless Puppets and then report to the Sicilian Refugee.
1294.title: [Lv65]Purify Sicily: Puppets

1295.completion: Yay! With those deadly Blaze Vipers gone, life in Sicily can finally begin to return to normal. We thank you, brave warrior, with these lavish rewards.
1295.details: Thanks to you, our island is free of those horrible puppets! However it’s hard to celebrate with so many Blaze Vipers around. Destroy 100 of these slithery serpents, and we will be that much closer to driving Hades and his minions out of our island forever. For help finding these monsters, talk to the Quest Envoy. God's speed!
1295.objectives: Go to Sicily via the Event Transporter. Once there, kill 100 Blaze Vipers and then report to the Sicilian Refugee.
1295.title: [Lv81]Purify Sicily: The Vipers

1296.completion: Now that those Ice Wraiths are gone, the weather is warming up again. You are truly Sicily’s hero, and we insist on rewarding your service with these gifts.
1296.details: As if those vipers weren’t scary enough, now we’re faced with a scourge of Ice Wraiths! Hades must be getting desperate to send such wretched filth to our fair island. Annihilate 100 of these frozen freaks, and all of Sicily will be forever in your debt. As usual, the Quest Envoy has offered to help you find the wraiths. Be careful!
1296.objectives: Go to Sicily via the Event Transporter. Once there, kill 100 Ice Wraiths and then report to the Sicilian Refugee.
1296.title: [Lv91]Purify Sicily: Wraiths

1297.completion: I thought those Gela Guards would never be defeated, but thankfully you proved me wrong. In honor of your strength and bravery, we present you with these fine Sicilian gifts.
1297.details: Those ugly things walking around the countryside are Gela Guards. They bully us Sicilians and wreak havoc wherever they go. Defeat 100 of these goons to win our gratitude, plus a few gifts. If you have trouble finding them, the Quest Envoy knows exactly where they hide. Fight bravely, young warrior!
1297.objectives: Go to Sicily via the Event Transporter. Once there, kill 100 Gela Guards and then report to the Sicilian Refugee.
1297.title: [Lv101]Purify Sicily: The Guards

1298.completion: Oh, brave warrior! Glory be upon you! You have defeated Hades, and Sicily is once again free from his curse. To thank you, we have saved the finest gifts in all of Sicily for this occasion. Accept them with pride!
1298.details: Your bravery has angered Hades, who has now sent some of his deadliest monsters to fight you. The dreaded Gela Hunter is both smart and lethal. Send 100 of them back to the underworld god, and forever rid Sicily of his wretched curse. The Quest Envoy has offered to help you find the hunters, should you need their assistant. Stay strong and victory will be yours!
1298.objectives: Go to Sicily via the Event Transporter. Once there, kill 100 Gela Hunters and then report to the Sicilian Refugee.
1298.title: [Lv111]Purify Sicily: Hunters

1299.completion: So, how do you like the gifts? Great, huh?
1299.details: You have grown into a true hero. The wise sage asked me to give you some gifts.
1299.objectives: When you reach Level 35, talk to the Gift Envoy and claim the sage's gifts. They will enlarge your bag.
1299.title: [Lv30]Sage's Gift 6

1300.completion: With those skeletons gone, business in Parnitha can return to normal. Thank you, brave warrior. You have earned this reward.
1300.details: Parnitha is overrun with Wandering Skeletons, and it’s bad for business. Local merchants have offered a reward to anyone who can kill 50 or more of these bothersome bones.
1300.objectives: Slay 50 Wandering Skeletons in Parnitha and then report to Ion in the Starting Area of the main city.
1300.title: [Lv67]Skeleton Hunt

1302.completion: I am the Pet Master, and my pets are some of the fanciest in all of Greece. For a brave warrior like you, I give this egg. Take special care of it!
1302.details: The Pet Master came to the village recently, and offered to give away her fancy pets. If you want an animal companion, you must find her quickly before they are all gone!
1302.objectives: Claim a pet from the Pet Master.
1302.title: [Lv200]First Fuzzy Friend

1303.completion: Oh, your baby pet looks hungry. Feed it now, and don’t miss any more meal times!
1303.details: Baby pets need more than love, they need food too! And the only person I know with baby pet food is the Newbie Guide. Ask him nicely and he may give you some.
1303.objectives: Claim pet food from the Newbie Guide.
1303.title: [Lv200]Hungry Baby Pet

1304.completion: You are quite the wasp swatter! For ridding the Starting Area of those insidious insects, I gladly present you with this reward.
1304.details: Welcome, brave warrior. This is the Starting Area of the main city. It’s usually a very pleasant place, but we’ve recently been invaded by a swarm of wasps. They bite and sting everyone, even the children! If you can kill at least 30 of them, we would all be very grateful!
1304.objectives: Ion wants you to kill 30 Wasps in the Starting Area of the main city.
1304.title: [Lv200]Wrath of the Wasps

1305.completion: So, how do you like the gifts? Great, huh?
1305.details: You have grown into a hero. The wise sage asked me to give you some gifts.
1305.objectives: When you reach level 40, talk to the Gift Envoy and claim the sage's gifts which will improve your gear's basic attributes.
1305.title: [Lv35]Sage's Gift 7

1306.completion: Oh, brave warrior! Glory be upon you! You have defeated Hades, and Sicily is once again free from his curse. To thank you, we have saved the finest gifts in all of Sicily for this occasion. Accept them with pride!
1306.details: Your bravery has angered Hades, who has now sent some of his deadliest monsters to fight you. The dreaded Gela Hunter is both smart and lethal. Send 100 of them back to the underworld god, and forever rid Sicily of his wretched curse. The Quest Envoy has offered to help you find the hunters, should you need their assistant. Stay strong and victory will be yours!
1306.objectives: Go to Sicily via the Event Transporter. Once there, kill 100 Gela Hunters and then report to the Sicilian Refugee.
1306.title: [Lv121]Purify Sicily: Hunters

1307.completion: Those scouts are gone from Plataea, thanks to you! The Persian army will think twice before sending their scouts to our country again. Please accept this reward as a token of our gratitude.
1307.details: Enemies from the east have sent scouts to Plataea. They assault the citizens and pillage their homes. Athens needs you to drive these Persian Scouts back to from whence they came!
1307.objectives: Cronus Captain asked you to destroy the Persian Scouts in Plataea, and then report back to him.
1307.title: [Lv105]Plataea Under Siege

1308.completion: Generations of great warriors have trained by fighting with $gThorn Turtles$c, and now you follow that tradition. Here is your reward for a job well done!
1308.details: Our spies inform us that Persian Scouts are preparing to invade Plataea! But you are not ready to face them yet. Kill 100 Thorn Turtles, and then report back to me.
1308.objectives: Cronus Captain instructed you to kill 100 Thorn Turtles in Plataea, and then report back to him.
1308.title: [Lv110]Prepare for War!

1309.completion: You’ve done it! Scholar Kal is dead! Thank you, brave warrior. In the name of our fallen leader, I present to you these useful rewards.
1309.details: I was once a soldier in a proud army, but that all changed when we lost our leader to the Scholar Kals. Since then, we have drifted far from our former glory. But you can make things right. If you defeat Scholar Kals, we can one again march through this country with our heads held high!
1309.objectives: The Thracian Mercenary asked you to defeat Scholar Kals in Plataea, and then report back to him.
1309.title: [Lv105]A Broken Army

1310.completion: I am pleased to hear the Wind Elves are gone from Plataea. You have earned our thanks, as well as these valuable rewards.
1310.details: Wind Elves have raided the land north of Plataea. They are tricky creatures, often camouflaging themselves as little girls. Worst of all, they harass our soldiers and make life difficult for everyone. Only a brave warrior like you can drive them away!
1310.objectives: The Thracian Mercenary requested that you kill the Wind Elves in the land north of Plataea, and then report back to him.
1310.title: [Lv110]Elves in the Wind

1311.completion: My warrior, I have been waiting for you for some time.
1311.details: War is just around the corner, with various guilds beginning to get involved. Find the Retired Soldier in the main city first and he will tell you the details.
1311.objectives: Find the Retired Soldier in the city of Athens and he will tell you what you should do.
1311.title: [Lv21]Ship Materials

1312.details: I was once a brave Athenian soldier. I've been living here in seclusion since I retired from the army. However, as a former Athenian soldier, I always pay attnetion  what's going on in the city. A battle is approaching, but we are still badly in need of supplies. Please find Alexiou who is in the Starting Area of the main city and inquire him about that for me.
1312.objectives: Find Alexiou in the Starting Area of the main city and inquire him about supplies for the battlefront.
1312.title: [Lv21]Retired Soldier

1313.details: I am busy. What, he sent you here? Good, you seem to have his approval. Go to Marathon and tell Barca about this matter. He is in charge of the material allocation.
1313.objectives: Alexiou asks you to tell Barca in Marathon about this matter.
1313.title: [Lv21]Alexiou's Attitude

1314.completion: Good, choose any material and send it to the War Supplier in the main city, in the suburbs or in Marathon, and you will get different rewards for each.
1314.details: Oh? He asked you to find me? It seems you are strong enough. All right, you have my approval, go back to him. Remember, be polite!
1314.objectives: Barca asks you to report to the Retired Soldier in the city of Athens.
1314.title: [Lv21]Final Result

1315.completion: You did it! Killing Mutant Cruces was no small feat, but you made it look easy. Thank you, and please accept this humble reward.
1315.details: Brave warrior! There are rumors that Persephone’s seal has been removed. This will certainly summon the souls of the dead! Prophecy warns us the first monster will be Mutant Cruces. Slay this evil beast, and all Sicily will rejoice!
1315.objectives: Kill Mutant Cruces and avenge the victims of Sicily.
1315.title: [Lv25]Sicilian Call(1)

1316.completion: All of Sicily thanks you for killing Wicked Alex. I've been authorized to give you this reward for your heroic service.
1316.details: Mutant Cruces was only the beginning. I fear that more souls of the dead are rising. The prophecy foretells the next monster will be Wicked Alex. Slay him, and help save Sicily from this wretched curse.
1316.objectives: Kill Wicked Alex and avenge the victims of Sicily.
1316.title: [Lv61]Sicilian Call(2)

1317.completion: Skeleton Captain Ixion is dead! Let the good new ring out for all to hear! And it’s all thanks to you, brave warrior. Take this reward, you deserve nothing less.
1317.details: With the death of Wicked Alex, there is but one more monster to defeat. Skeleton Captain Ixion is said to be the most dangerous of all the dead souls. Slay this foul spirit, and Sicily will once again be free of evil!
1317.objectives: Kill Skeleton Captain Ixion and avenge the victims of Sicily.
1317.title: [Lv101]The Deadly Captain Ixion

1318.completion: So, how do you like the gifts? Great, huh?
1318.details: For your heroic performance, the sage has asked me to give you this gift as a reward. Please accept it!
1318.objectives: When you reach level 60, talk to the  Gift Envoy  and claim the gear awarded by the sage.
1318.title: [Lv55]Sage's Gift 8

1319.completion: I am pleased to hear the Wind Elves are gone from Plataea. You have earned our thanks, as well as these valuable rewards.
1319.details: Wind Elves have raided the land north of Plataea. They are tricky creatures, often camouflaging themselves as little girls. Worst of all, they harass our soldiers and make life difficult for everyone. Only a brave warrior like you can drive them away!
1319.objectives: The Thracian Mercenary requested that you kill the Wind Elves in the land north of Plataea, and then report back to him.
1319.title: [Lv110]Elf Legends

1320.completion: Killing all those Huge Spiders is no small feat. Marathon is much better without them. Take this reward, you have earned it!
1320.details: I’ve heard you are a brave hero, but you have yet to pass the seven trials of magic. Only then can you be considered a great mage. The first test pits you against hordes of Huge Spiders in Marathon. Eliminate 100 of them, and then find the Athenian Traveler. He will tell me of your success or failure. Now off with you!
1320.objectives: Eliminate 100 Huge Spiders in Marathon, and then tell of your deed to the Athenian Traveler.
1320.title: [Lv1]Magic Trial(1)

1321.completion: Those skeletons have been running loose in the Athens suburbs for too long. Thank you for destroying them. Here is your reward.
1321.details: You killed the huge spiders in Marathon, but that was only the first of seven tests. To continue, you must travel to the suburbs of Athens and destroy the Skeletons that haunt the area. Once you have claimed 10 Skulls, take them to the Athenian Traveler, who will inform me of your progress. Now be gone!
1321.objectives: Destroy the Skeletons in the surburbs of Athens and collect 10 skulls. Take them to the Athenian Traveler.
1321.title: [Lv1]Magic Trial(2)

1322.completion: I can’t remember the last time Paniza was free of those terrible Wandering Skeletons. Thanks to you, they finally are! And now, it’s reward time!
1322.details: I was certain those skeletons would stop you, but your skills grow more impressive each day. However, the third trial of magic will not be so easy. Go to Paniza, and kill 100 Wandering Skeletons. If you survive the ordeal, seek out the Athenian Traveler. He will again inform me of your success... or failure. Leave me now!
1322.objectives: Kill 100 Wandering Skeleton in Paniza until you have 10 skulls, and then talk to Athenian Traveler.
1322.title: [Lv61]Magic Trial(3)

1323.completion: Megara has been terrorized by that Death Mage for too long. You did a good thing by killing him. Now take this reward, it’s the least I can do.
1323.details: You are more than half way through the trials of magic. I’m beginning to believe the stories of your greatness. But this fourth trial is very difficult. On the coast of Megara lives the Death Mages. Slay them to collect 10 wands. Take them to the Athenian Traveler, he will know what to do. Now leave at once!
1323.objectives: Slay the powerful Death Mages on the coast of Megara and collect 10 wands. Afterwards, talk to Athenian Traveler.
1323.title: [Lv61]Magic Trial(4)

1324.completion: I never met a Cyclops I liked, probably because those one-eyed freaks just creep me out. Good job taking so many out! Here’s your reward.
1324.details: I see the Death Mage was no match for your strength. Hopefully for your sake the same is true for this fifth trial. Cyclops roam the Greek countryside. Kill 100 of them, and you will again receive ten wands. Afterwards, inform the Athenian Traveler of your success. Why haven't you left yet?
1324.objectives: Kill 100 Cyclops until you have 10 wands. When you're done, talk to Athenian Traveler.
1324.title: [Lv91]Magic Trial(5)

1325.completion: The Bradian Scholar Kal used to think he was so smart. Now he doesn’t think at all, because he’s dead! Hahaha! Well done, brave warrior. This reward is for you!
1325.details: You may not look like a typical Cyclops exterminator, but one should never judge a hero by their looks! However, this sixth trial has bested warriors better than you. Slay the Bradian Scholar Kal. Collect 10 wands from them. Then, report to the Athenian Traveler. Go now!
1325.objectives: Destroy the Bradian Scholar Kal, and you will receive ten wands. Afterwards, talk to Athenian Traveler.
1325.title: [Lv91]Magic Trial(6)

1326.completion: I didn’t think you were a match for the Boar King. But thankfully you proved me wrong, and made him squeal like the pig he is. Now here is your reward.
1326.details: You have reached the final trial of magic. I still can’t believe it! But the previous trials were nothing compared to this one. You must travel to Paniza and kill the Boar King. This will not be easy. If you survive, seek the Athenian Traveler. If you not, I shall pray for your safe passage to the Underworld. Now leave already!
1326.objectives: Kill the Boar King in Paniza, then find the Athenian Traveler.
1326.title: [Lv1]Magic Trial(7)

1327.completion: This honor is reserved for only the bravest warriors, and that certainly includes you. Well done!
1327.details: Because of your courageous service to Athens, the High Council has awarded you the title of "Heroic Envoy". To claim this prestigious honor, you must visit the senator in Athens.
1327.objectives: Claim your new title of Heroic Envoy from the senator in Athens.
1327.title: [Lv1]Heroic Envoy

1328.completion: You can now shift your class. Enjoy all the responsibilities and privileges this new rank has to offer!
1328.details: You have proven yourself to be a hero of the people, and are now permitted to shift class. I can make that happen now if you’d like.
1328.objectives: If you are above Level 100, you can claim 1  Class Shift Permit from me to shift your class.
1328.title: [Lv101]Class Shift

1329.completion: You can now shift your equipment, and open up a new world of gear to explore. Congratulations!
1329.details: A hero of your caliber deserves a change in equipment now and then. I can grant you a permit to shift your equipment, if you’re interested.
1329.objectives: If you are above Level 100, you can claim 1  Equipment Shift Permit from me to shift your equipment.
1329.title: [Lv101]Equipment Shift

1330.completion: Good job, brave warrior! It will be a long time before any Dark Witches come back here looking for an easy score. Take this reward as our thanks!
1330.details: A shipment of valuable cargo just arrived at Parnitha Port. Officials fear a gang of Dark Witches is planning to steal it, and request that you clear them out.
1330.objectives: Eliminate the Dark Witches at Parnitha Port, and return to the [Round Quest]Port Issuer.
1330.title: [Lv80]Port Security

1331.completion: You did it! Parnitha Port is once again free of those pesky Persian Scouts. Take this reward, you earned every bit of it!
1331.details: The Persians have sent their Persian Scouts to disrupt shipments at Parnitha Port. Destroy them before they do any more harm!
1331.objectives: Bust those Persian Scouts at Parnitha Port for rewards.
1331.title: [Lv91]Clear Out the Scouts

1332.completion: With those Venomous Icy Frogs gone, the air is warmer and the ships are no longer blocked. Such a service deserves this reward!
1332.details: Every year, Venomous Icy Frogs migrate to the mouth of the river near Parnitha Port and clog our shipping lanes. We need you to clear them out!
1332.objectives: Exterminate those Venomous Icy Frogs around Parnitha Port, and then return to [Round Quest]Port Issuer for your rewards.
1332.title: [Lv101]Frog Clog

1333.completion: Dark witches are difficult to deal with, but not for you! Take this reward as thanks for driving them away from our port.
1333.details: Several ship captains have reported their cargo is under attack by Dark Witches. You are our best hope to drive them away.
1333.objectives: Rid Parnitha Port of Dark Witches, and return to the Port Issues for your reward.
1333.title: [Lv80]Witches of Parnitha

1334.completion: Thank you for ridding us of those Ghost Warriors. You obviously fear no man, living or dead. Now take this well-earned reward!
1334.details: A small army of Ghostly Warriors is haunting Parnitha Port. If you can scare them off, we would be ever so grateful!
1334.objectives: Drive those Ghostly Warriors back to the spirit world, and then return to Port Issues for your rewards.
1334.title: [Lv81]No Ghosts Allowed

1335.completion: Life was unbearable with those Flaming Boas slithering around the port. On behalf of the transport crew, here is your reward.
1335.details: It’s hard to believe, but a swarm of Flaming Boas have attacked the transport crew. For safety’s sake, kill those snakes!
1335.objectives: Kill the Flaming Boas that infest Parnitha Port, and return to Port Issues for your reward.
1335.title: [Lv89]Snakes From Hell

1336.completion: Thanks to you, those Persian Clergies are gone from Parnitha Port. I doubt that’s the last we’ve seen of them. But for now, take this reward.
1336.details: The Persian threat is finally upon us! We have several reports of bandits attacking Thermopylae to the north, and Persian Clergies taking station in Parnitha Port. This poses a dire threat to Athens. Will you help?
1336.objectives: Slay the Persian Clergies at Parnitha Port, and report back to [Daily Quest]Port Issuer.
1336.title: [Lv90]The Persians are Coming!

1337.completion: Thank you, brave warrior. You have avenged me more than you will ever know. Take this reward, it’s from the bottom of my heart!
1337.details: Salt Water Crocodiles are a pain in the you-know-what, and I have the scar to prove it! Get them out of Port Parnitha once and for all!
1337.objectives: Teach those Salt Water Crocodiles a lesson, then report back to [Daily Quest]Port Issuer.
1337.title: [Lv94]Vile Crocodile

1338.completion: Ah! The Centaurs are gone, and so is their terrible smell. We can all breathe deeply now, thanks to you. Here is a reward for your trouble.
1338.details: Centaurs are nothing but mythical monsters of mayhem. They stink, and live to cause trouble. No cargo is safe with them around. Do something!
1338.objectives: Bust some Centaurs and report to the [Daily Quest]Port Issuer for your rewards.
1338.title: [Lv98]Scent of a Centaur

1339.completion: Yay! I knew you could get rid of those Venomous Icy Frogs! Everyone at Parnitha Port wants me to thank you with this reward.
1339.details: The only thing worse than Icy Frogs are Venomous Icy Frogs. They’re everywhere, coldly poisoning whoever they touch. Please clear them out!
1339.objectives: Clear out the Venomous Icy Frogs in Parnitha Port.
1339.title: [Lv100]Frogs Galore!

1340.completion: Wow, I’m very impressed with the way you handled those Venomsting Scorpions. You have earned this reward and then some!
1340.details: Urgh, Venomsting Scorpions are all over the riverside. Every step could mean death! Kill them and end this nightmare!
1340.objectives: Venomsting Scorpions are all over the riverside. Kill them and end this nightmare!
1340.title: [Lv103]The Scorpion’s Sting

1341.completion: What can a silly Mudskipper do against a brave warrior like you? Nothing, except die! Hahaha. And now, your reward.
1341.details: Is there no end to our bad luck? Now Mudskippers are attacking us. Do me a favor and grind those gill-breathers into chum!
1341.title: [Lv106]The Horrible Hopping Fish

1342.completion: Welcome, brave warrior. I am so glad you made it. We can really use your skills here on the frontline. Are you ready for the battles that lie ahead.
1342.details: All of Athens praises your bravery on the battlefield. But as you know, war is coming and we are once again in need of your service. The frontline appears to be at Parnitha Port. Go there now, and report to Themistocles. He will put your skills to best use. Take care, my friend. We are all counting on you!
1342.objectives: Report to Themistocles at Parnitha Port.
1342.title: [Lv80]Duty Calls

1343.completion: Those Dark Witches didn’t stand a chance against you! I guess you deserve a reward. Take it before I change my mind.
1343.details: The Dark Witches are back. Kill those cackling fools, and then report to Meletiou in Athens.
1343.objectives: Kill the Dark Witches, and then report to Meletiou in the main city of Athens.
1343.title: [Lv80]Witch Hunter

1344.completion: Hello, brave warrior! You have an important message for me? Let me see... yes, this is grave news indeed. Thank you for delivering it. Now here is a reward for your swift service.
1344.details: The Persian invasion includes hordes of giant monsters. Our attempts to eliminate them have proven futile due to a mysterious power that keeps regenerating them. We fear a new wave is coming soon, and are unsure how long we can hold the frontline. I need you to deliver this important message to Themistocles in Parnitha Port. May your journey be swift!
1344.objectives: Deliver Meletiou's message to Themistocles at Parnitha Port.
1344.title: [Lv80]Monsters Reborn

1345.completion: I always knew something was weird about that lake. Thank you for confirming my suspicions!
1345.details: I've got a possible lead regarding that Persian monster problem Meletiou reported. Go to Mysterial Lake(-138,-113). You won't return empty handed.
1345.objectives: Go to Mysterial Lake(-138,-113) at Parnitha Port, and then report to Bias.
1345.title: [Lv80]The Mystery of Mysterial Lake

1346.completion: I see your efforts were not in vain. This information will help the investigation immeasurably. Good work!
1346.details: Themistocles is an expert investigator. He can help us decide what to do next. You’ll find him at Parnitha Port.
1346.objectives: Discuss the investigation with  Themistocles at Parnitha Port.
1346.title: [Lv80]Detective Themistocles

1347.completion: You did it! With those pesky spirits gone, the Persian invasion is much less threatening. Thank you, brave warrior!
1347.details: Those Ghostly Warriors are somehow helping the Persian monsters regenerate. Kill them before they can work their ghostly magic! Then, report to Meletiou in Athens.
1347.objectives: Kill the Ghostly Warriors and then report to Meletiou in Athens.
1347.title: [Lv80]Bust Those Ghosts

1348.completion: Greetings, brave warrior! Hear my tales of wars gone by, and  may they help strike down our enemies once and for all.
1348.details: War will soon be upon us, and we need all the advice we can get. Go speak with Ephialtes, he is a celebrated veteran and has many helpful suggestions to share.
1348.title: [Lv105]War Stories

1349.completion: The vacation was good for you. I see the fighting spirit has returned to your eyes.
1349.details: You’re a bit jumpy these days. Perhaps a little relaxation will help? The Northern  Coast(-147,153) of Parnitha is just stunning. I suggest you vacation there for a while, and then talk to Meletiou in Athens.
1349.objectives: Visit the Northern  Coast(-147,153) of Parnitha Port, and then talk to Meletiou in Athens.
1349.title: [Lv105]Mandatory Vacation

1350.completion: So, you wish to become an even greater warrior? I have a few military exercises that will accomplish that, if you’re up to the task.
1350.details: Military exercises are a great way to prepare for war. Find Themistocles at Parnitha Port. His training techniques are the best in Greece.
1350.objectives: Go to Parnitha Port and speak with Themistocles.
1350.title: [Lv105]Military Exercises

1351.completion: Well done, brave warrior! You are more prepared for battle than ever before.
1351.details: Sharpen your warrior skills by killing those Venomsting Scorpions. Not only will you be more battle ready, but we’ll finally be free of those deadly arthropods. It’s win-win! When you’re done, visit good ol' Bias.
1351.objectives: Slay the Venomsting Scorpions, then go to Parnitha Port and visit Bias.
1351.title: [Lv105]Scorpion Slayer

1352.completion: Ah, brave warrior! It is good to see you again. Bias tells me you are ready for your final training. The sooner we start, the better for us all!
1352.details: There is one remaining exercise for you, and then you will truly be ready. Go to Parnitha Port and find Themistocles. He will have further instructions.
1352.objectives: Bias asked you to speak with Themistocles at Parnitha Port.
1352.title: [Lv105]Complete Your Training

1353.completion: Excellent work, soldier! This training will prove invaluable on the battlefield. You are now ready to face our foes.
1353.details: Your final exercise will not be easy. Rage Flamefrogs are nasty creatures, and hard to kill. Slay them, and your training will be complete. When you're done, report to Meletiou in Athens.
1353.objectives: Kill Rage Flamefrogs, then report to Meletiou in Athens.
1353.title: [Lv105]Rage Flamefrog's Roar

1354.completion: You did it! Those bandits will no longer impede our army’s efforts, thanks to you. And now here is your reward.
1354.details: The dogs of war are barking at our very gates! Welcome to the frontlines, warrior. I hope you remember your training, because you’re going to need it. Your first task is to kill the Persian Bandits that surround us. We can’t block the Persian army until they're all cleared out. Good luck, our men are counting on you!
1354.objectives: Defeat the Persian Bandits, then report your success to the [Round Quest]Athens Issuer.
1354.title: [Lv110]Bandits on the Run

1355.completion: Those Persian Vanguards folded quickly once you joined the battle. Thermopylae thanks you with these rewards.
1355.details: An entire legion of Persian Vanguards have begun an assault on Thermopylae. This will not stand! Kill them, for the glory of Greece!
1355.objectives: Kill the Persian Vanguards, and then claim your reward from [Round Quest]Athenian Issuer.
1355.title: [Lv120]Guarding Against the Vanguards

1356.completion: Another victory for Greece, thanks to you. Each Persian Paladin slain brings us closer to ending this war. You have earned your reward, along with our eternal thanks.
1356.details: Most paladins are sworn to be defenders of the peace, but not the scurrilous Persian Paladin. They invade our land and pillage all that crosses their path. They deserve no mercy from us.
1356.objectives: Kill the Persian Paladins, and then visit the [Daily Quest]Athenian Issuer to collect your reward.
1356.title: [Lv121]The Paladin Purge

1357.completion: It wasn’t a pretty task, but killing those Rot Hide Cooers was necessary to stop disease and boost morale. You are indeed an asset to our cause. Here is your just reward.
1357.details: The battlefield is riddled with dead soldiers, each deserving a hero’s burial. But instead, their corpses are picked clean by those disgusting Rot Hide Cooers. And where Cooers go, disease soon follows. Kill them before this becomes a bigger problem.
1357.objectives: Destroy the Rot Hide Cooers, and then speak to Telephus.
1357.title: [Lv110]Kill the Cooers

1358.completion: War is hell, and it’s even worse with disgusting creatures like White Cooers running around. Thanks to you, that’s no longer a problem. Such valiant service deserves this reward.
1358.details: A plague of White Cooers has returned, causing mayhem among our soldiers and our citizens. These disgusting creatures must be eliminated, and you are the best warrior to do it.
1358.objectives: Kill the White Cooers and report to the [Daily Quest]Athenian Issuer for a reward.
1358.title: [Lv113]Death to all Cooers

1359.completion: Reports from Thermopylae claim you have rid the area of those terrible Flaming Hounds. Bless you, brave warrior. This reward is the least we can do.
1359.details: Our soldiers at Thermopylae are not only facing a Persian invasion, but also packs of Flaming Hound. They attack with fiery fangs, and disrupt the night with dreadful howling. For our army’s wellbeing, you must exterminate these hellish beasts!
1359.objectives: Kill the Flaming Hound, and then claim your rewards from Telephus.
1359.title: [Lv119]The Bellicose Hounds

1360.completion: Those Persian Huntresses posed a serious threat to our victory, but not any longer. It is my pleasure to present you with this reward.
1360.details: Powerful Persian Huntresses have been seen at the Thermopylae battlefield, each deadly and swift. Only a warrior of your skill can hope to stop them. Good luck!
1360.objectives: Defeat Persian Huntresses at Thermopylae, and then find the [Daily Quest]Athenian Issuer to collect your reward.
1360.title: [Lv119]Who Hunts the Huntress?

1361.completion: I was unsure how we would ever defeat those Persian Vanguards, but you made it look easy. We are lucky to have you on our side! Now this reward is for you.
1361.details: Our soldiers at Thermopylae are assaulted by a new stealthy foe. Only Persian Vanguards are capable of such sneak attacks. Find these covert assassins and kill them all.
