1361.objectives: Eliminate the Persian Vanguards, and then claim your reward from the &g[Daily Quest]Athenian Issuer.
1361.title: [Lv120]Vanguards of Vengeance

1362.completion: The winds of fate are blowing in our favor! With this wand, we shall surely cripple the Persian war effort. Please accept this reward as a symbol of our thanks.
1362.details: Our spies inform us that a coven of Persian Whiterobe Mages in Thermopylae are guarding the Persian Wand. We must obtain it! Defeat the Mages, steal their wand, and bring it to Meletiou in Athens.
1362.objectives: Kill the Persian Whiterobe Mages in Thermopylae and take their sacred wand to Meletiou.
1362.title: [Lv121]Grand Theft Wand

1363.completion: Thank you, brave warrior! You have renewed our hope by stopping the Persian Clergies' frightening advance. Now take your well-earned rewards, and be proud of a job well done!
1363.details: Our messenger from Thermopylae reports that the enemy has the city surrounded. Killing the Persian Clergies is our first order of business.
1363.objectives: Kill the Persian Clergies, and then visit the [Daily Quest]Athenian Issuer to claim your reward.
1363.title: [Lv125]Clearing the Clergies

1364.completion: Yes! We have dealt a serious blow to the enemy. You have earned our thanks, as well as this reward.
1364.details: The Persian Hammer Warriors continue to steal our strategies and reveal our position. They must be dealt with... and quickly.
1364.objectives: Kill the Persian Hammer Warriors, and then claim your compensation from the [Daily Quest]Athenian Issuer.
1364.title: [Lv125]Drop The Hammer!

1365.completion: Hah! Our counterstrike was a success. We sent those Persian Soldiers packing, thanks to you! Take this for your bravery.
1365.details: It’s finally time to mount an offensive! The general has ordered a counterstrike against those Persian Soldiers. Let’s teach our foes a lesson they won’t soon forget!
1365.objectives: Kill the Persian Soldiers, and then speak with the [Daily Quest]Athenian Issuer to claim your reward.
1365.title: [Lv125]Strike and Counterstrike!

1366.completion: You’ve saved us again! With those Persian Bowyers gone, we now stand a chance for victory! Take these rewards, they are rightfully yours!
1366.details: Our soldiers are no match for those sneaky Persian Bowyers. Their arrows fall down upon us like rain. You must take them out. Now hurry, you're our only chance!
1366.objectives: Kill the Persian Bowyers, and then collect your rewards from the [Daily Quest]Athenian Issuer.
1366.title: [Lv125]Death From Above

1367.completion: Defeating the Persian Archmages is an amazing accomplishment. You should be proud, brave warrior. Please accept this!
1367.details: Few can match the power and skill of the legendary Persian Archmage. Hopefully, you are one of the few. Kill them, or we face certain defeat!
1367.objectives: Kill the Persian Archmages, and then report your success to the [Daily Quest]Athenian Issuer.
1367.title: [Lv125]Archenemies

1368.completion: By defeating those Persian Paladins, you sent a strong message to our enemies. And once again, your valor on the battlefield has earned you a reward.
1368.details: The enemy is sending forth their most powerful warriors, the deadly Persian Paladins. Are you strong enough to defeat them? I hope so, for all our sake!
1368.objectives: Kill the Persian Paladins, and then collect your rewardw from the [Daily Quest]Athenian Issuer.
1368.title: [Lv125]Paladin Power!

1369.completion: Message delivery can be dangerous business. Your service has definitely earned this reward.
1369.details: I have important information for Postman at Thermopylae. Deliver him my message at once.
1369.objectives: Deliver a message to Postman in Thermopylae.
1369.title: [Lv121]Messenger Service

1370.completion: You have killed the Persian Whiterobe Mages, and in doing so, pleased the guild leader greatly. A reward is in order.
1370.details: Your guild leader orders that you eliminate the Persian Whiterobe Mages at Thermopylae. You don’t want to disappoint them, so be strong and fight bravely!
1370.objectives: The guild leader has ordered you to eliminate the Persian Whiterobe Magess at Thermopylae.
1370.title: [Lv121]Orders From Above

1371.completion: This war has drained Greece of brave warriors. A good soldier is hard to find these days. Thank you for reporting to me. Now take this for your speedy service.
1371.details: You are indeed a brave warrior, but an army of one will not win this war. We need more fighters to rage against the invading Persians. However, recruitment is low. Leonidas in Thermopylae was leading an effort to raise an army as well. Report to him and find out if his luck has been better than mine.
1371.title: [Lv120]You and What Army

1372.completion: Your scouting report is distressing! The Persians are in greater numbers than I imagined. Thank you for your service, brave warrior. This reward is for you.
1372.details: I have an important surveillance mission for you. Sneak behind enemy lines and scout out the Persian Encampment(-140,32). Afterwards, report what you find to Meletiou in Athens.
1372.objectives: Scout the enemies at the Persian Encampment(-140,32) in Thermopylae, and then report your findings to Meletiou in Athens.
1372.title: [Lv120]Scout the Enemy

1373.completion: Meletiou's pledge to deliver supplies is a godsend. Our soldiers will rest easy knowing food and medicine is on the way.
1373.details: Our reports indicate the army at Thermopylae is running dangerously low on supplies. Report to their leader, Leonidas, and let him know help is on the way.
1373.objectives: Deliver Meletiou's message to Leonidas at Thermopylae.
1373.title: [Lv120]Supplies for Thermopylae

1374.completion: Thank you for killing those Persian Bandits. My only regret is that they can only die once!
1374.details: Persian Bandits have infiltrated Thermopylae. They steal our food and seduce our women! We must fight back. Report to Themistocles once you rid us of them all.
1374.objectives: Kill the Persian Bandits at Thermopylae, and then report to Themistocles in Parnitha Port.
1374.title: [Lv120]Bandits Must Die!

1375.completion: We have triumphed? Oh happy day! Let the word ring out that a new day has dawned, one of peace and prosperity for all of Greece!
1375.details: I’ve announced our victory to the people, and they are elated! Travel to Thermopylae and tell Leonidas the good news! That man deserves a celebration.
1375.objectives: Report the news of our victory to Leonidas at Thermopylae.
1375.title: [Lv120]A Message of Peace

1376.completion: You’ve killed the Persian Captain! This will certainly send the enemy’s morale plummeting. Take this modest reward, you deserve it and more!
1376.details: We have the enemy on the run! Now is the time to eradicate their morale. Kill the Persian Captain, and then report to Meletiou in Athens. Victory awaits!
1376.objectives: Kill the Persian Captain, and then report to Meletiou in Athens.
1376.title: [Lv120]Death of a Captain

1377.completion: The Persians are amassing their armies, and an epic battle is at hand. I may have information that can help.
1377.details: Our encounters with the Persian army have been mere skirmishes compared to the huge battle that is coming. But we still need more military intelligence. Find Marshal Leonidas, he may have valuable information for us.
1377.objectives: Find Marshal Leonidas for new intelligence.
1377.title: [Lv125]Gathering Intelligence

1378.completion: You have unearthed a wealth of new information. This will indeed come in handy.
1378.details: Yearning for a reconnaissance mission? Investigate the Eastern Open Ground (151,153) at Thermopylae, but keep a low profile. Aristotle awaits your report.
1378.objectives: Investigate the land near Eastern Open Ground (151,153) at Thermopylae, and then report your findings to Aristotle.
1378.title: [Lv125]A Little Recon

1379.completion: Aristotle is a wise and cautious man. If he believes we should attack now, that’s good enough for me. Thank you for informing me of his plan.
1379.details: The intelligence you gathered has given us an advantage. Now is the time to launch a new offensive! Tell Leonidas of my decision, you will find him at Thermopylae.
1379.title: [Lv125]Aristotle's Attack

1380.completion: The mighty Persian Paladins are now nothing but corpses. Your bravery has once again served Greece well. But don't let it get to your head.
1380.details: Persian Paladins are attacking. A clarion call has gone out to all able-bodied soldiers. We must show those paladins no mercy! Kill them all!
1380.objectives: Kill all the Persian Paladins, and then report to Themistocles.
1380.title: [Lv125]Clarion Call

1381.completion: What a bold idea...! But killing the Persian leader will not be easy. We must consider all the risks. In the meantime, here is your reward for delivering me this information.
1381.details: We are all pleased with your recent success, but now is not the time to celebrate. The Persian army remains formidable, and we are growing weary of war. Perhaps if we kill their leader, the rest of their army will disband. Speak to Marshal Leonidas to see if he has any suggestions.
1381.objectives: Discuss Themistocles' new plan with Leonidas in Thermopylae.
1381.title: [Lv125]Themistocles' Bold Plan

1382.completion: Mardonius is dead? This is a great victory for Greece! The Persian army must be in shambles. Glory to us all!
1382.details: After much consideration, I believe Themistocles' plan is the right course of action. You must assassinate Mardonius, the Persian leader. His death will undo the enemy's morale like string. Once he is dead, report to Meletiou in Athens immediately.
1382.objectives: Kill Mardonius, the leader of the invading Persian army and report to Meletiou in Athens.
1382.title: [Lv125]Assassination

1383.completion: You have proven yourself to be more than a brave warrior, but an accomplished explorer too! The mystery of the Thermopylae ruins is no longer a mystery, thanks to you.
1383.details: The Ruins (19,131) north of Thermopylae have gone unexplored for years. Check them out and see what you can find.
1383.objectives: This is an exploration quest, so you are unable to use the autotrack function. The Ruins(19,131) are just north of Thermopylae.
1383.title: [Lv122]The Ruins of Thermopylae

1384.completion: Take this fashionable item to the Valentines party. Happy Valentine's Day!
1384.details: Ha-ha, this will be an unforgettable St. Valentine's Day massacre. Kill those annoying  Snow Demons  that have invaded the suburbs with someone of the opposite sex, and you will get a special gift for Valentine's Day.
1384.objectives: Create a team of two with someone of the opposite sex and go kill the  Snow Demons  in the suburbs!
1384.title: [Lv20]<2P>Valentine's Day Gifts

1385.completion: Because you embody bravery and skill, it is with great pride that I bestow upon you the title of Champion of Greece!
1385.details: The senate has elected to honor you as the Champion of Greece. Visit the senator to claim this prestigious title.
1385.objectives: Claim your new title from the senator in Athens.
1385.title: [Lv1]A New Champion

1386.completion: It was an honor to fight by your side, soldier. Those Milier Guardsmen never knew what hit them!
1386.details: The Milier Guardsmen have assembled and are heading toward the frontline. They are coldblooded killers with little regard for innocent life. Join us in our mission to kill these monsters. Sebastiane is waiting for good news.
1386.objectives: Kill the Milier Guardsmen, and then talk to Sebastiane at Megara Coast.
1386.title: [Lv106]It's Milier Time!

1387.completion: You really rattled their bones, didn't you? Hopefully this swift act of justice will discourage any other potential traitors.
1387.details: The Skeleton Mages of Argolis have been spotted consorting with the enemy. Destroy those bony traitors, and then report to Eyfimias at Megara Coast.
1387.objectives: Destroy the Skeleton Mage of Argolis, and then talk to Eyfimias.
1387.title: [Lv110]Bad to the Bone

1388.completion: The Isthmus of Corinth runs red with the blood of young RedDragons. Take this well-earned reward, brave dragon slayer!
1388.details: It’s that time of year again, when Young RedDragons migrate to the Isthmus of Corinth. Like always, they must be killed before they are fully grown. I’m sure you’re up to the task.
1388.objectives: Kill the Young RedDragons at the Isthmus of Corinth, and then talk to the [Daily Quest]Main City Issuer.
1388.title: [Lv104]Dragon Slayer

1389.completion: You have finally arrived! Listen carefully, there is much for us to discuss.
1389.details: We are again faced with the cold reality of impending war. As we speak, guilds from around Greece are taking up arms in preparation. Find the Retired Soldier in Athens, he will tell you the details.
1389.objectives: Find the Retired Soldier in Athens.
1389.title: [Lv50]News of War

1390.completion: Hello, brave warrior! Who sent you and why do you wish to speak with me?
1390.details: Hello, brave warrior. I was once a warrior too, but the ravages of age forced me to retire. I still have a lot of connections in the army though, and they tell me war is imminent. They also tell me that supplies are running low. Only Alexiou can help. Go to him and ask him what supplies are available. You will find him in the main city.
1390.objectives: Find Alexiou in the Starting Area of the main city and ask him for war supplies.
1390.title: [Lv50]Short on Supplies

1391.completion: I'm very busy allocating materials. What is the purpose of your visit?
1391.details: The old retired soldier sent you to speak with me? Well, any friend of his is a friend of mine, but I won’t be much help. For war supplies, you should speak with Barca in Marathon. He supervises material allocation, and can help you obtain whatever you need.
1391.objectives: Alexiou instructed you to visit Barca in Marathon about obtaining war supplies.
1391.title: [Lv50]Running to Marathon

1392.completion: You’ve returned with the supplies our army so desperately needs. The war has yet to begin, and you’ve already proven yourself a hero! Choose any material and send it to the War Supplier in either Athens, the suburbs, or Marathon. Each city will reward you differently.
1392.details: Who goes there? You’re a friend of the retired soldier? That old coot never fades away. He wants war supplies? Well, I can never say no to him, and you look like an honorable warrior. I will give you the supplies. Now go back to the retired soldier and tell him the good news.
1392.objectives: Take the supplies from Barca and report to the Retired Soldier in Athens.
1392.title: [Lv50]Supplies for the War

1393.completion: You sent those pathetic Persian Mages straight to hell, which is exactly what they deserved. Your bravery inspires us all!
1393.details: Those poor Persian Mages are all alone in Thermopylae. You should pay them a visit, and cure their loneliness... with death!
1393.objectives: Eliminate the Persian Mages at Thermopylae, and then claim your reward from Telephus.
1393.title: [Lv113]The Lonely Mages

1394.completion: All of Greece thanks you for your heroic actions. I will follow you into battle any day! Until then, take this reward.
1394.details: Thermopylae is once again plagued by Persian Bandits. Of all the bandits in the world, these guys are the worst! They kill first and ask questions later. We must destroy them before they destroy us!
1394.objectives: Slay the Persian Bandits at Thermopylae, and then report to Telephus to collect your reward.
1394.title: [Lv117]Bandits of Ill Repute!

1395.completion: You are a quick study. I’ve never seen anyone take to beast riding as easily as you. Remember, they aren’t just for transportation. You can fight when riding as well. It’s a great advantage on the battlefield.
1395.details: Athens is a beautiful city, but walking is hard on the feet. The best alternative is a riding beast. But first, you have to learn how to do it. Visit Kreion, he’ll teach you everything you need to know.
1395.objectives: To learn riding skills, head to the main city and find Kreion.
1395.title: [Lv200]Beast Rider

1396.completion: The bond between steed and rider is sacred. He lives to serve you, so treat him right. You can start by placing him in the mount bar. Ride on!
1396.details: Mastering the art of beast riding was only the first step. Now you need a decent animal to ride! Don’t worry, I’ve asked Polyclitus to set aside his finest steed for you. Find him, and the steed is yours. Remember, in order to ride it, the beast must first be placed in the mount bar. Happy riding!
1396.objectives: Find Polyclitus in the main city, and ask him for a riding steed.
1396.title: [Lv200]Warrior's First Steed

1399.completion: Your visit has been the highlight of my month. It gets so lonely up here by myself. I will not forget your kindness.
1399.details: The Priestess feels terribly lonely guarding the Athenian Temple by herself. Be a good warrior and pay her a visit. It will surely make her day!
1399.objectives: Pay a visit to [Priest]Saizeriya in Athens.
1399.title: [Lv70]A Friendly Visit

1400.completion: Business has been so bad lately. But if people see a warrior like you here, they might actually stop by. Thank you for your friendship, and for possibly boosting my sales!
1400.details: [Warehouse] Belen moved to Athens in order to pick up more business, but so far her plan has backfired. She feels miserable about the lack of profits, but a visit from you would surely lift her spirit!
1400.objectives: Visit [Warehouse]Belen in the Athenian Newbie Camp.
1400.title: [Lv70]Business As Usual

1401.completion: What’s the big deal? I’m only playing! Tell my sister I am having fun and not to worry.
1401.details: Lil is a little girl who loves to play pranks. But this time she went too far, and actually ran away from home! Her big sister Eileen is frantic, and believes Lil is somewhere in Marathon. If you can reunite these siblings, you’ll be a hero to them both!
1401.objectives: Find the missing girl Lil in Marathon.
1401.title: [Lv70]Lost Child

1402.completion: Welcome to Marathon, young soulr. You may have noticed that we are not a city at peace. Perhaps you can help restore order by ridding us of these villains.
1402.details: Everyone wants peace, but few are willing to pay the price for it. The citizens of Marathon are no exception. Talk with Dionigi for more specifics.
1402.objectives: Discuss the situation in Marathon with Dionigi.
1402.title: [Lv70]Quest For Peace

1403.completion: Hello. What can I do for you? My friend is too busy and sick to help? More like too lazy! Oh well, thanks for the message!
1403.details: Hi there, weary traveller! If you’re headed to Parnitha you’ve still got a long journey ahead of you. Hey, that reminds me! Since you’re going that way, maybe you can deliver a message for me. I’m supposed to help the Parnitha Village Head, but am too busy and sick. If you can let him know that, I’ll be very grateful. Thanks!
1403.objectives: Deliver a message to the Village Head in Parnitha.
1403.title: [Lv70]Special Delivery

1404.completion: You are kind to visit us. And the people of Athens remind us of our purpose. This is just the kind of morale booster we needed!
1404.details: What has become of beautiful Parnitha? We are under constant attack from hordes of evil monsters! The Wounded Guards there are under great peril, but they are still holding the line. Raise their spirits by visiting them, and let them know all of Athens is praying for their safety.
1404.objectives: Pay a visit to the Wounded Guard in Parnitha.
1404.title: [Lv70]Mission of Mercy

1405.completion: This is grave news indeed, but with your advanced notice we now stand a good chance of defending our city. Thank you, brave warrior!
1405.details: I just heard rumor that the Death Mage is preparing to launch a large-scale invasion of Megara. Iphicrades must be informed. Find him as quickly as you can, but be careful of the mob nearby. They are strange and unpredictable, and it’s probably wise to avoid them.
1405.objectives: Bring news of the Death Mage's plans to invade Megara to Iphicrades.
1405.title: [Lv70]Random Quest Scroll

1406.completion: Greetings, brave warrior! This spy business is hard for an old man like me. Retirement sure sounds sweet. Thanks for delivering me such good news!
1406.details: Eumaeus is our spy in Argolis. The last three months have been difficult for him, and he has earned the right to retire after he completes his final mission. Please deliver that message to him, but beware! You’ll be traveling through enemy territory. Just remember, if you’re captured, tell them nothing! Good luck!
1406.objectives: Travel to Argolis and speak with the undercover spy, Eumaeus.
1406.title: [Lv70]Retirement Plan

1407.completion: You couldn’t find anything about the vanishing boat. How curious. I guess some mysteries are meant to go unsolved!
1407.details: The strangest thing happened. I always fish near an abandoned boat in the East Suburb River. But when I went there today the boat was gone! Maybe you can look around and find out where it went.
1407.objectives: Scout the suburbs of Athens around (190,150), but note that the search function is not allowed because this is an exploration quest.
1407.title: [Lv70]The Vanishing Boat

1408.completion: The Wizard Plotau’s reign of terror is over! My best soldiers couldn’t bring him down, but you sure did! I offer you my humble thanks, as well as this well-earned reward.
1408.details: In these parts, the Wizard Plotau is public enemy number one. He attacks our caravans with expert precision. We can’t continue to live this way. Kill this magical menace, and bring his head back to the Captain. A hero’s welcome will be waiting for you!
1408.objectives: Kill the Wizard Plotau in Parnitha, and then bring his head to the Captain.
1408.title: [Lv70]Public Enemy

1409.completion: Wow, you just killed 50 Dark Wizards without even breaking a sweat. Word of your deed will travel fast, so get used to being called a hero!
1409.details: Parnitha has been targeted by a clan of Dark Wizards. They scare the children and take the joy out of life. You are our only hope to drive them away of our village once and for all!
1409.objectives: Kill 50 Dark Wizard in Parnitha, and then report to the Captain for your reward.
1409.title: [Lv70]The Wizards of Dark!

1410.completion: Yo, those spiders were talking smack until you came around. Now they don’t talk at all cause they’re dead! Word.
1410.details: Ain’t no spider like a Marathon spider cause a Marathon spider don’t stop! They’re also big and ugly and full of deadly venom. Exterminate this menace before someone gets hurt!
1410.title: [Lv70]Spiders of Doom!

1411.completion: You found Lil’s ring! Where did the lion keep it? Wait, I don’t want to know, the answer could be gross. In any case, thank you so much!
1411.details: I was chasing a Huge Lion the other day, and now I can’t find the ring I bought for Lil. Alas, could it be that the lion ate the ring?! Without it, I have no gift for Lil. I cannot bear to imagine her saddened face.
1411.objectives: Gerrhus in Marathon requests you kill a Huge Lion, and return his Lost Ring.
1411.title: [Lv70]Lil's Ring

1412.completion: You killed those feral beasts! Let us howl with delight, for tonight we feast on wolf meat!
1412.details: This land is rich with wildlife, perfect for hunters like me and Gerrhus. But lately, a large pack of Vicious Wolves have moved in. They wait to attack us during our return from the hunt, and then steal our dinner! These wolves must be stopped or we’ll all starve!
1412.objectives: Kill 50 Vicious Wolves, and report the good news to Vanguard Captain Gerrhus.
1412.title: [Lv70]Big Bad Wolves

1413.completion: Thank you, brave warrior. You have done Greece a great service. However, I am sad. Salose was once a noble man. What a tragedy.
1413.details: Long ago, the hero of Athens was a general named Salose. He fought bravely against the Persians, and was a devoted defender of Greece. But that was before the famous Battle of Thermopylae, where he and his men were nearly destroyed by an evil force. Salose never recovered from that incident, and his soul became tainted with darkness. He blames Greece for his downfall, and now seeks revenge as the head of the Dark Necromancers. They are targeting Parnitha as we speak. Kill this fallen hero before his evil spreads any further, and then report your deed to Bias.
1413.objectives: Destroy the Dark Necromancer Salose in Parnitha, and speak with Bias.
1413.title: [Lv70]Salose the Fallen

1414.completion: Hey, you did it! You must feel like a real hero! Just be careful, there are a lot more threats out there than just little snakes.
1414.details: Newbie Camp is overrun with Little Snakes. They slither around like they own the place. Each one packs enough venom to kill us all! Okay, that might be an exaggeration, but still... these things need to die!
1414.objectives: Kill 30 Little Snakes, and then report to Zander in the Newbie Camp of the main city.
1414.title: [Lv70]Mo Snakes Mo Problems

1415.completion: The world is a better place without those Forest Magicians and their weird Milier beliefs. You are indeed one of Greece’s most valuable allies!
1415.details: Milierism is a mystic cult, with roots in Babylonian astrology. Miliers used to practice their faith in peace, but that has changed. Paranoia is their master now, as they’ve grown to mistrust all “outsiders.” The Forest Magicians on the Isthmus of Corinth are among the worst Miliers in Greece. They attack our citizens for no reason, and must be stopped!
1415.objectives: Annihilate 30 Forest Magicians on the Isthmus of Corinth, and report to Iphicrades of Megara.
1415.title: [Lv70]Death Cult for Cutie

1416.completion: I’m glad to see that Boar King is dead. Maybe our crops can recover and feed more than just him! As a reward, all I can offer you is a boar mount. Interested?
1416.details: Boars make great pets. In fact, many are even trained to be ridden. But not the Boar King! He thinks himself above such servitude. He also feels entitled to our crops, and is eating us out of house and home. Go stick this stuck-up pig, and then let Bias in Parnitha know what you’ve done.
1416.objectives: Kill the Boar King Tomas, and then tell Bias in Parnitha about it.
1416.title: [Lv70]What A Pig!

1417.completion: Oh, revenge sure is sweet. I wish I could have seen that mean queen’s face when you beat her up. Thank you, you’re a real friend!
1417.details: Vicious Queen Nina is a bully, and she’s mean, and I hate her so much! I bet you could beat her up. Will you? Oh please do me this favor, and I’ll be your best friend forever!
1417.objectives: Beat up Vicious Queen Nina in the suburbs, and then go talk with Alns in the Newbie Camp.
1417.title: [Lv70]The Queen of Mean

1418.completion: You are my number one snake killer! Thank you for helping me get rid of those slimy serpents.
1418.details: Is this Greece, or SnakeLand? It’s hard to tell with so many Snakes invading our suburbs. You must be here to get rid of them. Thanks for volunteering!
1418.objectives: Drive away the Snakes in the suburbs, and then report to Nemodes in the Newbie Camp.
1418.title: [Lv70]Random Quest Scroll

1419.completion: Thanks! You really saved my hide by killing those wild boars. Sadly, all I have to offer is more pork. Oops!
1419.details: Ugh! Raw pork sure is tasty, but you pay a heavy price later. What I would give to get a new, pain-free stomach! I guess that's my price for stealing from the food supply... and now I'm 30 Wild Boars short. Yikes, did I eat all that?
1419.objectives: Kill 30 Wild Boars in Parnitha, and then report to Aiputos.
1419.title: [Lv70]Tricky Trichinosis

1420.completion: Welcome to Heroa, where great heroes of the past are laid to rest in eternal peace. Perhaps many years from now, you will earn the right to join them.
1420.details: All heroes-in-training eventually visit Heroa to pay their respects to the heroes of the past. Are you ready to make that pilgrimage?
1420.objectives: Go to (-184,-184) in the suburb of Athens to pay homage to Heroa.
1420.title: [Lv70]The Heroes of Heroa

1421.completion: With those mages gone, the stench of death has cleared from the air. Thank you, brave warrior. You really did some good today!
1421.details: A gang of Death Mages have set up camp in Megara. If you’re a true warrior, then you’ll have no problem killing these hostile mages in their own camp!
1421.objectives: Kill 50 Death Mage in Megara, and then report to Byzas.
1421.title: [Lv70]Random Quest Scroll

1422.completion: Wow, that mob wasn’t so tough after all. At one point, I thought they were going to cry! By the way, did you get any torches from them?
1422.details: The Mobs are back, and they’re taking over Megara. Folks are afraid to leave their homes! This is no way to live. Do Megara a favor and mow this mob down.
1422.objectives: Kill 10 Mobs in Megara, and then report the news to Theognis.
1422.title: [Lv70]Mob Rule

1423.completion: Wow, 30 dead little weird birds. If there’s a prettier sight, I don’t want to know about it. Now let the dissections begin!
1423.details: Ornithology is the study of birds, and I am one of Greece’s most renowned ornithologists. But there is a species of Little Weird Birds around the Isthmus of Corinth that warrants closer study. In the name of science, please bring me those birds!
1423.objectives: Kill 30 Little Weird Birds in Isthmus of Corinth, and then return to Pylades in Megara.
1423.title: [Lv70]Bye Bye Birdies

1424.completion: My fear of snakes is second only to my love for you. Thank you for killing them! Now we can be fishermen again, instead of scaredymen!
1424.details: The once snakeless city of Megara is now overrun with deadly Pallas Pit Vipers. It’s not as fun as it sounds. Like all hordes of venomous serpents, these things need to die. And you’re just the warrior to do it!
1424.objectives: Slay 20 Pallas Pit Viper in Megara, and then tell the Fishermen the good news.
1424.title: [Lv70]Pit Vipers are the Pits

1425.completion: Thanks to you, those Skeleton Warrior are gone! Hopefully this will discourage others from trying to take over our city. God bless Greece, and no place else!
1425.details: Megara is really going downhill. Now we have tribes of Skeleton Warriors moving in. They’re trying to assimilate into our culture, and soon will want full citizenship. This can’t happen! You better kill them before they get any other bright ideas!
1425.objectives: Kill 10 Skeleton Warriors in Megara, and then report to Sebastiane.
1425.title: [Lv70]Skeletons Go Home!

1426.completion: You really broke some bones out there! I guess those punk Skeleton Warlocks were all teeth and no bite! Thanks!
1426.details: A rowdy bunch of Skeleton Warlocks are up to no good in Megara. They’re mean to little kids, and sometimes say rude things to the elderly. The only way to teach them any respect is to kill them!
1426.objectives: Destroy 10 Skeleton Warlocks, and then report to Sebastiane in Megara.
1426.title: [Lv70]Skeletal Punks!

1427.completion: You smell like dead Poisonous Frogs. That’s a good thing! Thanks for getting rid of those things.
1427.details: Earlier this year, the trendy gift for Parnithian children was an adorable poisonous tadpole. Well, the tadpoles quickly grew into Poisonous Frogs, and now we’re overrun with toxic amphibians! Kill them before they multiply any further!
1427.objectives: Kill 50 Poisonous Frogs in Parnitha, and then report the quest to the Captain.
1427.title: [Lv70]Parnitha's Poison

1428.completion: You put the hurt on those witches. Awesome! Now maybe things can start to go back to normal around here!
1428.details: We got 99 problems, but a witch ain't one. Actually, that’s not true. The Witches in Parnitha are a huge problem. Slay those foul magic-users, it’s what they deserve!
1428.objectives: Travel to Parnitha and kill 30 Witches, and then visit the Captain in the village.
1428.title: [Lv70]When Witches Die

1429.completion: It’s nice to see the suburbs without the skeleton hoodlums cluttering up the place. You’ve really got a knack for this stuff!
1429.details: I got a bone to pick with all the Skeletons in the suburbs. It wouldn’t be so bad if they’d just clean up after themselves, but no! They’re a bunch of slobs and they need be dead now. Thanks.
1429.objectives: Destroy 40 Skeletons in the suburbs, and find Dorotheou in the Newbie Camp for your reward.
1429.title: [Lv70]Skeleton Slobs

1430.completion: The evil that little deer do is now buried with their festering carcasses. Thank you, brave warrior. Greece is in your debt!
1430.details: Once upon a time, the fields of Greece were a playground for countless Little Deer. But then an evil infected their souls, and they grew into snarling beasts of prey. Killing them is our only option now.
1430.objectives: Kill 20 Little Deer in the Newbie Camp, and then report to Dorotheou.
1430.title: [Lv70]This Deer Possessed!

1431.completion: Greece has faced many foes, but none as scary as that little bee. I thank you, as does my tongue!
1431.details: That Little Bee just stung my tongue. It’s swelling up! Soon I won’t be able to speak! Kill that bee! Avenge my tongue!
1431.objectives: Teach the Little Bee in the Newbie Camp a lesson, then tell Dorotheou about it.
1431.title: [Lv70]Bee Minor

1432.completion: Those skeleton creeps keep coming, and you keep knocking them down. I shudder to think where Greece would be without you!
1432.details: What’s worse than Skeleton Warriors? Skeleton Warlock, that’s what! They use bad grammar, and are really cheap. Plus, I hear they are planning to attack our camp. How messed up is that? Kill those monsters!
1432.objectives: Kill 50 Skeleton Warlocks in Megara, and report to Pylades.
1432.title: [Lv70]War with the Warlocks

1433.completion: You’re back! Did you enjoy the river? Natural beauty like that reminds us what we’re fighting for.
1433.details: Greece isn’t just about war and duty. It’s also filled with beauty, like the river Gyges? You should really check it out. There is a path that leads right to it, starting from the Newbie Camp. Enjoy!
1433.objectives: Your journey to Gyges (40,157)is an exploration quest, therefor the search function is not available.
1433.title: [Lv70]Journey to Gyges

1434.completion: Great work, brave warrior! Maybe I’ll make some Harpy Underling soup out of the corpses you left behind. Sounds yummy!
1434.details: Here’s a riddle: What has long nails, pale faces, and rhymes with sharpy funderlings? The answer is Harpy Underlings, of course! There’s a bunch of them running around the Isthmus of Corinth, ready to be killed by a brave warrior. Will you do it? Great!
1434.objectives: Kill 40 Harpy Underlings at the Isthmus of Corinth, and then report to Pylades in Megara.
1434.title: [Lv70]Harpy Hunting

1435.completion: With those Bad Tempered Deer gone, the sun feels warmer and the sky seems bluer. Everything is better now, thanks to you!
1435.details: Deer are mostly gentle creatures, but not in Marathon. Our Bad Tempered Deer need an attitude adjustment. Kill those surly stags!
1435.objectives: Kill 30 Bad Tempered Deer in Marathon, and then report to [Props]Thoas.
1435.title: [Lv70]Don't Fear the Deer

1436.completion: You have done me a great favor, brave warrior. I don’t’ know how I’ll ever repay you.
1436.details: Welcome to Marathon, brave warrior. As you can see, I am but a humble merchant struggling to make ends meet. Times are hard, but those Robber Lolos make things even harder. They raid my business, and must be stopped. Do an honest businessman a favor and kill those hoodlums!
1436.objectives: Bring down 10 Robber Lolos, and turn report the good news to [Props]Thoas, the Prop merchant in Marathon.
1436.title: [Lv70]The Merchant's Tale

1437.completion: Welcome to the Athens Lighthouse! It’s a crowning achievement of our culture and ingenuity. Plus, the pretty light keeps ships from crashing into our coast. Everybody wins!
1437.details: Ever wonder where that beautiful light that fills the sky over Athens comes from? It’s from Athens Lighthouse, and it's worth a visit! When you get there, make a wish. Legend has it, any wish made at the Lighthouse will eventually come true!
1437.objectives: Find the Athens Lighthouse (-182,146). As with all exploration quests, the search function is not available.
1437.title: [Lv70]The Athens Lighthouse

1438.completion: Knowing those Wandering Skeletons are dead is a great relief, but nothing will bring my beloved back to me. You have helped right a great wrong today, brave warrior. Thank you!
1438.details: My name is Phaedrus, and my story is one of heartbreak and pain. I foolishly neglected the love of my life, so she ran away with some Wandering Skeleton. They eventually killed her, and left me with nothing but regret. I want her avenged! In the name of love, please kill those skeletons!
1438.objectives: Avenge poor Phaedrus of Parnitha by killing 40 Wandering Skeletons, and then report back to him.
1438.title: [Lv70]Love and Revenge

1439.completion: Those Mutated Frogs were starting to freak me out. Glad to see you put an end to them. Thanks!
1439.details: When the Persians invaded, they brought with them a menagerie of terrible monsters. Even though we defeated our enemy, their monsters continue to multiply. We can’t seem to wipe them out completely! The latest outbreak is at Plataea Portal, where a new breed of Mutated Frogs have been spotted. Eliminate these amphibious freaks, and then report to Sebastiane in Megara.
1439.objectives: Kill 20 Mutated Frogs at Plataea Portal, and then report to Sebastiane in Megara.
1439.title: [Lv70]Amphibious Freaks

1440.completion: The Crocodile Selous’ are dead! Thank you for freeing Megara from their tyranny! You are braver than I will ever be!
1440.details: For years, the authorities of Megara refused to believe that monstrous Crocodile Selous' lurked in our shadows. But people kept disappearing, and they were forced to face the truth. Now those same authorities are determined to kill the crocs once and for all, and they believe you’re the one to do it.
1440.objectives: Kill 50 Crocodile Selous' in Megara, and then report the news to Pylades.
1440.title: [Lv70]Crocodile Denial

1441.completion: You have done a great service to our suburb today, brave warrior. Please help yourself to all the oxen beef you can stomach!
1441.details: A few Wild Oxen is a good thing. They play a vital role in keeping our lovely suburb thriving. But too many can cause big problems. You need to thin the herd a bit. Afterwards, we will celebrate with a fancy oxen barbeque!
1441.objectives: Kill 50 Wild Ox in the suburbs, and then report to [scholar merchant]Moya back at the Newbie Camp.
1441.title: [Lv70]Thin The Herd

1442.completion: That was a strange quest, but you proved yourself to be more than a match for those dressing boxes. Good work!
1442.details: Okay, here’s something you don’t see every day. Several of Lamia's Dressing Boxes have come to life, and are attacking people. You don’t believe me? Go to the suburbs and see for yourself. While you’re there, kill as many of those possessed boxes as you can!
1442.objectives: Go to the suburbs and kill 50  Lamia's Dressing Boxes, and then report to [Scholar merchant]Moya back at the Newbie Camp.
1442.title: [Lv70]Boxes? Yes, boxes!

1443.completion: You are indeed a brave warrior, but you are not yet a great hero. Now that you’re here, perhaps we can change that.
1443.details: Long ago, Amphitryon was exiled to Plataea for crimes against Greece. Since then, his children have grown to be great heroes, thus redeeming their criminal father. Since you too wish to be a hero, you should pay him a visit.
1443.title: [Lv70]The Hero Maker

1444.completion: Um, whoever told you I make durable lambskins was sadly mistaken. But I’m always happy to see a brave warrior, so welcome to Plataea!
1444.details: There is a Fellmonger in Plataea who makes the most durable lambskins. I must know her secret. Visit her and see what you can find out.
1444.objectives: Speak with the Fellmonger of Plataea.
1444.title: [Lv70]Secret Skin

1445.completion: Wow, not only did you kill the giant Boas, but you looked good while doing it. Style and bravery are a rare combination. Good for you!
1445.details: Have you ever seen one of Marathon’s Boas? No? I’m not surprised. Most people who get close enough to see one don’t live to tell the tale. But you aren’t most people. You’re a brave warrior, and should have no problem killing these enormous snakes!
1445.objectives: Kill 20 Boas at Marathon, and then report to Gerrhus.
1445.title: [Lv70]The Bold and the Boas

1446.completion: I’ve seen many warriors in my time, but none could kill a frog like you. Be proud, brave heart, for you have done well.
1446.details: I can’t go anywhere these days without running into a bunch of big belly Frogs. They’re all over the place, but mostly in the land south of Marathon. It’s time for these little froggies to croak!
1446.objectives: Kill 10 Frogs and then report to Gerrhus.
1446.title: [Lv70]The Frogs of War

1447.completion: The Cursed Zone has one less monster resident now, thanks to you. Maybe someday, we can reverse the god’s curse and return this land to its original splendor.
1447.details: This area used to be heaven on Earth, until a few drunken citizens offended the gods. The angry deities were quick to cast a blight upon the land, turning it into the Cursed Zone. Now horrible monsters roam freely, and attack people with little consequence. For example, the Centauri Heathen has been running amok. Kill this monster, and help relieve our eternal curse.
1447.objectives: Kill 1 Centauri Heathen in the Cursed Zone, then report to [Jewelry]Antigone at the Newbie Camp.
1447.title: [Lv70]The Centauri Assassination

1448.completion: Are you enjoying the splendor of the Natural Moat? Of course you are. Who wouldn’t?
1448.details: According to legend, the Natural Moat at the Isthmus of Corinth was created when one of the gods threw an ax into the ground. Whether or not you believe these ancient tales, the moat is definitely worth seeing. Enjoy your trip.
1448.objectives: Visit the Natural Moat at Isthmus of Corinth (-31,22). This is an exploration quest, and therefore the search function is disabled.
1448.title: [Lv70]The Natural Moat

1449.completion: It is with great honor that I bestow upon you the title of Guardian of Greece. May Greece continue to benefit from your honored service.
1449.details: The gods of GodsWar are pleased with your service, and have deemed you worthy of a new title. We dub thee Guardian of Greece! You can claim this title from the senator in Sparta.
1449.objectives: Claim your new title from the senator in Athens.
1449.title: [Lv1]Guardian of Greece!

1450.completion: You must be the brave warrior that everyone is talking about. I have your special title here, and am honored to present you with it. From this day forward, you are Orion the Magnificent!
1450.details: Your tireless devotion to Greece has won favor with the gods of GodsWar. They wish to award you with the special title of Orion the Magnificent! Few have ever earned this great honor. Congratulations!
1450.objectives: Claim your new title from the senator in Athens.
1450.title: [Lv1]A New Orion!

1451.completion: In all my years as a senator, I have never met an actual Legendary Hero. I am honored beyond words to present this title to you. Your service makes us all proud!
1451.details: There are many heroes in GodsWar, but few become actual legends in their own time. You are one of the few. The gods of GodsWar wish to crown you Legendary Hero! Well done!
1451.objectives: Claim your new title from the senator in Athens.
1451.title: [Lv1]Legendary Hero

1452.completion: The amount of monsters you have slain is truly impressive. Greece is a better place for it. Take this title of Monster Slayer and be proud!
1452.details: You are no friend of monsters, that much is obvious. But the gods of GodsWar have chosen to award you with the title of Monster Slayer, and that puts you in a class few ever achieve. Huzzah!
1452.objectives: Claim your new title from the senator in Athens.
1452.title: [Lv1]Monster Slayer

1456.completion: That was a hard won victory, brave warrior. I hate to imagine what those Huntresses and Wolves would have done had you not stopped them. Take this reward, you’ve earned it!
1456.details: An unholy alliance has been forged between a coven of Persian Huntresses and packs of wild Flame Wolves. They are attacking Thermopylae as we speak! Destroy them all, and destroy them now!
1456.objectives: Slay 25 Persian Huntresses and 25 Flame Wolves at Thermopylae. Afterwards, find Telephus and report what you've done.
1456.title: [Lv121]Unholy Alliance

1457.completion: The Oracle of Athens is pleased with your service, and hopes you are equally pleased with this reward.
1457.details: The Oracle of Athens has requested that you rid the suburbs of 500 Wild Oxen. Apparently they have overbred again, and must be destroyed.
1457.objectives: Kill 500 Wild Oxen and then report to Paris in Athens.
1457.title: [Lv1]Athena's Oracle I

1458.completion: For ridding Greece of all those Bad Tempered Deer, the Oracle of Athens presents you with this bountiful reward.
1458.details: By order from the Oracle of Athens, you have been tasked with the killing of 500 Bad Tempered Deer in Marathon. They need a permanent attitude adjustment, and you’re just the warrior to do it.
1458.objectives: Destroy 500 Bad Tempered Deer in Marathon, and then report to Paris in Athens.
1458.title: [Lv31]Oracle: Bad Tempered Deer

1459.completion: You have been blessed by the Oracle of Athens for killing those wicked witches in Parnitha. Well done, brave warrior!
1459.details: There are 500 witches taking up residence in Parnitha, and the Oracle of Athens wants them dead. Do what you do best, and send those sinful sorceresses to an early grave.
1459.objectives: Slay 500 Witches in Parnitha, and then report to Ctesias.
1459.title: [Lv51]Oracle's Orders - Witches

1460.completion: Warriors who obey the will of the Oracle of Athens are rewarded handsomely, and you are no exception. Congratulations!
1460.details: If there’s one thing the Oracle of Athens can’t stand, it’s Poisonous Frogs. This may explain why you’ve been tasked with killing 500 of those toxic critters in Parnitha. Hop to it!
1460.objectives: Eliminate 500 Poisonous Frogs in Parnitha, and then report to Ctesias.
1460.title: [Lv61]Oracle: Poisonous Frogs

1461.completion: By bringing death to those Death Mages, the Oracle of Athens has blessed you with this special reward.
1461.details: An entire army of Death Mages are gathering at the Megara coast. The Oracle of Athens believes this is our best chance to take them all out at once, and has trusted you to do it!
1461.objectives: Bring death to 500 Death Mages and then report to Iphicrades.
1461.title: [Lv71]Athena's Oracle V

1462.completion: You were wise to follow the Oracle of Athens’ order, and now is the time for you to reap the rewards of that wisdom.
1462.details: One or two Crocodile Selous off the Megara coast is no big deal. But now there are at least 500 there, and people are worried. The Oracle of Athens wants them dead, and believes you are the best suited to do it.
1462.objectives: Kill 500 Crocodile Selou along the Megara coast, and then report to Iphicrades.
1462.title: [Lv81]Athena's Oracle VI

1463.completion: The Oracle of Athens believes you to be a trusted servant of Greece, and has rewarded you accordingly.
1463.details: What makes a Strange Toad so strange? Who cares, the Oracle of Athens wants them dead! Kill 500 of them in Plataea, the future of Greece depends on it!
1463.objectives: Annihilate 500 Strange Toads in Plataea, and then report to Iphicrades.
1463.title: [Lv91]Athena's Oracle VII

1464.completion: Killing those Cyclops has earned you gratitude from the Oracle of Athens, as well as this lavish reward.
1464.details: I once met a Cyclops that had two eyes. It was very confusing, but none of that matters now. There are 500 of those monocular freaks in Plataea, and the Oracle of Athens wants them gone. You better get on it!
1464.objectives: Slay 500 Cyclops in Plataea, and then report to Iphicrades.
1464.title: [Lv101]Oracle's Orders - Cyclops

1465.completion: Your deeds on the battlefield in Plataea have not gone unnoticed by the Oracle of Athens. Take this well-earned reward with pride!
1465.details: Plataea was a lot nicer before the Scholar Kals moved in. Now things are falling apart there, and the Oracle of Athens wants order restored. Kill 500 of those snobby scholars, and bring peace back to Plataea.
1465.objectives: Kill 500 Scholar Kals in Plataea, and then report to the Thracian Mercenary.
1465.title: [Lv106]Athena's Oracle IX

1466.completion: For killing all of those obnoxious Wind Elves in Plataea, the Oracle of Athens is pleased to present you with this special reward.
1466.details: The atmosphere over Plataea is foul with the stench of Wind Elves. The Oracle of Athens is not pleased about it, and wishes you to kill 500 of those airy imps as soon as possible!
1466.objectives: Destroy 500 Wind Elves in Plataea, and then report to the Thracian Mercenary.
1466.title: [Lv111]Athena's Oracle X

1467.completion: By order from the Oracle of Athens, you are to be recognized for your bravery and duty with this special reward.
1467.details: An evil combination of Persian Huntresses and Flame Wolves has invaded Thermopylae. The Oracle of Athens will not be at peace until they are dead! Kill 250 Huntresses and Wolves, and all will be well again.
1467.objectives: Get rid of 250 Flame Wolves and 250 Persian Huntresses at Thermopylae, and then report to Telephus.
1467.title: [Lv121]Oracle: Deadly Packs

1468.completion: Because you have fought for Greece so bravely, I will allow you to read the Craftsman’s Skillbook. Study it closely, and it will serve you well.
1468.details: Find Polyclitus in the main city, and ask him about the mysterious Craftsman's Skillbook. Within its pages are the ultimate secrets to almost every trade!
1468.objectives: Find Polyclitus in the main city, and ask him for the mysterious Craftsman's Skillbook.
1468.title: [Lv70]The Book of Secrets

1469.completion: You have answered the call to battle! Good, your skills of war will be put to the test this fateful night. Fight well, and you shall be rewarded!
1469.details: Cry “Havoc!” and let slip the dogs of war! The fair Helen has been seduced by Paris, the playboy prince of Troy. This act of insolence will not be tolerated! As we speak, King Agamemnon is preparing an attack on Troy, and has vowed to bring Helen back. We need all the brave soldiers we can find. If this means you, then report to Menelaus at the Trojan beach at 8:00pm on Thursday's.
1469.objectives: Report to Menelaus at the Trojan beach every Thursday at  8:00pm.
1469.title: [Lv50]Trojan War

1470.completion: All this fuss just for little ol’ me? I’m flattered, but not surprised. When you’re as beautiful as I am, these things tend to happen. But enough is enough. I’m ready to go back to my husband, Menelaus.
1470.details: I have heard tale of your skills on the battlefield, and am grateful you chose to answer Agamemnon’s call to war. My wife Helen is the most beautiful woman in all of Greece, and she must be returned to my side. Retrieving her will be your job, once we’ve broken through Troy’s formidable defenses. For love and glory we will win this fight!
1470.objectives: Fight your way into Troy and rescue Helen.
1470.title: [Lv50]Rescuing Helen

1472.completion: Welcome to the Pindus Mountains Battlefield. I hope you are thirsty for war!
1472.details: Check in for duty at the Pindus Mountains Battlefield by hitching a ride with the Battlefield Transporter, and then sign up with the Battlefield Crier. Times are between 11:00am to 11:45am Wed. and Sun. 9:00pm to 9:45pm Sat.
1472.objectives: Fight in the Pindus Mountains Battlefield.
1472.title: [Lv60]Pindus Mountains Battlefield

1473.details: There’s only one way to win this war, and that’s by delivering holy water to the altars. This will earn us the points we need for victory! You can obtain holy water from the War Supplier. Get some, and then bring it back to me.
1473.objectives: Get some [Holy Water]*1 from the [Athens]War Supplier, and then deliver it to the Battlefield Crier.
1473.title: [Lv60]Holy Water Solution

1474.completion: Greetings! I hear you have been killing Cooers in Thermopylae. My confused friend will be pleased. You have won his trust and mine as well. Take this reward as payment for all your hard work.
1474.details: Oh, I seem to have wandered someplace strange and unrecognizable. Who are you? A brave warrior? Ha, that has yet to be seen! If you want to win my trust, go to Thermopylae and kill 50 White cooers and 50 Rot Hide Cooers. Why? I have my reasons! When you’re done, report to the Athens Traveler. He’s my friend and will know where to find me. Now I just need to figure out which way is home!
1474.objectives: Go to Thermopylae to kill 50 White Cooers and 50 Rot Hide Cooers, and then report to the Athens Traveler.
1474.title: [Lv121]A Confused Man's Trust

1475.completion: I see you’re back from Thermopylae, still covered in the blood of those wicked Persian Mages and Bandits. Good job! My friend with the memory problem will be happy to hear it, as am I. Now here is your reward.
1475.details: Ouch! I hit my head and can’t remember anything other than how much I hate Persian Mages and Persian Bandits. They need to die! Can I trust you to kill them for me? I overheard a man say there are some in Thermopylae. Slay those foreign wizards and thieves, and then report to the Athens Traveler. Ohh, my memory is getting worse. What were we talking about?
1475.objectives: Go to Thermopylae and kill enough Persian Mages and Persian Bandits to you win 10 Sacred Staffs. When you're done, report to the Athens Traveler.
1475.title: [Lv121]The Angry Amnesiac

1476.completion: Nice work! You really took the sting out of those Wasps! Feel free to buzz back anytime. Until then, here’s your reward!
1476.details: When I was a child, a nest of wasps attacked my head. It took mother three weeks to pull out all the stingers! I’ve never forgiven them for that, and am now on a crusade to kill every wasp I find. Help me fulfill this lifelong mission, and you will be rewarded in kind!
1476.objectives: Kill enough Wasps, and then find Ion at the Starting Area of the main city.
1476.title: [Lv200]Wasp War I

1477.completion: Nothing pleases me more than knowing all those Wasps are dead. Let’s pause for a moment and really enjoy this. Okay, that’s enough. Here’s your reward.
1477.details: When I was a child, a nest of wasps attacked my... oh, you’ve already heard this story. Sorry, my hatred for wasps makes me forgetful sometimes. In any case, there are more of these damned insects flying around. I’ve got another reward, if you agree to help again!
1477.objectives: Kill enough Wasps, and then find Ion at the Starting Area of the main city.
1477.title: [Lv200]Wasp War II

1478.completion: Wow, you killed those Snakes as if they were helpless worms! I love it! Here’s your reward for a job well done!
1478.details: Is there anything more disgusting than a snake? They don’t have any limbs! That’s just gross. Whenever I see a snake, I kill it. But there are too many of them these days. I can’t keep up! Help me kill these snakes, and I’ll make it worth your while!
1478.objectives: Kill enough Snakes, and then find Ion at the Starting Area of the main city.
1478.title: [Lv200]Snake Slayer I

1479.completion: You must have killed a million Snakes! Maybe more! And no, I never exaggerate. This reward is for you.
1479.details: Hey, you’re the one that helped me kill those disgusting snakes earlier! It was fun, right? Are you up for another round? Yay! Now let’s go kill us some more snakes, partner!
1479.objectives: Kill enough Snakes, and then find Ion at the Starting Area of the main city.
1479.title: [Lv200]Snake Slayer II

1480.completion: I can’t remember the last time I saw so many Wild Oxen be slaughtered. You’re a maniac, but in a good way. Here’s your well-earned reward.
1480.details: Wild Oxen are dumb. There’s no other way to put it. In fact, they’re so dumb that killing them is an act of mercy. Do the humane thing, and put as many of those dumb Wild Oxen out of their misery as you can.
1480.objectives: Kill enough Wild Oxen, and then find Ion at the Starting Area of the main city.
1480.title: [Lv200]Dumb Oxen I

1481.completion: It will be a long time before those Wild Oxen recover from the smackdown you just handed them. They never saw it coming! Good work!
1481.details: I remember you! You’re the Wild Oxen killer. Wow, you really slaughtered a lot of those silly beasts. But there’s more. There’s always more. The time to kill more Wild Oxen is now. Why? Because they’re so dumb, that’s why!
1481.objectives: Kill enough Wild Oxen, and then find Ion at the Starting Area of the main city.
1481.title: [Lv200]Dumb Oxen II

1482.completion: I used to go through life never worried about Dressing Boxes, but then one came to life and bit my face! We live in strange times, my friend. Thanks for killing so many of them!
1482.details: It may be hard to imagine a box as a monster, but with Lumia’s Dressing boxes, the threat is all too real. They really hurt, especially their pointy corners. Do us a favor and kill these boxes before somebody loses an eye!
1482.objectives: Kill enough Lumia's Dressing Boxes, and then find Ion at the Starting Area of the main city.
1482.title: [Lv200]Box Buster I

1483.completion: The only good Dressing Box is a dead Dressing Box, and that’s exactly what they are thanks to you. And for your fantastic work, I give you this reward.
1483.details: You were brave against those boxes earlier, but I fear more have returned. Is there no end to this box blight? Hopefully after another round of killing them, they will get the hint and leave. Now go get them!
1483.objectives: Kill enough Lumia's Dressing Boxes, and then find Ion at the Starting Area of the main city.
1483.title: [Lv200]Box Buster II

1484.completion: When I asked you to kill all those Vipers, I wondered if you could actually do the job. But you certainly put those doubts to rest! Good work!
1484.details: What kind of world do we live in where deadly Vipers can slither around wherever they please? This is not the Greece I grew up in. Kill these serpents and restore my homeland to its former glory!
1484.objectives: Kill enough Vipers, and then find Ion at the Starting Area of the main city.
1484.title: [Lv200]Viper Sniper I

1485.completion: Another day, another Viper slaughter. Where would we be without you, brave warrior? Knee-deep in Vipers, probably. Thanks!
1485.details: You did such a good job with that first round of Viper killing that I volunteered you for round two! So get out there and show those sneaky snakes who’s boss!
1485.objectives: Kill enough Vipers, and then find Ion at the Starting Area of the main city.
1485.title: [Lv200]Viper Sniper II

1486.completion: I wish I could have seen you take out all those Skeletons. Did their bones snap? I bet they did. How exciting! Here’s your reward.
1486.details: The evil that possesses these Skeletons must be taught to let sleeping bones lie! You’re just the one to teach this lesson, and class is in session! Kill them all!
1486.objectives: Kill enough Skeletons, and then find Ion at the Starting Area of the main city.
1486.title: [Lv200]Scary Skeletons

1487.completion: Eww! I accidentally stepped in the carcass of one of those Huge Spiders you killed. They really leave a mess! Anyway, thanks for your hard work.
1487.details: Some say Huge Spiders are cuddly and misunderstood creatures. I say to Tataros with that nonsense! They are a menace to Marathon and must be killed.
1487.objectives: Kill enough Huge Spiders, and then find Dionigi in Marathon.
1487.title: [Lv200]Spider Fighter I

1488.completion: I saw what you did to those Huge Spiders! Brutal stuff! The image will haunt my dreams, but it’s my fault for looking. Here, take this reward. You earned it!
1488.details: Oh my! My spider sense tells me another wave of Huge Spiders is just on the horizon. Will you take up arms once again and slay these vile arachnids? I thought you would.
1488.objectives: Kill enough Huge Spiders, and then find Dionigi in Marathon.
1488.title: [Lv200]Spider Fighter II

1489.completion: I love the sound of Huge Spiders screaming for their lives, and you really made them howl! I know you think that's sadistic, and I guess I can't disagree...
1489.details: Each Huge Spider mother can lay over 14 billion eggs a day! That’s why there are so many. Get out there again, and wipe out as many as you can!
1489.objectives: Kill enough Huge Spiders, and then find Dionigi in Marathon.
1489.title: [Lv200]Spider Fighter III

1490.completion: By slaughtering all those Boas, you have avenged my stolen lunch. I thank you, and my lunch thanks you. Here’s your reward!
1490.details: I used to love Boas, but then one of them ate my lunch! Now I hate them all and want them dead! Nobody eats my lunch and gets away with it! Kill them now!
1490.objectives: Kill enough Boas, and then find Dionigi in Marathon.
1490.title: [Lv200]Boa-cide I

1491.completion: Every time a Boa dies, an Atheniann baby survives the night. Thanks to you, the children of Marathon are smiling a lot today. Thanks!
1491.details: I’m starting to feel bad about killing all these Boas, but there’s no turning back now! Drive them out of Marathon, and we’ll both be heroes. Well, you will.
1491.objectives: Kill enough Boas, and then find Dionigi in Marathon.
1491.title: [Lv200]Boa-cide II

1492.completion: I am very grateful, brave warrior. Because of you, the secret that I am part snake will be buried with all those Boas you killed. You have more than earned this reward.
1492.details: I just found out I’m part Boa. Apparently, my great-great-grandfather married a snake. Oh the shame! If this ever got out, I’d be ruined! Finish off these gossipy serpents before one of them blabs my family secret!
1492.objectives: Kill enough Boas, and then find Dionigi in Marathon.
1492.title: [Lv200]Boa-cide III

1493.completion: If these Vicious Wolves weren’t so vicious, then they wouldn’t have to die. But they are, so they do. Thanks for doing what needed to be done.
1493.details: The Vicious Wolves of Marathon aren’t so bad. They really just want to be loved, but go about it the wrong way. Too bad for them, because now they must die!
1493.objectives: Kill enough Vicious Wolves, and then find Dionigi in Marathon.
1493.title: [Lv200]Wolf Killer I

1494.completion: Knock-knock. Who’s there? Vicious Wolves. Vicious Wolves who? Vicious Wolves are dead, thanks to this Athenian warrior! Ha ha ha! Here’s your reward.
1494.details: The relatives of those Vicious Wolves you just slayed are here in Marathon, and their looking for revenge. Better get out there and face them before they catch you off guard.
1494.objectives: Kill enough Vicious Wolves, and then find Dionigi in Marathon.
1494.title: [Lv200]Wolf Killer II

1495.completion: With those Vicious Wolves now dead, I shall howl at the moon all by myself tonight. It will be magnificent! Stop by, if you’re around. Just be quiet during my performance!
1495.details: I was peacefully baying at the moon last night, when suddenly a pack of Vicious Wolves joined in. Don’t they know I howl alone? Kill them all so that I’m never interrupted again!
1495.objectives: Kill enough Vicious Wolves, and then find Dionigi in Marathon.
1495.title: [Lv200]Wolf Killer III

1496.completion: Wow, you really got rid of all those Huge Lions! I’m speechless, except for the words I’m saying now. This reward is for your brave service!
1496.details: My first pet was a Huge Lion. His name was Seymour, and we went everywhere together. But then he ran away. Now every time I see a Huge Lion, I think of Seymour and it makes me sad. Stop these painful memories from resurfacing by driving these beasts out of Marathon!
1496.objectives: Kill enough Huge Lions, and then find Gerrhus in Marathon.
1496.title: [Lv200]Dyin' Lions I

1497.completion: What do you get when you cross a mighty warrior with a bunch of Huge Lions? A bunch of dead Huge Lions! Hahaha! I crack myself up. Here’s your reward.
1497.details: Remember a long time ago when you agreed to drive away some Huge Lions for me? Wasn’t that fun? Want to do it again? Sure you do! Yay!
1497.objectives: Kill enough Huge Lions, and then find Gerrhus in Marathon.
1497.title: [Lv200]Dyin' Lions II

1498.completion: How did you kill all those Huge Lions? Bravery and skill? I don’t know what those things are, but I do know when to give a reward for a job well done!
1498.details: Huge Lions are considered the kings of the jungle. Well, Greece is the birthplace of democracy, and we have no patience for monarchical royalty. Death to the king! Death to all Huge Lions!
1498.objectives: Kill enough Huge Lions, and then find Gerrhus in Marathon.
1498.title: [Lv200]Dyin' Lions III

1499.completion: A lot of warriors have promised to kill those Bad Tempered deer, but either forgot or grew scared. Not you! You finished what you started. I like that! Here’s a reward.
1499.details: Have you ever seen a Bad Tempered Deer up close? They are mean! I hate mean things, because mean things beget mean feelings! Kill those dastardly deer before they plague our people's hearts!
1499.objectives: Kill enough Bad Tempered Deer, and then find Gerrhus in Marathon.
1499.title: [Lv200]Death Time for Deer I

1500.completion: I knew you would have no problem with those Bad Tempered Deer. They’re all talk... and fangs. And don’t forget the sharp hooves. Come to think of it, you’re lucky to be alive! Good job!
1500.details: Bad Tempered Deer aren’t born that way. As fawns, they’re just a little cranky. By adolescence, they grow grumpy and sullen. It’s only when they reach adulthood that they become truly bad tempered. Okay, lesson over. Time to kill them!
1500.objectives: Kill enough Bad Tempered Deer, and then find Gerrhus in Marathon.
1500.title: [Lv200]Death Time for Deer II

1501.completion: For bravery above and beyond the call of duty, and for killing those Bad Tempered Deer like a total badass, I present you with this nifty reward.
1501.details: All these Bad Tempered Deer are effecting the mood in Marathon. People are starting to argue over the littlest thing. Maybe if you kill those deer, everyone will mellow out. It’s worth a try!
1501.objectives: Kill enough Bad Tempered Deer, and then find Gerrhus in Marathon.
1501.title: [Lv200]Death Time for Deer III

1502.completion: Ding Dong! The Frogs are dead. Which old frogs? The Marathon Frogs! Ding Dong the Marathon Frogs are dead!
1502.details: Everybody knows that frogs are man’s best friend. Wait, I’m thinking about dogs. Frogs are nobody’s best friend. They’re just a nuisance and can only cause harm.
1502.objectives: Kill enough Frogs, and then find Gerrhus in Marathon.
1502.title: [Lv200]Die Like a Frog I

1503.completion: It pleases me beyond measure to know that all those Frogs are finally dead. Does this mean I have a problem? Maybe. In any case, here’s your reward!
1503.details: In Greece, there are 500 frogs for every person. We’re a minority! Help balance this ratio by sending a few of those amphibians to the next life!
1503.objectives: Kill enough Frogs, and then find Gerrhus in Marathon.
1503.title: [Lv200]Die Like a Frog II

1504.completion: Hey, why did you kill all those Frogs? Oh right, because I asked you to. My bad. Thanks for doing it! Ha ha!
1504.details: Do you know what Marathon needs? More frogs. NOT! One frog is one frog too many, so kill those warty, slimy, croaky, jumpy, icky beasts! Bleargh!
1504.objectives: Kill enough Frogs, and then find Gerrhus in Marathon.
1504.title: [Lv200]Die Like a Frog III

1505.completion: You make killing Little Crocodiles look so easy, I might even try it myself. On the other hand, I’m a lover not a fighter. Here’s your reward.
1505.details: Marathon is tired of being known as the land of the Little Crocodiles. But they can’t establish a new reputation until those oversized lizards are gone. Kill the crocs, and then reap the rewards.
1505.objectives: Kill enough Little Crocodiles, and then find Gerrhus in Marathon.
1505.title: [Lv200]Croc Killer I

1506.completion: Killing Little Crocodiles is your business, and business is good! Now relax, and enjoy this bountiful reward.
1506.details: You did a great job killing those Little Crocodiles earlier, but guess what? A new generation has hatched and they are meaner than their parents! Slay those cold-blooded reptiles before they take over Marathon permanently!
1506.objectives: Kill enough Little Crocodiles, and then find Gerrhus in Marathon.
1506.title: [Lv200]Croc Killer II

1507.completion: The long reign of terror by those Little Crocodiles is finally over! And for killing them, you’ve earned a little reward!
1507.details: The Little Crocodiles are back! I don’t know what providence protects them, but you can end it now. Kill these miniature monsters once and for all! Marathon is counting on you!
1507.objectives: Kill enough Little Crocodiles, and then find Gerrhus in Marathon.
1507.title: [Lv200]Croc Killer III

1508.completion: The evil witches of Parnitha are gone! Long live the brave warrior that killed them. And long live me for hiring the brave warrior!
1508.details: Parnitha has long been known for its wonderful cuisine, beautiful vistas, and evil Witches. One of these things is bad for tourism, and it’s not the food or scenery. Make Parnitha the paradise it was meant to be, and kill those Witches!
1508.title: [Lv50]The Witches of Parnitha

1509.completion: The coast of Megara used to be a haven for Death Mages, but not any more. You drove those gothic jerks out for good! For all you do, this reward’s for you!
1509.details: When people think of the Megara Coast, they immediately think of Death Mages. This is driving down home prices, something the people of Megara can’t afford. For real estate purposes, kill those Death Mages as soon as possible!
1509.objectives: Destroy the Death Mages of the Megara Coast.
1509.title: [Lv70]Megara's Death Mages

1510.completion: It’s a dark day for Dark Witches in Parnitha Port. You shined a light on their evil, and drove them back to the shadows of hell. Great work!
1510.details: There’s really no sanctuary for Dark Witches. Wherever they go, people want them gone and Parnitha Port is no exception. Destroy those persecuted women of magic once and for all.
1510.objectives: Bring death to the Dark Witches of Parnitha Port.
1510.title: [Lv90]Parnitha Port's Witches

1511.completion: Those Persian Scouts won’t be scouting much of anything anymore. What a bloodbath! Your glory on the battlefield knows no bounds! And now I give you this reward.
1511.details: When the Persian Scouts invaded Plataea, they soon turned that sleepy town into a den of scum and villainy. The people have pooled their resources and are looking to hire someone to put those scouts in an early grave!
1511.objectives: Eliminate the Persian Scouts that have invaded Plataea.
1511.title: [Lv110]Wanted: Persian Scout

1512.completion: The lovely ladies of Parnitha Port are happy to see those jezebel Persian Huntresses dead. They wish to express their thanks with this lavish reward.
1512.details: Persian Huntresses are gorgeous women who attract every man they meet. This explains why the ladies of Parnitha Port want them gone! Their jealousy has financed a handsome bounty for anyone who drives these huntresses out for good!
1512.objectives: Seek and destroy the Persian Huntresses of Parnitha Port.
1512.title: [Lv120]Thermopylae's Huntresses

1513.completion: I’m sure the satisfaction of killing that Dark Wizard was the only compensation you seek. Ha! Just kidding. You should see the look on your face! Okay, here’s your reward.
1513.details: The people of Parnitha are fed up with the Dark Wizard that lives there. Apparently, he’s a bad tipper and always smells of sulfur. They want him gone, so go hunt him down and take him out!
1513.objectives: Slay the Dark Wizard of Parnitha.
1513.title: [Lv50]Wanted: Dark Wizard

1514.completion: I saw you kill that Skeleton Warlock. It was amazing! He begged for his life, but you weren’t hearing any of it. I’d sure hate to be your enemy! Now take this well-earned reward.
1514.details: There lives a Skeleton Warlock, somewhere on the Megara Coast. He likes to dabble in witchcraft, and brag and bluster and boast. All of the people fear him, well if not all then certainly most. So kill this Skeleton Warlock, and release his imprisoned ghost!
1514.objectives: Destroy the Skeleton Warlock of the Megara Coast.
1514.title: [Lv70]Megara Coast's Warlocks

1515.completion: You killed the Centaur in what experts are already calling the fight of the year. Way to go! You have earned a warrior’s reward.
1515.details: For years, poets wrote about the nasty Centaur of Parnitha Port. But now those poets are dead, and yet the Centaur continues to live. That hardly seems fair, so kill this man-beast and reunite him with the poets he adored.
1515.objectives: Slay the Centaur of Parnitha Port.
1515.title: [Lv90]Wanted: Centaur

1516.completion: You reduced that Wind Elf to nothing but a mere puff of smoke! Plataea will always remember you as their greatest hero. Take this reward.
1516.details: A storm hit Plataea, and with it blew in a most notorious Wind Elf. He hides in the day and hunts the town at night. Like all Wind Elves, he should be removed from the human realm, and you’re the only one to do it!
1516.objectives: Kill the Wind Elf of Plataea.
1516.title: [Lv110]The Wind Elf of Plataea

1517.completion: The Persian Archmage is dead! That lousy punk owed me money. I probably should have collected before you killed him. Oh well, my loss. Here’s your reward.
1517.details: The Persian Archmage of Thermopylae is public enemy number one! He’s a dangerous scoundrel with no regard for our noble Grecian ways. Hunt down and kill this magic user like the dog he is!
1517.objectives: Eliminate the Persian Archmage of Thermopylae.
1517.title: [Lv120]Thermopylae's Archmages

1518.details: Welcome to Athens, young friend. You've come at the right time. Athens needs your help! Our soldiers have been struggling to maintain the peace here, but everyday there's some new menace that must be dealt with. Do your duty and help defend Athens! Go talk with Acacia for more information on what you can do to help. He is just behind me with an exclamation mark over head.
1518.title: [Lv1]New to Athens

1519.completion: Wow, what a strong new soldier!
1519.details: Aha, we've finally got a true hero willing to step up. The village leader will certainly be very glad to see you. Go see him as soon as possible to see what plan Athena has in store for us,. Press the Q key to unfold the quest pane and then click the name of the village leader, Athena will then guide you towards him automatically.
1519.objectives: Unfold the quest pane and use the autotrack function to automatically move towards [Village Leader]Admes.
1519.title: [Lv2]Meet the Leader

1520.completion: Good job! This piece of gear is now yours.
1520.details: Glad to know you are ready to help Athens! Your first mission is eliminate the Crispy Wood Man that are occupying the forest in the north. Nobody knows where they came from, but we must drive them away. Go north and kill every one you see.
1520.objectives: Kill 10 Crispy Wood Man and then go talk with [Village Leader]Admes.
1520.title: [Lv3]Crispy Wood Man Menace

1521.completion: Well done! You certainly are skilled with a weapon.
1521.details: You've got a powerful weapon. Why not try using it? The Little Deer nearby have been a thorn in our side for far too long. Why not use your new weapon to teach them a lesson? When you are done, pay Acacia a visit. I've heard he has received some new information.
1521.objectives: Kill 12 Little Deer and then go talk with Acacia.
1521.title: [Lv4]Polishing a New Blade

1522.completion: Alright, get ready to learn a new spell.
1522.details: I've recently received a secret report about deer in the forest acting strangely, including attacks on farmers. I want you to help investigate what is going on. Before you do this, first pay [Skill]Thisbe a visit to upgrade your skills.
1522.title: [Lv5]Before an Investigation

1523.completion: Hey, how did you know what I wanted you to do?
1523.details: Did You come here to investigate the Little Bees? Listen to me, kill any Little Bees you see, immediately. I believe Acacia will be very happy with you if you can do this.
1523.objectives: Kill 12 Little Bees and then talk to Acacia.
1523.title: [Lv6]Eliminate the Little Bees

1524.details: I think I've found some clues into the plot behind what's happening. The Little Deer were not driven crazy without reason. Instead, they're very likely under the control of the Wasps. Please go deep into the forest to investigate what's going on there and kill any Wasp you see. When you are done, report to [Village Leader]Admes.
1524.objectives: Kill 15 Wasps and then report to [Village Leader]Admes.
1524.title: [Lv7]Plotting Behind the Scenes

1525.completion: Huh, the village leader sent somebody to look for me.
1525.details: As expected, some Persians are making trouble. The Persians have been planning an invasion for a long time, but I still never expected them to send a force so deep into our territory. We must find the leader of this group before they become an even bigger threat. Go talk with the villagers nearby and see if you can find any clues. Start with [Warehouse]Belen, she often brings goods through the forest, so she may know something.
1525.title: [Lv8]Capture the Ringleader

1526.completion: You brought Honeycombs too? That’s more than I expected!
1526.details: They swarmed through the air, spreading panic and chaos everywhere. I was stung and fled back to the village in fear. These aren’t ordinary insects—they’re aggressive Little Bees stirred up by something. If you’re brave enough, head out there and collect some Honeycombs while you deal with them.
1526.objectives: Kill 15 Little Bees and collect 5 Honeycombs, then report to [Village Leader]Admes.
1526.title: [Lv9]Buzzing Blades

1527.completion: So it's true... even the snakes have been corrupted.
1527.details: As far as I know, there is a form of dark magic which allows the caster to influence even the smallest of creatures. Lately, an unusual number of aggressive Little Snakes have slithered out from the deeper parts of the forest. If you think it's just superstition, go see for yourself and deal with them.
1527.objectives: Kill 15 Little Snakes and then report to [Village Leader]Admes.
1527.title: [Lv10]Slithering Threat

1528.completion: Well done. With Wilemet gone and these fangs in hand, we may finally understand what corrupted them.
1528.details: The deeper we go into the forest, the more aggressive the snakes become. Wilemet the Controller is rumored to be the cause, spreading corruption through unknown means. We need to act fast. Eliminate him and collect Snake Fangs from the nearby serpents for analysis — perhaps they’ll reveal how he's manipulating them.
