1528.objectives: Kill Wilemet the Controller and collect 8 Snake Fangs, then report to [Village Leader]Admes.
1528.title: [Lv11]Fangs in the Shadows

1529.completion: Now all Athenians know there is a new hero in their midst. It is you, the hero who discovered the Persians' plot and kept our beautiful city safe. This badge is your reward.
1529.details: What an exciting moment! You deserve everybody's worship, as well as some rewards! Head over to the main city and pay [Sage]Gideon a visit. He will tell you about real glory!
1529.title: [Lv12]Athenian Savior

1530.completion: Get ready right now. No more gossiping.
1530.details: There is trouble brewing in the suburbs. Though we've sent quite a few people out to deal with it, we need more help. Please do us a favor and head out to the suburbs to talk with Inspector Galen and find out more about the current situation.
1530.objectives: Head to the suburb to pay a visit to Inspector Galen.
1530.title: [Lv13]Trouble in the Suburbs

1531.details: There have been a lot of reports of snake sightings in the eastern farmland. They rush in a devour everything in sight. There's even a report of them stealing fish from a fishermen. Do us all a favor and drive these hateful snakes away.
1531.objectives: Kill 20 Sea Snakes and then report to Inspector Galen.
1531.title: [Lv14]Annoying Sea Snakes

1532.details: Some obstinate Persian spies have made their way to the suburbs with the intent to continue their plan of sabotage and terror. It seems you didn't get all of 'em when you eliminated all the Persians in the main city of Sparta. Now you must finish the job. Eliminate the remaining Persians.
1532.objectives: Kill 20 Persian Infiltrators and then report to Inspector Galen.
1532.title: [Lv15]The Persians' Struggle

1533.completion: Great, we've recaptured the woodlands and our farmland.
1533.details: Some harpies have been staging raids in the east woodlands and farmlands. Please drive them away.
1533.objectives: Kill 15 Plumed Harpies and 15 Frenzied Harpies, and then report to Inspector Galen.
1533.title: [Lv16]Recapturing the Woodlands

1534.completion: Was Galen the one who asked you to come here?
1534.details: Don't be too proud of recapturing the woodlands. Many farmlands in the suburbs are also in danger. Go west and ask Farmer Yannis if he needs some help.
1534.title: [Lv17]Farmer Yannis

1535.details: Snake Queen Johnna has been up to no good in the northeastern mountains for a long time now. Rumor has it she practices dark magic up there, but no one knows for sure. Nobody has ever been able to capture her either, despite many attempts and a large bounty on her head from the Athenian capital. Maybe you should give it a try, you seem to be able to accomplish things others cannot on a regular basis.
1535.objectives: Defeat Snake Queen Johnna and then claim rewards from the board.
1535.title: [Lv20]Wanted: Snake Queen Johnna

1536.details: I think Lion Lord Wilyeen must be lurking somewhere in the northwestern woodlands. He is definitely a great threat to travelers in the area. Whoever kills him will be rewarded handsomely.
1536.objectives: Defeat Lion Lord Wilyeen and then claim rewards from the board.
1536.title: [Lv20]Wanted: Lion Lord Wilyeen

1537.completion: Hmm, the situation is changing quickly. Perhaps they will be useful after all.
1537.details: I don't know where the strange creatures in my farmland come from. Some of them look like flowers and some have the heads of oxen and the bodies of men. I am scared and unsure about whats going on. Please go see whats wrong and bring me back some clues.
1537.objectives: Kill 1 Flower Pixie and 1 Minotaur and then report to Farmer Yannis.
1537.title: [Lv18]Hidden Troubles

1538.completion: Right click on the egg to begin hatching the pet. Warriors and Champions should strongly consider taking a Minotaur as a pet, while Mages and Priests should take a Flower Pixie.
1538.details: Though the creatures look very strange, you can easily tame them and then force them to serve as your pet if you manage to capture them using a certain tool. Take a tool and attempt to capture some.
1538.objectives: Capture 1 Flower Pixie and 1 Minotaur and then report to Farmer Yannis.
1538.title: [Lv19]Tame Them!

1539.details: Thanks for helping me, but would you mind also helping my buddy, Kiron? If you can, please also get rid of any scorpions you see along the way.
1539.objectives: Kill 20 Great Mane Plains Lions and 20 Silver Mane Plains Lions, and then go talk with Farmer Kiron.
1539.title: [Lv20]A Gift for Kiron

1540.completion: Well done! I am less worried, but I still need a favor.
1540.details: My friend hasn't forgotten about me! Getting me someone so capable to help is very good. The snakes nearby keep trying to eat me! Please get rid of them before I wind up as dinner.
1540.objectives: Kill 30 Demonic Black Snakes and then go talk to Farmer Kiron.
1540.title: [Lv20]Too Much Trouble

1541.completion: Cool, now I can go home.
1541.details: Why am I here? It's all the fault of those annoying turtles. They've taken over my hut and took my fishing pole. Would you please drive them back to the sea?
1541.objectives: Kill 25 Suburban Sea Turtles and 25 Sleepy Saltwater Turtles, and then report to Fisher Hamon.
1541.title: [Lv20]The Turtles

1542.completion: Great, that's just what I've been looking for.
1542.details: Are you attempting to eliminate those terrifying turtles nearby? If you really want to do it right, would you please bring me some turtle shells? It's said their eggs have some peculiar uses, like preserving heat.
1542.objectives: Get 10 Turtle Shells for [Skill]Jenna. Press the M key to unfold the map and then click the specified words to move towards the quest area(116, 145) automatically.
1542.title: [Lv21]I Want Turtle Shells

1543.completion: Many thanks! This gem is for you.
1543.details: I do appreciate the favor, but could you please help eliminate the Farm Wasps in my farmland?
1543.objectives: Kill 30 Farm Wasps and then report to Farmer Kiron.
1543.title: [Lv22]Eliminate the Farm Wasps

1544.completion: Many thanks! This gem is for you.
1544.details: I am worried about my buddy, Kiron. There are too many Woodland Drones occupying his farmland. They destroy crops. Please help get rid of them.
1544.objectives: Kill 30 Woodland Drones and then report to Fisher Hamon.
1544.title: [Lv23]Brown Dragons

1545.details: You've mastered a rich variety of skills for coping with difficult situations. In the western part of the suburbs, there are a lot of young dragons which have been making trouble. Please kill all of them.
1545.objectives: Kill 30 Young Firemane Dragons, 30 Young Flamescale Dragons and 30 Young Jade Dragons, and then report to Farmer Kiron.
1545.title: [Lv24]Young Dragons

1546.completion: You are far stronger than I'd imagined.
1546.details: I am not sure whether the young dragons have something to do with Red Dragon Puluo, but I know their leader is Young Armored Dragon, who is very tough. If you wish to beat him, you'd better get somebody to help you.
1546.objectives: Kill [Elite]Young Armored Dragon and then talk to Farmer Kiron.
1546.title: [Lv25]Young Armored Dragon

1547.completion: Many thanks. We will never forget you.
1547.details: The real source of all the trouble is Kelly the Venom Queen. She has been occupying the suburbs for a long time and almost all the evil creatures in the suburb are under his control. Unless he is slain, the suburbs will never be at peace. Get somebody to help you before you fight her and watch out for her tough guards.
1547.objectives: Kill Kelly the Venom Queen and then deliver the good news to Farmer Kiron.
1547.title: [Lv26]The Venom Queen Must Die!

1548.details: Report the situation here to Iakovou in Marathon and ask them to be on high alert.
1548.objectives: Report the situation here to Iakovou in Marathon.
1548.title: [Lv27]Marathon

1549.completion: Thanks, but could you do me another favor?
1549.details: Have you encountered any Boas along the way? For some time now, these large snakes have been threatening travelers in the area. With our focus on the Spartans in the north, the Boas have taken advantage to spread fear. It’s time we clear them out to make the path safe again.
1549.objectives: Kill 35 Boas and then report to Iakovou.
1549.title: [Lv28]Clear the Way

1550.completion: Good job. Now report to the official nearby.
1550.details: What’s going on? Why have the wolves become so aggressive lately? The Vicious Wolves have been terrorizing the outskirts and attacking travelers. We need you to eliminate them before more harm is done.
1550.objectives: Kill 35 Vicious Wolves and then report to Iakovou.
1550.title: [Lv29]Vicious Wolf Threat

1551.completion: Are you coming to help us?
1551.details: Marathon is right in the middle of an intense battle and in dire need of help from strong warriors like you. Dionigi will be very pleased to see your coming to help us.
1551.objectives: Head to Marathon and pay Dionigi a visit.
1551.title: [Lv30]Reinforcement

1552.details: I know Iakovou asked you to eliminate the bandits along the way, but I don't think you can clear them all unless their leader is dealt with. Fortunately, their leader, Robber Lolo, has been spotted in a camp to the south. Are you ready to pay him a visit?
1552.objectives: Kill 40 Robber Lolos and then report to Dionigi.
1552.title: [Lv31]Taking Down Robber Lolo

1553.completion: With Alwa defeated and the cache notes in hand, this operation is finally exposed.
1553.details: [Elite]Thief Lord Alwa has been spotted managing the smuggling routes personally. If we can intercept his operation and recover enough of the smuggled cache notes, we might finally trace their full supply network. Eliminate him and retrieve those documents before he vanishes again.
1553.objectives: Kill [Elite]Thief Lord Alwa and collect 10 Smuggled Cache Notes, then report to Barca.
1553.title: [Lv31]Disrupting the Supply Line

1554.completion: You are everything they said you would be!
1554.details: Not only must the threats inside the camp be dealt with, but the Deer roaming the outskirts are becoming a serious hazard. Their venomous stings endanger both soldiers and supply lines. Head out and eliminate them before they cause further harm!
1554.objectives: Kill 40 Bad Tempered Deer and then report to Koronos.
1554.title: [Lv31]Huge Scorpions

1555.completion: Wow, you are a really great fighter!
1555.details: Have you ever faced a beast that roars like thunder and strikes like a god? If not, I suggest you go see the Huge Lions nearby. If you could get rid of them you'd certainly ease a lot of people's minds around here.
1555.objectives: Kill 40 Huge Lions and then report to Crophi.
1555.title: [Lv31]Lion Attack!

1556.details: The Crocodiles to the west have been acting strange lately, they also seem to have grown in size. Not only that but they are acting much more aggressive, attacking anyone who gets near. Please do something about them?
1556.objectives: Kill 40 Crocodiles and then report to Spyridon.
1556.title: [Lv31]Crocodile Trouble

1557.completion: Well done. These antlers prove your strength and dedication. This mount is now yours.
1557.details: Greetings! Do you wish to become a true knight? If this is your goal, the first thing you must have is a proper mount. You may buy one from me or earn one simply by helping me eliminate the Angry Deer and collecting their antlers.
1557.objectives: Kill 100 Angry Deer and bring back 10 Deer Antlers to [Props]Thoas.
1557.title: [Lv40]Knighthood 101 I

1558.details: Once you've got a proper mount, you are still not qualified to call yourself a 'knight' because you can't ride it yet. Learning to ride a mount can be difficult, but if you can do something for me, I'll teach you the riding skill. Go eliminate the Frogs and you'll be well on your way to becoming a true knight.
1558.objectives: Kill 100 Frogs and then claim your reward from [Props]Thoas.
1558.title: [Lv40]Knighthood 101 II

1559.details: You've done some great things, but you still need to do more in the fight against the Spartans. A lot of Lions have been spotted on the plains to the north and there are reports of heavy fighting between them and the Athenian Cadians. I want you to head over there to reinforce the soldiers there. Remember to bring me back a Lion Fang as proof of your deeds.
1559.objectives: Eliminate the Lions and bring a Lion Fang to Barca as proof. Press the M key to unfold the map and click the specified words to move towards the quest area (0, 0) automatically.
1559.title: [Lv32]Spartan Cadians

1560.details: Did you see Spartan Captain Adron when you fought against the Spartan Cadians? He is their leader. Just kill him, and they'll stop fighting. What are you waiting for? Go take care of him and let's end this!
1560.objectives: Kill Spartan Captain Adron and then report to Barca.
1560.title: [Lv33]Fight for Athens!

1561.completion: These hooves are coated in a dark residue... We'll send them to the sages immediately. Excellent work.
1561.details: Reports from the outskirts of Marathon tell of Angry Deer attacking travelers and livestock. Their behavior is unnatural—filled with rage and completely unprovoked. We suspect something darker is stirring in the woods. Cull their numbers and bring back some of their hooves for study.
1561.objectives: Kill 60 Angry Deer and collect 10 Corrupted Hooves, then report to Braca.
1561.title: [Lv34]Rampage of the Angry Deer

1562.completion: These teeth look razor-sharp. Good work — this should keep the marshes safer, for now.
1562.details: Crocodiles have been emerging from the marshes near Marathon, attacking villagers and devouring livestock. Their aggression is unusual and their presence alarming. We need to cull their numbers and bring back proof of the hunt.
1562.objectives: Kill 60 Crocodiles and collect 10 Crocodile Teeth, then report to Barca.
1562.title: [Lv35]Marshland Menace

1563.completion: These fangs hold a strange energy... I know what's wrong.
1563.details: You've dealt with magical weapons before, but this is something more primal. Packs of Vicious Wolves have been attacking travelers in the Northwest. We need you to put them down and bring back something to help us study their aggression.
1563.objectives: Kill 60 Vicious Wolves and collect 10 Wolf Fangs, then report to Barca.
1563.title: [Lv36]Fangs of the Vicious

1564.completion: Great, the hidden threat in Marathon has finally been taken care of.
1564.details: I am certain that these evil creatures are in thrall to Skeletal Lord Darnas. Darnas was once one of the most decorated and honorable Athenian warriors, but since he was revived by that evil necromancer during a fierce battle, he has been hostile and overly aggressive, even to close friends. He is now a threat and must be eliminated, along with his guards.
1564.objectives: Kill Skeletal Lord Darnas as well as 60 Huge Lion, and then report to Barca.
1564.title: [Lv37]Skeletal Lord Darnas

1565.completion: Welcome to Parnitha. This is the battlefront in our struggle against those Spartan weaklings.
1565.details: Thanks to you, the battle for Marathon has been won and we con finally focus on the fierce fighting still going on in Parnitha. Go to Parnitha and meet with General Antilochos. He will be very glad to see you.
1565.objectives: Head to Parnitha and pay a visit to Bias.
1565.title: [Lv38]Battle in Nemea

1566.details: Kill 10 Spartan Frontline Soldiers on the battlefront, and I will reward you.
1566.title: [Lv70]Spartan Frontline Soldiers

1567.details: Some Spartan Frontline Patrols are carrying some especially good wine. They won't appreciate it as much as we will. Kill them and take the wine.
1567.objectives: Loot wine from the Spartan Frontline Patrols.
1567.title: [Lv70]Enemy Wine is Delicious

1568.details: Wow, you must be very brave since you're here on the battlefront. But are you brave enough to fight against any hostile adventurer that crosses your path? We'll see, go defeat a hostile Level 70+ player and you will be rewarded.
1568.objectives: Defeat a player Level 70 or higher.
1568.title: [Lv70]Fight to the Death 1

1569.details: Wow, you must be very brave since you're here on the battlefront. But are you brave enough to fight against any hostile adventurer that crosses your path? We'll see, go defeat a hostile Level 75+ player and you will be rewarded.
1569.objectives: Defeat a player Level 75 or higher.
1569.title: [Lv70]Fight to the Death 2

1570.details: Wow, you must be very brave since you're here on the battlefront. But are you brave enough to fight against any hostile adventurer that crosses your path? We'll see, go defeat a hostile Level 80+ player and you will be rewarded.
1570.objectives: Defeat a player Level 80 or higher.
1570.title: [Lv70]Fight to the Death 3

1571.details: This is the most critical time of the battle. We must strike now and kill their General and secure victory!
1571.title: [Lv70]Checkmate

1572.completion: Great, now I can have a nice Spring Festival. Here is a Spring Festival Firecracker for you, but I need more goods. Can you get me more?
1572.details: In order to enjoy a peaceful Spring Festival, we must defeat the Lunar Beast. This is not too difficult, but it is not without dangers. To get started we must first lure it out. People say the best way to lure this monster out from the shadows is with Spring Festival Firecrackers. This is where you come in. I need some special goods for Spring Festival, and if you bring them to me I will reward you with Spring Festival Firecrackers. You can recapture my special goods for the Spring Festival from the Spring Yetis in the suburbs or get some from others.
1572.objectives: Recapture Spring Festival Greetings Cards, Preserved Hams and Rice Cakes from the Spring Yetis in the suburbs for the Spring Merrymaker in the main city.
1572.title: [Lv20]Festival Firecracker

1573.details: The flames of war have spread beyond the boundaries of Athens and Sparta. Surely in this chaotic world there must be someone we can trust, a reliable ally. Lately, I've been tied up by ... pressing matters. Could I entrust you with the noble task of helping someone in Thebes? You may take a shortcut through the transporter or via Plataea.
1573.title: [Lv130]A New Ally

1574.completion: You've got skill, I'll give you that. But don't get too proud. This is only the beginning.
1574.details: Your heroic deeds have spread across all of Greece. Indeed, I feel honored meeting you in person. Formalities aside, we do have some problems that may need urgent attention. Those Mycenaean scum have recently set up an encampment and have been raiding us aggressively. If you would do us a favor by destroying them, perhaps it would make this alliance more justifiable.
1574.objectives: Eliminate 200 Mycenaean Spearmen, then return to Kreon.
1574.title: [Lv130]Thebes' Worry

1575.completion: What can I do for you, friend?
1575.details: What you've said has me worried. Why would the Mycenaeans and Spartans join forces? If this is true, then we have a larger problem in our hands. Consult Oedipus. He is the wisest man I know and may be able to shed some light on this matter.
1575.title: [Lv130]Mycenae and Sparta

1576.completion: Finally, the time has come to settle this man-to-man! Let's prepare for battle!
1576.details: Just as Kreon suspected, they have joined forces and have begun eyeing our lands! We must cut them off quickly before their troops have a chance to gather for an attack. Head out and defeat the Mycenaean Maulers. We shall wage war against the Mycenaeans!
1576.objectives: Eliminate 200 Mycenaean Maulers, then return to Oedipus.
1576.title: [Lv130]Face Off!

1577.completion: It's great running into a fellow homelander in this area!
1577.details: The King of Athens, Theseus, has sent countless messengers before you. His son, Hippolytus, arrived here a few days ago. As friends of Athens, we have provided him the greatest of comforts. If you're free, drop by his quarters. I'm sure you'll have a dozen things to talk about.
1577.title: [Lv130]Another Athenian

1578.completion: They seem reliable enough. Well then, let's work on the terms of the alliance.
1578.details: As you know, the Thebans are considering forging an alliance, but some of them still have doubts about our sincerity. I would like you to eliminate the Mycenaean Swordsmen and take out their leader. I'm sure the Thebans will have no more doubts once we've proven our resolve.
1578.objectives: Eliminate Mycenaean Swordsmen and the Mycenaean Vanguard, then return to Hippolytus.
1578.title: [Lv130]Proof of Sincerity

1579.completion: You're back! Ha! No lesser task could slow you down, could it? I've prepared this title to celebrate your success. Wear it proudly and let all of Thebes know of our friendship.
1579.details: Thanks to your efforts in solving the Thebans' problems, they have agreed to the alliance. Please convey this good news to my father, Theseus. The alliance shall oppose the Spartans and Mycenaeans!
1579.objectives: Return to Athens and inform Theseus of the good news.
1579.title: [Lv130]Forging an Alliance

1580.completion: We're glad to see you here! Come, we have much to do!
1580.details: Now that the Thebans are our friends, we shall be victorious in this war. They have requested aid on the front lines and I've decided to send my strongest warrior to assist them: you! Go now and make us proud!
1580.title: [Lv130]The Return to Thebes

1581.completion: Are you here to assist me?
1581.details: I need your help, Hero. My daughter, Ismene, has discovered something peculiar close by. Could I trouble you to take a look?
1581.title: [Lv131]Oedipus' Request

1582.completion: Not bad! I couldn't have done better myself!
1582.details: It's not a big deal, really. I've discovered a large herd of Ravenous Deer. These deer have caused some pretty serious damage to the villages. Shall we do something nasty to them in return?
1582.objectives: Eliminate 200 Ravenous Deer, then return to Ismene.
1582.title: [Lv131]Ravenous Deer

1583.details: I've been studying the ecological change of the surroundings. I am sure the recent change is not incidental. Go tell our findings to Kreon.
1583.title: [Lv131]Report to Kreon

1584.completion: Masterfully done! I am proud of you!
1584.details: Is that so? That more or less confirms my hunch. To be honest, the Centaur Bandits raided us half a month ago and it caused some serious damage. Let's rid ourselves of their malice!
1584.objectives: Eliminate 200 Centaur Bandits, then return to Kreon.
1584.title: [Lv131]Hidden Dangers

1585.completion: Do you have some good news? Why don't you tell me about it?
1585.details: I think we are doing pretty well. Do me a favor and go see Ismene. Tell her the good news.
1585.objectives: Bring this good news to Ismene.
1585.title: [Lv131]Some Good News

1586.completion: Well done! Stick around a bit. I might have another task for you to handle.
1586.details: In the bleakness of this war, this is certainly welcome news. If only our worries were all so easily solved. If this is so, then the Amazon Raiders must also die, for they have done the same deeds as the Amazon Raiders. Could I task you with this?
1586.objectives: Eliminate 200 Amazon Raiders, then return to Ismene.
1586.title: [Lv131]Counterattack!

1587.completion: Looks like you still have much to learn.
1587.details: Have you seen the Vagrant White Bulls? I suspect they have started to exhibit signs of mutation. If so, then it is a truly dreadful development. We must guard against all hidden enemies. I’ll need you to investigate this matter.
1587.objectives: Eliminate 200 Vagrant White Bulls, then return to Tiresias.
1587.title: [Lv132]Vagrant White Bulls

1588.completion: We are surrounded by enemies, both near and far. There is much at stake.
1588.details: Polynices has just returned from Mycenae. Talk to him and let me know what you learn.
1588.objectives: Learn more about the situation from Polynices.
1588.title: [Lv132]More Information

1589.completion: Looks like you're not just brute and muscle; you have good stamina too!
1589.details: In Thebes, there are 2 dangerous creatures on a rampage: the Centaur Bandits and the Amazon Raiders. So far they have targeted and killed countless humans and will stop at nothing until we are completely wiped out! Will you lend us your help?
1589.objectives: Eliminate 100 Centaur Bandits and Amazon Raiders in Thebes, then return to Polynices.
1589.title: [Lv132]Enemy of Distant Shores

1590.completion: You'd a long day. Take a rest for now. Our other tasks can wait.
1590.details: At ease. I'm sure you've had a long day. Report to Tiresias, then take a well deserved break. The rest can wait.
1590.title: [Lv132]A Rest Between Tasks

1591.details: So we meet again, friend. The Vagrant Brown Bulls are driving us mad. Once again, we must rely on your blade to mete out judgement. Please help me with this task.
1591.objectives: Eliminate 200 Vagrant Brown Bulls, then return to Tiresias.
1591.title: [Lv133]Vagrant Brown Bulls

1592.completion: Perfect timing! I need you to do me a small favor.
1592.details: It's ... complicated. Our recent troubles are wearing us down. We have no idea what the Mycenaeans are planning! What's with the strange animals? Some circus show?! Please excuse my outburst. If you need more details, approach Polynices.
1592.objectives: Learn more about the situation from Polynices.
1592.title: [Lv133]Mycenae's Scheme

1593.completion: Among all my friends, you may not be the best, but you are certainly the strongest!
1593.details: Scouts have reported a sudden increase in the population of strange animals in the vicinity. Do us and your countrymen a favor and eliminate them before they overrun us all!
1593.objectives: Eliminate 100 Vagrant White Bulls and Vagrant Brown Bulls in Thebes, then report to Polynices.
1593.title: [Lv133]The Expedition

1594.completion: You're alive! Thank the gods, you're alive!
1594.details: You're alive! I knew you would pull through! Talk to Tiresias. I'm sure he has prepared something special for you.
1594.title: [Lv133]Victory!

1595.completion: Congratulations, my friend. I hope to see you again sometime soon.
1595.details: Nothing can express the gratitude and admiration I have for you, but I must try. Here, this is for you. Take it!
1595.title: [Lv133]Rewards

1596.completion: What in blazes? Who called you here?!
1596.details: I may not be on good terms with Jocasta, but rest assured it will not affect our effort to serve Thebes. The battle has taken its toll on the soldiers. There seems to be foul magic, sorcery or the like at work here. I think Jocasta knows what we are dealing with. Find her and follow her instructions. She will tell you what to do next.
1596.title: [Lv134]The Undead?

1597.details: Eurydice sent you here? She must have great confidence in your abilities. Yes, there is strange magic at work here. For something to reanimate itself and stay frenzied is unheard of. The best plan I can think of is to reduce their numbers. At least they will pose less of a threat to citizens.
1597.objectives: Eliminate 200 Undead Raiders, then return to Jocasta.
1597.title: [Lv134]Resting the Undead

1598.completion: How did you know about me?
1598.details: This is prepostrous! There is no end to this killing! They feel no pain and won't stay down. This is not the solution to our problem. We need divine intervention. Seek Rhadamanthus. He is the son of Zeus and Europa. He might have a solution!
1598.title: [Lv134]A Search for a Solution

1599.completion: You've got them? Great! Let's continue the research.
1599.details: Oh, those! Are you having trouble with them? You are just in time. I have been researching an effective way to shut them down, but I'm out of samples. Perhaps you could get me some?
1599.title: [Lv134]Undead Creature Swatch

1600.details: Perfect! These samples might just be the solution we have been seeking. I'll need some time to get things in order. Return to Jocasta and tell her I will be there shortly.
1600.title: [Lv134]Hope for Good News

1601.completion: Good. Now we can await further news with fewer woes.
1601.details: I have overestimated Rhadamanthus' abilities. I thought he would know the answer right away. You have to take action while he finishes working everything out. There seems to have been an increase in the Undead Halberdiers attacks.
1601.objectives: Kill 200 Undead Halberdiers and report back to Jocasta.
1601.title: [Lv134]Defend and Destroy

1602.details: After much research, I realized that the recent undead plague may have some connection to horrible Immortal Nolsan. Only he has powers dark enough to create such a catastrophe! Make haste and convey my findings to Jocasta.
1602.title: [Lv135]The Findings

1603.details: This is shocking news indeed. Immortal Nolsan is a being with the most horrific powers known to mankind! I want nothing to do with this terror. I suggest you ask Eurydice for some assistance.
1603.title: [Lv135]Terrible Tidings

1604.details: We must make haste and eliminate this abominable undead mage. If he's not destroyed, the undead creatures will soon overrun our world! The Undead Dark Mages are his elite army; we should start with them. Kill them and his strength will be greatly diminished.
1604.objectives: Kill 200 Undead Dark Mages and report back to Eurydice.
1604.title: [Lv135]Weakening

1605.details: Gather your comrades and prove your valor against Immortal Nolsan. Should you die in battle, I will erect a memorial stone for you.
1605.title: [Lv135]The Battle

1606.completion: You deserve this, though I do feel somewhat saddened.
1606.details: Please deliver news of this victory to Rhadamanthus. The legend of the undead has finally ended!
1606.title: [Lv135]The Fall of the Undead

1607.completion: I knew you could do it.
1607.details: This is unfortunate news indeed. The undead are still wreaking havoc. I have received word that faraway Thebes is still very much plagued by them. Most of them are powerful mages. If you are confident of your ability to face these undead, please lend Thebes a hand.
1607.objectives: Wipe out the undead monsters in Thebes.
1607.title: [Lv136]It's Not Over Yet!

1608.details: Your recent massacre of the undead has alerted their elusive leader. I haven't been able to discern more, though. You will need to seek the advice of Polynices.
1608.title: [Lv136]More Terror Awaits

1609.details: Yes, it's him all right! Soul Harvester Maxxi! He's the mastermind behind everything. He may be in faraway Mycenae, but I can feel his presence!
1609.title: [Lv136]The Elusive Mastermind

1610.details: This ought to be the final battle against the undead. Go to Thebes and kill Immortal Nolsan. End this once and for all!
1610.title: [Lv136]Once and for All

1611.completion: Wonderful tidings indeed! I'm heartened to see such courage and valor. You will be handsomely rewarded!
1611.details: You have achieved the incredible. King Kreon should know about this!
1611.objectives: Speak to King Kreon of Thebes.
1611.title: [Lv136]All's Well that Ends Well

1612.details: The problem we face this time should be much easier compared to what you have already helped us with. Speak to Oedipus to find out more.
1612.title: [Lv137]An Easier Problem

1613.completion: How can I help you, brave one?
1613.details: She's wrong. The monsters plaguing us this time are no small matter. Rhadamanthus should know more about this. It would be best if you spoke to him.
1613.title: [Lv137]Strange Monsters I

1614.details: Oedipus is right. These strange creatures have been popping up in great numbers and they seem to be advancing toward us. We should quell their aggression before they attack us.
1614.objectives: Kill 200 Revived Khazra and report back to Rhadamanthus.
1614.title: [Lv137]Strange Monsters II

1615.details: It's not over yet. More strange monsters have been sighted in Thebes. I'm afraid we need your help again.
1615.objectives: Kill 200 Revived Khazra and report back to Rhadamanthus.
1615.title: [Lv137]Strange Monsters III

1616.completion: I'm truly grateful for your help.
1616.details: We've quelled the threat from those strange creatures, at least for now. You should convey the good news to Oedipus.
1616.title: [Lv137]Peace for Now

1617.details: I encountered some dreadful creatures during my hunting trip yesterday. It's an entire group of the nefarious Lurking Mountain Scorpions! Surely you aren't just going to stand by and watch get eaten?
1617.title: [Lv138]Wild Beasts

1618.completion: Ha! They will be really grateful for my help. Oh, um, your help, I mean.
1618.details: Have you heard? We're not the only ones in trouble. Thebes has been harassed by hordes of Lurking Mountain Scorpions lately. We may not be on the best of terms with them, but I guess humans should help one another against these pesky monsters, right?
1618.objectives: Head to Thebes and kill 200 Lurking Mountain Scorpions.
1618.title: [Lv138]Ready to Help!

1619.details: Honestly, though I keep sending you on these quests, I don't really dare to trifle with the elite monsters. Why don't you ask Oedipus and see if he has the guts to initiate such a request?
1619.title: [Lv138]The Elite Monster

1620.completion: I feel sorry that things had to turn out this way, but still, thank you.
1620.details: I feel saddened by the words I must speak. The strongest of them all is Golden Scorpion Sukur. I have in fact defeated it before, but I let it go when it assured me it would stop harming humans. It broke its promise and has continued to menace the world. Sigh. Yes, you should kill it and rectify my mistake.
1620.title: [Lv138]The Broken Promise

1621.completion: Did he ask you to find me again?
1621.details: I knew this peace would not last long. The people of Mycenae have begun their attacks again. This time they have sent out their strongest mages. I will need your aid. Oedipus will consult with you further on a strategy. Me? Well, as the leader you should know I...
1621.title: [Lv139]War with Mycenae

1622.completion: I've always had great trust in your abilities.
1622.details: They have sent out their Mycenaean Female Mages. They may not look strong, but they are known for their witchcraft. You must counter their attacks carefully.
1622.title: [Lv139]Mycenaean Magic

1623.details: You've done well, but more formidable foes lie in wait. Have you heard of Mycenaean Royal Sorcerers? They are capable of casting the most ghastly curses. Only the strongest can survive their magic attacks. Do you think you are up to the challenge?
1623.title: [Lv139]Formidable Foes

1624.details: Tell Kreon this will be the last time I'll help him.
1624.title: [Lv139]A Disgruntled Message

1625.completion: It's time for the final battle.
1625.details: Scorpion Lord Selket has descended upon Greece. This is grave news, for Selket is a harbinger of evil. I'm afraid the end of the world is nigh if we don't destroy it. Eliminating its followers would be a good way to start weakening its power.
1625.title: [Lv140]Scorpion Lord's Servants

1626.completion: By Zeus, you did it! You did! You did!
1626.details: Are you ready? Have you rallied your comrades? This is an ancient god you will be facing. Its prowess is far beyond anything you have seen thus far. I won't be surprised if you lose the battle. However, know that only the greatest glory and rewards await your victory.
1626.objectives: Defeat the strongest boss, Scorpion Lord Selket!
1626.title: [Lv140]The Final Fray

1627.details: The Mycenaeans have yet to learn their lesson from their last defeat. Go forth and break their spirits!
1627.title: [Lv130]Break Them

1628.details: Heavy weaponry has always been the key to Mycenae's success in battle. Bring these troops down, and you will have dealt a deterring blow to Mycenae's invasion.
1628.title: [Lv130]Hammer Time

1629.completion: They should know who not to mess with now!
1629.details: Mycenae's best swordsmen are recruited as royal guards. Eliminate them and show Mycenae the error of its ways.
1629.title: [Lv130]Rain of Blades

1630.details: There is no quicker way to scatter the enemy than to take out their leader first. That'll teach them not to mess with us!
1630.title: [Lv130]Put-out

1631.completion: That's right! Drive home the meaning of FEAR to them!
1631.details: Our attack must be relentless and swift. Let's go!
1631.title: [Lv131]Pursuit

1632.completion: All is going according to plan.
1632.details: Those Amazons have become craftier and have been increasing the frequency of their attacks on us. Surprise them by striking back at their home!
1632.title: [Lv131]Jungle Surprise

1633.details: Rampaging bulls are a real nuisance and threat! Please, you must do something about them!
1633.title: [Lv132]Bull-ies

1634.completion: They should be no threat anymore.
1634.details: A pack of Vagrant White Bulls have been posing greater and greater threat to our villages! Get rid of them!
1634.objectives: Head forth to Thebes and eliminate 100 Vagrant White Bulls.
1634.title: [Lv133]Grave Tidings

1635.completion: Ha! Now they should stay down, literally!
1635.details: The Undead Halberdiers! Need I say more? Go forth and eliminate them!
1635.title: [Lv134]Refusing To Die

1636.completion: You really showed them their place, literally!
1636.details: The Undead Dark Mages! Need I say more?  Go forth and eliminate them!
1636.title: [Lv135]Refusing To Die Too

1637.details: No rest for the wicked! These defilers of the holy MUST be destroyed at all costs!
1637.objectives: Head forth to Mycenae and eliminate 100 Undead Dark Mages.
1637.title: [Lv136]A Long Arm

1638.completion: More poems for you? No? Why not?!
1638.details: Life precedes death, and death hence renews hope and life. What do I mean? I only meant for you to eliminate some Revived Khazras for me. Ha ha!
1638.title: [Lv137]R.I.P.

1639.completion: You can run, but you can't hide! Ha!
1639.details: Lurking Mountain Scorpions? The name says it all! Do what you must!
1639.title: [Lv138]Hidden

1640.details: The Mycenaean Female Mages have been religiously carrying out attacks against us every single day. You have to do something about it!
1640.title: [Lv139]Justice Served

1641.completion: Now it should know who it's dealing with.
1641.details: An ancient god resides in the recesses of Thebes - the Scorpion Lord! Kill his servants to tell him we're not to be trifled with.
1641.objectives: Slay 100 Scorpion Lord's Servants in Thebes.
1641.title: [Lv140]Of Scorpions And Thebes

1642.completion: You're getting the hang of this, aren't ya?
1642.details: Time and again have the undead caused trouble for us. I'm sure this will be just a menial task for you.
1642.title: [Lv130]The Undying

1643.details: Mycenae has been at war with us for a long time, and fatigue has plagued our troops. Eliminate the enemy's forces as best you can, or the war will soon be lost.
1643.title: [Lv133]Say NO to Magic

1644.details: Scorpion Lord Selket, the god of scorpions, must fall, and we must start by eliminating his followers! This is the first step toward removing this threat from our land!
1644.title: [Lv137]Desert Crusade

1645.completion: Your contributions shall not go unrewarded.
1645.details: Sicily used to be a safe haven in its former glory, but it is now nothing but a cesspit of death and disease thanks to Hades! Head to the main city and look for the Event Transporter (use Auto Routing to locate the NPC with ease) to be transported to Sicily immediately.
1645.objectives: Head forth to Sicily and kill 100 Gela Hunter. Then report to the Sicilian Refugee. (The Event Transporter can teleport you to Sicily instantly.)
1645.title: [Lv131]Keeping It Clean (9)

1646.completion: You have proven yourself a true warrior indeed. You have earned our gratitude, our trust, and our respect for your abilities. We are at your service, hero.
1646.details: You have awoken us from our eternal slumber. You say you followed the goddess Persephone's clues to find this place? Very well. Prove your mettle to us by slaying Skeleton Captain York! Then relay the good news to the Sicilian Refugees.
1646.objectives: Eliminate Skeleton Captain York to avenge the slain.
1646.title: [Lv131]Summons (4)

1647.completion: It is said that this monster has numerous clones of itself. We may yet need your help again.
1647.details: Atlas, having lost his faith and sanity, went forth to amass a gigantic army of demons. Now they are camped in the Wonderland! Our scouts have reported a numerous sightings of savage demons in the ranks of Atlas' army, with Alpha Demon at the front line.  It's up to you, hero, to deliver our wrath upon these demons!
1647.objectives: Enter the Wonderland instance via the instance NPC located in the main city and eliminate Alpha Demon.
1647.title: [Lv120]Die, No. 1!

1648.completion: Don't you ever get tired of swinging that blade?
1648.details: The target ... is the Undead Dark Mages. The number ... is 1,000. Their atrocities know no bounds ... it's time to show them their place.
1648.title: [Lv130]Wanted: Revived Khazras

1649.completion: Hope you had a good rest after all that killing! Whew!
1649.details: The target ... is the Vagrant Brown Bulls. The number ... is 5,000. Drive them to extinction. Leave none alive.
1649.title: [Lv130]Wanted: Vagrant Brown Bulls

1650.details: The Nemean Lion is a dire threat to our safety. It has been prowling around the settlements hunting for live human prey. You must make haste and remove this threat before it gets out of hand.
1650.title: [Lv40]Help Needed

1651.details: Hear my command, children of Athens! Ride forth and slay the Centaur Bandits of Thebes! Onward!
1651.objectives: Eliminate 500 Centaur Bandits, then find Rhadamanthus in Thebes.
1651.title: [Lv131]Athena's Prophecies (12)

1652.details: Eat and eat is all they know how to do! Look at my poor crops; they're all chewed up and tossed around! Please, you must go forth and teach these Ravenous Deer a lesson they won't forget!
1652.objectives: Eliminate 500 Ravenous Deer, then find Rhadamanthus in Thebes.
1652.title: [Lv131]Gluttons

1653.details: A certain individual in Mycenae threatens our safety. Head to Woods Watcher's Home, and do what you must.
1653.title: [Lv130]King of the Woods

1654.details: A certain individual in Mycenae threatens our safety. Head to Northern Flatland, and do what you must.
1654.title: [Lv130]King of the North

1655.details: A certain individual in Mycenae threatens our safety. Head to Southern Flatland, and do what you must.
1655.title: [Lv130]King of the South

1656.details: A certain individual in Mycenae threatens our safety. Head to Blood Tree, and do what you must.
1656.title: [Lv130]King of the Trees
